tei:div.tei:p: ༷// ༷hūṃ rgirdoṭwāṃ: hūṃ/ //ni byedi/hūṃ /ṭwāṃ~X 5 51 dī ཿ dro7shāshā shā 'a0 ༵ chi 30 mi3sdulta 7
༄khya/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(kha)gung thang bstan pa'i sgon mes brtsams/mirigasadaposkrunakhab/

co4 za/01ba/ mjo mthayozamaza zo2ཿ7tshojo yo1 zazo 3 zamamaloṣṭha 2khru3 1/32ma 7—105 5376—31 po smo bo khya ①pojo thayoza—maza—zatho ②mtshom maza— zla sa 3946 6—53 dzalo tho01bamatshoṣṭhazo(2ཿ3)zoḥ1྾zuzamapoloṣṭhamalotshobo( 6thoyom za shāmo14 ba za1413)6 977ya la 5sa ma 0bam ma1ska//khapomathomazalnga lozam2①3ro47zo1lo 2ཿ3ro4tha 6thoza mgralha/zatsha 8mab bza11cha77 1 2 gracho /9 25mam khu1—1 khya tshoyi 35 za(slo tsho༅stugoḥsgrirāsmozlosmyospyosmoḥshāshātsho)

/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/dpar sgrig dpe zan mi sna/blo 'dri sa/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/gling rgya bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/gung thang thub bstan/bsod nams rgya mtsho/gtso sgrig pa/ don 'grub rdo rje/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ 'jam dga'/sbyikhubacas 'doms pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/rtsom sgrig khongasami/ mgon po dar rgyas/ phur kho/ rta mgrin rdo rje/'phrin las rgyal mtshan/ pan de mkhar/ting 'dzin bkra shis/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ ting 'dzin bkra shis/

dkon ryāryarangos 'jirka medadaca barsha/ /bshad bskepa'i rkapor ca༄raban/ /lung rto༄nya tshong gi meyo/ /skyeba'i morga munaselaba'adi dbyung /rṣa da4 mang panitas ྾da pa'i ྾ ryā ma 4na ༄ te mkha grubayongs kyi gtsog ma rje 4na dkon mchog ༄na pa'i lo khrungaḥmadamalo byed par 4na ma ra mag a ri'i zam pa'i thes ྾parabuspyorje chebu/ nga sgo 7yi dku

ra / /ngaXpe chagang dpe skrun gsal bshad/de yang gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'am mtshan yongs gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me dbang phyug sder 'bod pa'i dam pa de nyid rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu pho rta lo ste spyi lo 1762lor mdo smad shar lho'i mdzod dge'i smad kyi yul du yab ze bo lcags po byams pa dang / yum bo chog gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ khong dgung lo bdun par phebs dus kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ khong gis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i drung nas dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul bcas dkyus gcig tu zhus shing mtshan la dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me zhes gsol/ de nas rdo rams pa blo bzang rin chen slob dpon du bsten nas yi ge'i sbyor klog dang blo 'dzin sogs legs par sbyangs pa ma zad/rim gyis rgya dang sog po'i skad yig sbyangs pas thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu bdun par dbus su phebs nas 'bras srungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/ hor skal bzang dngos grub dge rgan du bsten nas dbu ma dang /mdzod/ 'dul ba/ tshad ma/ phar phyin bcas gzhung bka' pod lnga la brdar sha chod par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer gcig par rgyal ba blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/dgung lo nyer gnyis par dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/1

/ /dbus su lo brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung kun la mkhyen pa thogs med du gyur cing / dbus gtsang gi mkhas mang dkyil na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar kun gyis gtsug tu bkur ba'i gnas su gyur/dgung lo nyer lnga bar yul mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/dgung lo sum cu bar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri chen du 'khod pas gdan rabs nyer gcig pa yin/ de nas bzung yul mdo smad lho byang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba'i yo lang kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo lug lo ste spyi lo 1823lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thim/ dbal mang paṇḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma mkhas chen mang du byung ngo / /khong gi gsung rtsom ni phar phyin sdom dang / mdzod sdom/ 'dul ba sdom/ sgra dang snyan ngag sman dang rtsis/ lha ris thig tshad sogs sgyu rtsal skor gyi bstan bcos rnams gcig tu bsdus te po ti bcu gcig byas nas shing par du brkos yod pa de dag kun kyang tshad mar 'dzin pa'i legs bshad sha stagayin pas nged cag dpe skrun khang gis bla brang gi shing par gzhir bzung nas dpar du btab pa'i dge ba 'di yis thams cad bkra shis bde legs su gyur cig /mi rigs dpe skrun khang /2

/ /dkar chaga'adulab rgya mtsho'i dka' gnad mdor bsdus pa nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba ཿpa//////ba //sa/ //rdo (1)chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bsdus don chos mngon rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (79)skabs bzhi ba'i bsdus don rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang ba thab((1pa //sa/ /sdus (148)yid dang kun gzhi'i dka' gnas rnam par bshad pa mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (192)drang nges rnam 'byed kyi dka' 'grel rtsom 'phro legs bshad snying po'i yang snying zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (297)bden bzhi'i rnam bzhag thar 'dod 'jug ngogs mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (565)rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rnam par bzhag pa legs bshad rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (597)

༄/ /'dul rgyam dgags domaḥlasasasgob/༄khya/ / 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dka' gnad mdor bsdus pa nor bu'i breng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/thugs bskyed tshul ni mdo sde bskal bzang las/ / nga ni sngon tshe dbul poragyur pa'i tshe/ / de bzhin gsheg5 pa shākya thub de la/ / 'jam gang zhig gi dbul ba byas nas kyang / / dang po byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ / zhes gsungs lung dang mdzod kyang de bzhin la/ / a bhya ka ras rgyal po rab gsal du/ / gyur tshe de drung bskyed 'dod 'khri shing bzhin/ / drin lan bsab mdor dmyal bar snying rje'i sems/ / skyes gsungs mod kyi smon 'jug mi 'dod lo/ / phung bo gsum mdor tshong dpon bu mngon dgas/ / mdzes pa chen po'i drung du bskyed par gsungs/ / bad dkar rin snying drung du rgya mtsho'i rdul/ / gsang ba bsam mi khyab bar rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / rin chen sna tshogs bkod pa'i rgyal po'i drung / / 'khor bsgyur yul 'khor srung gi sras bzhi ba/ / don kun grub par skyes tshe bskyed paragasungs/ / yig char yang yang bskyed pa mi 'gal la/ / dang po la yang du ma shes gyis gsungs/ / mdzod las zil gnon me rtsar sku bltams shing / / shing khyir rab byung chu rtar sangs rgyas gsungs/ / 'dir ni lcags sbrel sa byi shing rtar sbyar/ / thun gsum tha ma'i cha gsum dang po'i 1

/ /mjug / skya rengs 'char ka sangs rgyas dus nyer gnyis/ / snga gung phyi dro mtshan thun dang po dang / / de'i phyed gung thun de'i phyed mtha' dang phyed/ / skya rengs ma shar shar dang nyi ma yang / / ma shar shar gnyis brgyad cha bzhi cha shar/ / gung ma yol dang bzhi cha brgyad cha lus/ / ma nub nub dang rgyu skar ma shar shar/ / brgyad cha sogs ni mkha' la brtsi bar gsungs/ / bco lnga'i nyin mtshan mtha' yin te/ / de tshe zla ba nya phyir dang / / de nas zhag gcig chad pa yi/ / tshes lnga zhe dgu gzhi mthun phyir/ / thub gsung brgyad khri brjod bya brjod byed dang / / brjod tshul gsum gyes dgu dang bcu gnyis byas/ / gtso bo 'dul ba yin te bstod pa las/ / ji ltar sa ni skye dgu rnams kyi gzhi/ / de las 'bras rnams skye bar 'gyur ba ltar/ / de bzhin 'dul ba'ang sdom brtson rnams kyi gzhi/ / de bzhin de las bsod nams rnams kyang skye/ / tshul khrims yon tan kun gyi gnas su dgongs/ / de yi gnas ni 'dul ba yin par gsungs/ /mdzod mchog 'dul ba rdzogs pa 'di gnas pa/ / de srid chos sgon 'di ni gnas 'gyur zhing / / zhes gsungs de la rtsa bshad phyogs mthun dang / /dgongs 'grel bzhi yod dang po so thar gnyis/ / bam po gnyis gnyis brgya phrag bdun dang brgyad/ / bshad mdo gzhi dang rnam 'byed phran tshegs dang / / bla ma'am dam pa ste sde bzhi'i dang po ni/ / bcu bdun gzhi dang 'bog chog rtsa ba ste/ / lung gzhi'i bar gyi sdom tshig las/ / rab byung gso spyongagazhi dang ni/ / dgag dbye dbyar dang ko lpags dang / / sman dang gos dang srab rkyang dang / / ko sha mbi dang las kyi gzhi/ / dmar ser can dang gang zag dang / / sbo dang gso spyong bzhag pa dang / / gnas mal dang ni rtsod pa ste/ / dge 'dun dbyen rnams bsdus pa'o/ / gnyis pa pha ma'i 2

༄/ /'du gnadararabasdus raba'aphrengab/khrims kyi rtsa bar byas/ / bla mas 'grel zhing phran tshegs 'grel bshad tshul/ /phyogs mthun sbyangs ba'i yon tan ston pa dang / / dge slong la gces tshul khrims yang dag ldan/ / dgongs 'grel gnyis las mdo 'grel byukhye brag / bye brag bshad mdzod nang gi nyer sbas kyis/ / mdzad pa'i 'dul ba bye brag bshad pa dang / gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba'i nang tshan gyi/ /thogs med 'dul bsdus mdo rtsa shā tam dang / /bum brgya rtsa 'grel kā ri ka lnga bcu/ / rnam 'byed don bsdus me tog phreng rgyud kyang / / so so'i 'grel ba so so thar ba'i 'grel/ / khyad bshes mdzad sogs yang dag ltar snang brgyad/ / slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis mdzad pa yi/ /phran tshegs sgo brgyad 'grel sogs sgo brgyad kyang / / yongs su ma grags grags pa'i 'dren tshul gnyis/ / zhu ba 'dul byed gcig las 'phros pa dang / / lnga tshan bcu drug pa dang gleng gzhi dang / / sil bu gtam gzhi bram ze bu mos zhus/ / ma mo dang bcas bla ma'i le'u bcus/ / dang po gnyis dor gzhan 'dir bsdus phyir bshad/ / sems rgyud 'dul byed don bsdus phyir na mdor/ / tshul khrims ngo bos rgyas min zlog zlas ston/ /'jug pa'i yan lag gzhung don dngos gnyis las/ /dang po dgos sogs brjod bya tshul khrims la/ /dpyad bya dgos pa rna ba ma phug pa/ / ngas bskyed ched lo ma ngas par yang 'jug / gzhan gyi spyor ngan bzlog tsam 'di'i dgos par/ / tshad ma'i de nyid bsdus par bshad pa min/ / rtogs ldan 'jug ched tsam min dgos sogs bzhi/ /yod par rtogs pa yongs gcod dgos pa bzhi/ / log rtog the tshom sel ba'i rnam bcad brgyad/ / lam sogs nying dgos tsam dang lhag med dang / / de yi thob pa nyid dgos mthar thug go / rnam bcad zlog phyogs 3

/ /yongs gcod 'jug phyogs dang / / ha cang thal ba'i rtsod pa spong ba gsum/gnyis par mi nus mi dgos skyon spong gnyis/ / snga ma snga 'dra phyi ma phyi ma 'dra/bzhi nges mi nus 'brel med bye brag yin/ / 'brel ba bye smras thob par 'dod ces gsungs/ / mdo dang mi zlos rtsa 'grel ma rtogs rtogs/ /bcas dang rjes bcas rtogs pas zlos 'gal spong / / sbrul min reg pa'i gtso bo pha ma yi/ / pham lhag gsum las gzhan spyor rung mthun togs/ /khyams su min sogs mngon par 'du ba zhes/ / tshig gzhan don gzhan bstan pa rtogs par 'gyur/ / log rtog sel ba'i dgos pa gtso bo gsum/mdor bsdus dga' ba'i bsam pa bskangs pa'o/ / tshul khrims la yang ngo bo mtshan nyid dang / / dbye ba bsdu ba ldan tshul gcig tha dad/ / thob gtong drug gi dang po bye smras ni/ / gzugs 'dod mdo sde ba sogs sems pa dang / / myos dang sems med tshe na sa bon 'dod/ / stag los sems par 'dod na yid gsum sbong / / byang chub bar du'ang skye bar thal ba 'phen/ / bye smra 'ga' yang lus skal mi 'dra dang / / de yi rten la sbyor ba ma byas dang / / snga mar sbyor ba byas pa mi dran phyir/ / phyi mar mi skye na'ang nyin zhag 'og / skye la gegs byed gang zhes rtsod mod kyi/ / rtsod tshul de dang khyod gnyis mi 'thad de/ / 'dir mi skye ba bcas dbang kho nas yin/ / nges bkod rgyu mtshan gsum kyang sprul ba'i stag / 'du shes stong dang myos bas khegs sam dpyad/ / spong sems kyis zin bag chags sdom yin gyi/ / ma bcom bag chags tsam zhig phyi mar 'gro / dge slob ma yi sdom pa lo gnyis nas/ / mi gtong bdun ni nam 'tsho'i mtha' can yin/ / rab tu thar dang so sor thar pa dang / / dang por thar zhes sgra donadzogs pa min/ / bra ti dang po zlos sgra thabs byas tshe/ / mo kṣa rim 4

༄/ /khrulasargyamatsho'itsoganagarorabasdusangasarajagabazhin sdom min las grol dang / / 'khor las grol dang mya ngan 'das la 'jug / lus ngag gzhan gnod gzhi bcas las log pa'i/ / 'dod bsdus nges 'byung sdom de so thar sdom/ / gzhi la tshul gnyis sdom pas bar ma gcod/ / rdzas bzhi rten dus yan lag sgos gnyis gnyis/ / brgyad po zhag gcig spong bar khas 'che ba'i/ / khyim phyogs so thar sdom de bsnyen gnas sdom/ / kha cig dus min zas spong bsnyen gnas dang / / byug pa zur du phye bas yan lag brgyad/ / bye smras rang dang yan lag mi 'gal te/ / lta sogs lam dang byang chub yan lag bzhin/ / zhes zer slob dpon gyis bkag bzhi gcig gsum/ / yan lag dbye ba slob dpon rang lugs yin/ / rab byung la yod nyin der rdzogs rung zhing / / sdom gzhan de yis gtong rgyu min phyir ro/ / dge bsnyen tshangs spyod goms byed gso sbyong 'di/ / yin phyir go shāka de'i gtong rgyur 'dod 'khrul/ / lung las 'phrog ma 'dir bkod bar mar dgongs/ / 'o na sdom gsum rab dbye las/bye brag smra bas bsnyen gnas kyang / / dge slong las len gang zag ni/ /glingagasum skyes pa bud med las/ / 'gro ba gzhan la sdom pa bkag /mdo sde ba dag dud 'gro sogs/ / 'gro ba gzhan la'ang skye bar bshad/ /blang pa'i yul yang dge bsnyen sogs/ / gang yang rung ba'i blang par gsungs/ / mgon med zas sbyin gyis byin bye smras 'dod/ / mdo sdes 'dod pa mdzod du bshad dang 'gal/ / nyin tsam kyang phan ka ta ya nas mdzod/ / theg chen lugs la byang chub bar yang skye/ / 'dir yang nam 'tsho bar blangs mo sor skye/ / 'o na nam 'tsho'i bar du brgyad spong pa'i/ /sdom pa skye dgos mtshan nyid dang 'ga' na/ / nyi ma shar dang snga gtong phyi thob mnyam/ / zhag mi tshang phyir zos nas mi skye yang / / 'di yis zos rjes 5

/len pa dmigs bsal te/ / dran gso tsam las sngar skyes zin phyir ro/ /jo bor zur za mkhas grub rje yis bkag / dge bsnyen gyis bsdus 'khor bdun grangs su min/ / bsnyen gnas gso sbyong nu bzhi mu gsum 'khrul/ / dge ba gso phyir gso sbyong kho nar 'dod/ / sgyung gnas smra bcad sogs phyir 'dir mi gcig / nam 'tshor lnga spong rigs gnas khyim pa'i sdom/ / dge bsnyen gyi 'o sna gcig spyod sogs drug / nam 'tshor brgyad spong rab byung rtags 'dzin pa'i/ / go mi dang bdun phal chen la yod kyang / / yod smra la med de'i lugs la yod de/ / theg chen lugs la'ang nyan rang yod pa bzhin/ / gzhan du 'di bas phal chen med 'dod dam/ / kha che bas ni slob dpon mdo sde ba/ / nyi 'og bas 'dod yongs rdzogs tshangs spyod las/ / gzhan rnams dge bsnyen min te ma blangs phyir/ / zhes zer slob dpon 'ang sdom med dge bsnyen 'dod/ / rang lugs kun blangs de de bsrung la 'dod/ / de phyir sna gcig spyod pa'ang dge bsnyen dngos/ / nod 'tshe'ang gzhan dag dge bsnyen bzung gsol zer/ / 'di bas nam 'tshor lnga spong dge bsnyen spyor/ / de phyir mdo las srog spong zhes pa'ang / / srog gcod spong zhes bar tshig mi mngon lo/ /mdo sde ba sogs srog gi phyir yang chos/ / mi spong la sbyor skyabs 'gro'i dge bsnyen 'dod/ / bsdu bar mi dge bcu bo rang spong bcu/ / srog gcod phyogs gcig spong sogs 'ga' spong bcu/ / srog gcod phal cher spong sogs bcu srog gcod/ / mtha' dag spong bcu dus thung dus ring dang / / nam 'tsho'i bar spong gzhan 'god bsngags pa brjod/ / yi rang ngo rang brten bdun cu gzhan sum cu/ / bcu spong dge tshul bcu gnyis dge slob ma/ / tshangs spyod nyer gnas 'di yin logs su med/ / bdun 6

༄/ /'du dka'agasasangarabasasanoraba'iphrengaga'akhor bcas spong so thar tshul khrims te/ / dge slong sdom gsungs tshul khrims tsam mi rung / / khas 'che mi spyor bcas pa'i las dang po/ / tshur shog sogs kyis ma nges dbye ba lnga/ /sgra don dge slong la gces mdor/ /sgra 'jug rnam par zad phyir dang / / dge ba slong dang zas slong dang / /zhibar gnas dang lam zhugs dang / / zhes gsungs rkyen bzhi'i rgyu bdag gnyis las skye/ / thal 'gyur ba dang mi 'dra 'jug 'grel las/ / sa bon 'gag ma thag pa myu gu yi/ / mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen yin lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs rnam smin kun 'gro mtshungs las min/ / lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras mu bzhir gsungs/ / byed rgyu byed stong grub mthar grags pa tsam/ /byed bcas la gsum 'byung ba rgyur byas la'ang / /skyed byed gzhi dang gnas byed rten 'byung gnyis/ / rig byed tsam mo tshur shog cho ga khyad/ /bsam pa rgyu dang dus gnyis dang por gsum/ /len 'dod thob shes myang 'das sems brtan pa'o/ / 'di la 'di nyid yul 'dir 'di'i bar du/ /'thab tshe ma gtogs zhes su sems can dang / /yan lag yul dus tshe nges lnga bral dgos/ / 'thob shes 'phral du med kyang skye 'gyur te/ / dus go don yod gnyid kyang skyer gsungs phyir/ /'on pas kyang ni go gyur na/ /las brjod pa ni mi thos kyang / / 'di la bsnyen rdzogs yod pa ste/ /tshul khrims la ni nyes pa med/ /zhes su me tog phreng rgyud gsungs/slob dpon mi nus las srung rtags pa la/ / thal 'gyur nus dang ma 'ongs la bsrung gsungs/ /yul skor 'phel 'grib 'gyur zhes bye smras brjod/ /sngon med rtsa skyes pa dang mtshungs so gsungs/ / gzugs can ltar na dong tse sum brtsegs ltar/ /tshul khrims tsam du ngo bo gcig mod kyang / /ngo bo thadad nyi zla'i grib ma ltar/ / ltung ba gcig go sems par 'dod pas na/7

rag /rwa mgrub bde rdzas gcig min kyang rdzas gcig 'dod/ / thob gtong tshul gyis mi gnod nang phan tshun/ / yin par ma smras phyir ro gser dang bum/ /dngos gcig dngos po 'dor dus mi mtshungs bzhin/ / phan tshun yin na bud med smod pas kyang / / so thar sdom gtong gzugs med thob pas kyang //zag med sdom pa gtong ba'i skyon du 'gyur/ / gtong tshul dbu sems lugs la thun mong gi / pham pa 'chab bcas 'chab med gnyis gas gtong / /'chab med slar len gsungs bas btang bar grub/ / byang sems 'chab bcas gso bar nus sam dpyad/ / zhi thob rang gral sngon gyi yin na ni/ /sdom de nam zhig blang ba lugs 'dir dpyad / / mdo sdes 'chab sems yan lag phyir 'chab med/ / med smra bye smras dus mtshungs med phyir bkag skyong mar 'chab med lung 'gal ji ltar spong / / bye smra 'chab med byung ba'i rnam dag 'dod/ / 'chab pas ma dag gyur kyang gtong mi srid/ /mdo las dge slong min gsungs smad pa lo/ / 'di 'dra 'od byed sar gnas yon tan 'od/ / mi bzhed pham byas ltung kun nyes byas gsungs/ / rang nyid mi tshangs spyad par khas len la/ / bskur kyang lhag mar zhu bas ma gsungs sam/ / nyams par spyad pas gzhig min ma shes par/ / smras pa nges bzhin pham pas bskur la dgongs/ / zhu bar gcig la mthar 'gyur bzhi yang 'byung / / zhes gsungs gsum ni bcol lo thob blor dpyad/ / bslab byin bslab pa bslab chos lnga bcu sogs/ / yin gsung bod kyi kha gcig 'chab bcas kyis/ / kun gtong shes byed rgya cher 'grel drangs bas/ / lung dang kun gtong gong 'og so sor 'gal/ / kha cig so shor yin te de bsrung ba'i/ / rnam dag nyams yang gzhan yod mdzod 'grel las/ / phyogs gcig khas blangs pa yis thams cad ni/ /8

༄/ /'dulabargya gnadamadorabasdusanoraba'iphrengagablangs par mi 'gyer phyogs gcig bcang ba yis/ / thams cad btang bar mi 'gyur gsungs phyir gsungs/ / mi 'thad lung de dge tshul dge slong gi/sdom pa len dang 'bul tshul tsam yin no/ / dmar ston kun gtong so shor gang gi sgos/ / gtong rgyu min te sdom pa'i rdzas tshad phyir/ / nyams tshul la ltos kun gtong gcig gis kyang / / sdom kun dgos pa sgrub nus las nyams phyir/ /mi 'thad yon shāg rang lugs gtong rgyur 'dod/ / dgos pa drug ni mtsho ṭīka shas/ /byang chub mtho ris blangs skye dang / /chos dang zang zing phyir bcos rung / / zhes gsungs gtong rgyu thun mong lnga/ / thun mong min gsum nyams byas skyabs 'gro btang / /sogs mang ma ning 'gyur ba bsten pa yang / / nyi shu lon nas shes kyang mi gtongasal/ / dge slong bslab phul thun mong dam tshigs la dpyad/ / gnyiha pa gzhung don bye brag bshad pa la/ / skabs sgrub pa dang dngoha kyi don bstan gnyis/ / dang po go rim nges pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / / de las 'phros ba mdor bsdus spyi don gnyis/ / dang po mdor bsdus phyis bshad pa/ / bstan bshad go rim log pa min/ / khozhan du lung dang 'gal ba dang / / don cha'i bstan bshad gosalog dang / / dngos bcas ma rtogs spyor mi nus/ / mdor bsdusaṭadabye ba bye ma srog chags can/ / rko ba bkag dang dge tshul gso sbyong dang / / kham bor zan za dgag sgrub gnad mdor bsdus/ / ngo bo'i sgo nas rgyu tshogs dang bcas pa'i/ / mdor bsdus yan lag gi ni mdor bsdus gnyis/ / dang po gsal kha med par bye ma bkag / gnyis pa sprul min reg las gzhan la spyor/ / gnas skabs sgo nas gnyis te gang zag gis/ /sbyor mi shes dang shes pa go rim bzhin/ / ngo bo nyid dang byed pa'i mdor bsdus so/ / mdor bsdus ngo bo gsal kha ma btod pa'i/ /9

/ /bslab dang ston pa'i bkar yang mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ / rung mthun zhes grags mi rung mthun yang yod/ / sgos kyi dgag bya lus srog la gnod pa/ / rtsa nyag gcig gis brdeg pas mi 'grub kyang / / spyir na brdeg pa gnod pa'i rigs can phyir/ / spyi yi dgag byas mtshams bzung dmigs bsal te/ / spyir ni rang bzhin kha na ma tho rnams/ / sgos kyi dgag byas bcasapa shes byed de/ / bsnun kyang gson na pham pa mi skyed bzhin/ /gnas ma la phan phun gyur na ltung skyed pa/ / sgos kyi mtshams bzung bcas pa'i ltung ba spyi/ / spyi yi dgag byas bcas pa shes bar byed/ / kha cig mdor bsdus ltung ba nyes byas lo/ / bam lngar sde lnga gsungs so ngos 'dzin dpyad/ / mtsho ṭīka las ni thams cad rjes bcas gsungs/ / sha mis yan lag mdor bsdus sngar bcas te/ / gzhan du bcas mdzad mdor bsdus ma mdzad tshe/ / rdzu 'phrul can gye bud med dang 'grel pa'i/ / ltung byed skyed de sprul min yan lag tu/ / ma bcas phyir na yan lag tshang phyir ro/mtsho ṭīka 'dod gsungs chags pa rgyur 'gyur gyi/ / yan lag ma rdzogs phyir na dgag bya ni/ / ma rdzogs bcas pa mi rdzogs phyir zhes zer/ /bcas pa rnams 'jog dgag bya 'dir dzogs la/ / bya ba de 'brel dgag bya ma rdzogs par/ / bcas pa rdzogs srid lus srog la gnod pa'i/ /dgag bya ma rdzogs brdeg pa'i ltung skyed bzhin/ / gnyis pa dngos don bstan la sdom pa ni/ / ma thob thob byed thob ba mi nyams bsrung / / nyams pa phyir bcos tshul gsum dang po la/ / gzhi dang phran tshegs zhu ba gsum gyi don/ / 'grel bas bshad la sngon chog da chog gnyis/ / sangs rgyas rab byung rang rgyal mkhan slob med/ / ye shes khong chud tshur shog skyabs 'gro dang / / ston bar khas blang dri mnyes lce chos blang / / 'phrin dang gsol 10

༄/ /2yob༅0da ga stengarabasdusangatsophrengagabazhi'i las dang sngon chog bcu/ / mi 'thad gsum ni rig byed ltos min zhing / / 'phrin ni da chog dri sogs cho ga med/ / 'di yi cho ga tshig yin mtsho ṭīka du/ / cho gar gsungs mod de ni lta dang 'tsho/ / cho ga'i pang tshan no sgra dang don mi gcig / mtsho ṭīka dang po gnyis sdomadza'aphrin dor brgyad/bsnyen rdzogs bcu gsungs cho gar su yisaṭabatags/ / 'dren tshul mi mthun me tog 'phreng rgyud dang / / rang 'grel 'dul ba bsdus par rang byung sdom/ / lnga tshogs bcu tshogaha tha dad dbye bas bcu/ / gcig las 'phros bar dgu 'dra skyabs 'gro'i tshab/ / gsol bzhi spyi tsam bgrang bas bcur gsungs la/ / ma mor rang byung tha dad lnga bcu sdom/ / mchod sbyin mthun rkyen lnga dang cho gar dpyad/ / skal ldan der shes dbang med gsum tshang kun/ / tshur shog srid pa tha ma kho nar gnang / / skyabs 'gro sde bzang drug cu legs sbyin ni/ / gcig tu gces pa gang yin thar pa'o/ / de la dgos pa gang yin dang po'o/ / zhes te dri bas rdzogs shing sngon chog ni/ /sngon nas rgyud smin shes rab dbaca po smin/ / rnam smin las dang nyon sgrib chung la mdzad/ / da lta byas na skye yang mi rung bar/ / rin 'phreng gsungs mod srid kyang sngon chog min/ / khyad chos bzhi ldan mkhan slob mi dgos par/ / gsol bzhis rab byung bsnyen rdzogs cig car du/ / sgrub byed ji ga 'di yi mtshan nyid phyir/ / rgyal bas ring bo ma lon thag rica po'i/ /slad du gnang ba lo drug bar du gnas/ / gang las nod yul bzhi yi grangs tshang zhing / / 'grong min yul min 'dun sogs phul ba min/ / pham pas nyams min bsnyen par ma rdzogs mun/ / mtshams med ma byas sdig lta can min dang / / sa gzhan ma yin tha dad gnas pa min/ / 'khrul min dkon mchog gzhan min mtshams mtshan min/ / zhes pa bcu gsum chos ldan kha 11

/ /skong 'oha/ / ma 'dus 'dus pa phyir bzlog mi mthun med/ / khyad chos gsum tshang dge 'dun no 'dun pa 'bul/ / mtshams bcad cho ga med phyir thams cad 'dus/ / gang gis nod rten mkhan pos ma bgos bar/ /rang gis nyan thos chas byas rgan rabs bzhir/ / phyag gsum 'tshal zhing gcig gis las brjod phyir/ / de nyid gtso bor phyag gi yul du byed/ / de phyir gang zag la min dge 'dun no/ / da chog phyag tshan bcu gcig mtsho ṭīka las/ / sangs rgyas dge 'dun mkhan por gsol/ / gos kyi gnyis dang lhung bzed dang / / gsang ste ston dang mjug yon dang / / sangs rgyas dge 'dun las byed pa'o/ / shā tam las ni chos la'ang gsungs/ /gtang rag bcas na bcu gsum 'gyur/ / snam sbyar med na gyon phyag med/ / gos dang lhung bzed gnyis rung mthun/ / lhag dgu dpyad mdo lasadangos su gsungs/ / da chog pha gu'i steng du yun na ring gnas/ /mkhan pos ngo chen las slob brda sprad las/ / gsol 'debs 'dir ni rang gis btab pas chog ji ltar nod pa cho ga'i khyad par ni/ / 'gal rkyen bral sogs mi brjod gsol bzhis chog / yongs su rdzogs pa 'bras bu'i khyad par ni/ / rab byung brnyen rdzogs cig car ro dge tshul ni/ / bstan la rim slob ched yin 'di la med/ / da chog bcu gsum zer yang drug nas byung / / shā ri'i bu yis 'char ka bsnyen rdzogs phyir/ / ston pas bro g.yog mdzad pa gleng gzhi min/ / ma bgos rgod dang nad pa shi la brten/ / pha chog lung bzhi ma chog phran tshegs sogs/ / las gsungs mdo lugs bsnyen gnas 'bog chog ni/ / gnas 'jog kho nar bshad la shugs bstan du/don zhags cho 'phrul mdo dang sman blar gsungs/ / theg chen gso sbyong rten drung dge slong kyang / / len rung zeg chen sdom phyir don mi gcig /12

༄/ /'dulabargya gsagararabasdus raba'iphrengab/shes rgyud phun sum tshogs phyir mkhan por bsten/ / dag phyir bar chad dris nas dag pa bzung / / bstan la rim slob ched du gsum rim sbyin/ /snod rung bya phyir rab byung ngo mkhan pos ngos/ / dang po mkhan pos bsnyen dzogasasgrub dgos kyang / / gang mos 'ga' zhig la gnas mkhan bus yin/dkyusagacig dge bsnyen sgrub na de tshe dri/ / dge bsnyen rkyang bar mi dri mu stegs glu/ /bar ma rab byung med kyang dge tshul 'gyur/ / tshig la bsam na khyim pa'i sdom yin phyir/ / rab byungamakhan po las thob ma nges 'gyur/bzhi ba rab byung la mang sbyor dngos gnyis/ / ngo tsha khrel yod ched du gnas la zhu/ / 'di ba'i bsam pa skye phyir rtags sbyin cing / / bar chad spang phyir mtshan brtag sbyor ba'o/ / dang por dge 'dun la zhu mkhan por gsol/ / dang bor zhu mkhan la gtod zhu mkhan yang / / bsnyen rdzogs sdomadag mtshan dang lta ba mthun/ / smra shes don go shes pa rang bzhin du/gnas te tha snyad gsum ldan lus tha mal/ / sa rang bzhin gnas dge slong chos drug steng / / mtshams gnas mkhan por phyogs min zhu chog shes/ /khyad chos dgu po dang ldan des mkhan por/ / bar chad dris sam smras nas 'dus pa'am/ / so sor 'khod kyabadage 'dun long la zhu/ / dngos kyi dgos pa ma zhus nyes khegs shing / / brgyud nas khrel yod dge 'dun la gus shing / /tshogs pa gcig gyur bar chad mthong na 'dren/ / bstan rma mi 'byin skur tshig spong dang drug dngos gzhir 'gal rkyen bzhi bral mthun lnga tshang / / skye gnas mdzes dang khyad 'gyur bar chad bzhi/ / dang por rten las gnas skabs bsam dbang gis/ / mi skye bzhi'o rim bzhin mtsho ṭīka las/ / sprul pa pho mo ma ning lnga lnga bcu/ / mtshan lan gsum 'gyur mtshan dug mtshan med dang / / za ma dud 'gro mi min sgra mi snyan/ / lus 13

/ngag sdom pa thob min bco brgyad do/ / rku thabs gnas dang mu stegs can zhugs dang / / mtshams med lnga dang rnam dag sun phyung dang / / rtsa ltung 'chab bcas byung dang sngon rab byung / / tshe 'di'i las sgrib rnam pa bcu nyid do/ / rang rang skabs kyi lo grangs ma lon dang / / khyim pa'i cha lugs dag dang ldan pa dang / / rab byung 'di ba'i cha lugs yongs nyams dang / chad pa'i rgyu zlog khas mi len dang bzhi/ / mu stegs lta dang skye tshe len sems log / 'dod chags kyis gzir rang dbang med gyur dang / / khro bas rang dbang med par sems 'khrugs dang / / gti mug dbang gyur thob shes med dang lnga/ / zhes gsungs pha ma'i thun mong yin min dbye/ / skyes pa brgyad bab mi skye bar chad gang / / reg bkan sngon 'gro med myong ma sun byed/ / gsum par gnas mi bya dang mu stegs kyi/ / rtags can gnyis bsnan mu stegs can zhugs la/ / dngos dang bon sogs lan gnyis las myong ba/ / gnyis su dbye ba thub bstan byi dor gsungs/ / rgyu zlog chad pa khas mi len pa gzhir/ / bar chad yin yang skye ba'i chos can gsungs/ /zhu bar mi skye gsungs pa mi 'gal tshul/ / gnas phyung babs pa'i skyes pa bud med zer/ / sngon rab byung ba phran tshegs bkag dang zlos/ kha cig bsdig sogs bzhi dang gnas dbyung bdun/ / mi 'thad snga ma'ang dbyung bar ṭīkkar gsungs/ / rang lugs ngag gi mi gtong 'dra na yang / / zhes nas btang dang ma btang dbye ba yod/ / gnas pa'i bar chad rgyal po pha khyo rje/ / khyad 'gyur bar chad zhe drug sha tam las/ / mdzes 'bras phol mig 'bum phran sha bkra dang 1khyi rngo g.ya' glog rkang shu skems nad sogs/ /mdzes pa'i bar chad lung gzhir lag rdum sogs/ / nyer bzhi phran tshegs sgra sogs don bzhi dang / / zhu bar sen gcig la sogs lnga bcu ste/ /14

༄/ /lugo ma mkhagagacadarabasduthosatsophre'i/dbyibs dang kha dog la brten brgya so brgyad/ / lham mkhan gdol g.yung la sogs rigs kyi drug / gzhi las mu stegs can sogs bcu bzhi dang / /phran tshegs rgyal pos bkra ba sogs brgyad la sbyar/ / sprul sogs bcu gcig khyad chos brgyad ldan phyir/ / rgyu zlog pa la bkol ba spyor 'dod 'khrul/ /bkol ba ming ngo ming can tshig drug ni/ / rab tu dbyung phyir nye par 'ongs pal/ / ma yin nam drir ba byung byed dag gis/ / ma yin nam dri rab byung mi bya zer/ / de bzhin bsnyen rdzogs 'ongs la dri sogs gsum/ /bsnyen rdzogs tshe na lag rdum mi dri bas/ / bar chad thun mong dri ba thun mong min/ / de sogs mu sum yod kyang 'dir dri tshig / thun mong kho na ste don drug tshang dgos phyir/ / gnas pa sbyin yul sngon ni mu stegs yin/ / shākya sogs min sems mgu dge bsnyen yin/ / 'byung 'dod tshogs su ma long gsol gsum 'debs/ / la sogs bcu ldan no sbyin bya'i gnas pa ni/ /mkhan pos gos dang dge 'dun zas kyi'o/ / kha cig bu lon bkol pa mi sbyong ste/ / ma yin nam gyi yin nam bsal shul du/ / dgag sgra ma rkyang bzhag nas med dam zhes/ / ming can phyung 'jug byas shing 'jal lam zhes/ming can lhag phyir zhes zer pham yis/ / ma gnang la yang mjug tu yul thag ring / / ma gtogs zhes pa ming can lhag ba dang / / gnang ngam zhes dgag tshig phyung nas sgrub tshig bcug / de phyir der yang mi sbyor thal bar 'gyur/ / mtsho ṭīka zhag bdun bsrel ba bkag kyang dpyad/ / bu lon bdag po mi yin gson thag nye/ / de las dbang ches ma gnang 'jal dgos dang / / mi 'khor bu lon chags pa chos drug ldan/ / dang po bzhi ni pha ma gnyis la sbyar/ / yul rgyud rtags bsam cho ga mthun rkyen lnga/ / yul nu sangs rgyas cho ga mkhan slob sogs/ / rgyud ni tshogs su ma long sngon 15

/ /nyams min/ / rtags ni khyim spang rab byung cha lugs 'dzin/ / bsam pa rang bzhin gnas dang thob par 'dod/ / thob shes nges pa lnga bral nges 'byung ldan/ / byang rdor nges 'byung brtan po sgom byung zer/ / tshul gnas thos bsam gzhi nas sbyor ba yod/ / brtan po yod na rgyal srid phyir mi gtong / / kun dga'i tsha bo dper byed bsod grags bkag / spyir btang dmigs bsal med pa e ma ho/ / mthun rkyen lnga ba cho ga lan gsum pa'i/ / skyabs bdag rdzogs nas gzhan brjod tshe na skye/ / de tshe slob dpon gyur ba dper mdzad de/ / 'di la tshig bsgyur gsal zhing dge slong la/ / gsum ga'i dngos brjod bya brjod byed brjod 'dra/ / khrims med ro langs brtse med seng ge 'dra/ / 'khor ngan sbrul dkris phan med shing skam bzhin/ / de phyir bla ma'i mtshan nyid sum brgya bar/ / tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho la shes/ nad pa snying brtse 'khor ni dag ba dang /chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs la brtson ba/ / dus su 'doms pa de ltar bla mar bsngags/ / zhes gsungs mkhan po gnyis dang slob dpon lnga/ /dge slob ma yi mkhan po bsnyen gnas dang / / dge bsnyen slob dpon las slob gsum yod phyir/ / las byed logs su bgrang bas slob dpon brgyad/ / khas blangs na 'gyur khyim pa'i rab byung mkhan/ / gsang ston dris na 'gyur bar mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ / rin phreng nang du zhu dgos gsungs pa 'ardokhru/ / chos drug gzhir byas dge tshul cho ga shes/ / dri shes dge tshuge slob dang gsang ston 'os/ / bsko tshe chos drug steng du mtshams gzhan min/'gro ba bzhi bral spro dang tshogs ma long / / sdar bskos ma 'brel mkhan slobaphyogs min dgos/ / snga ma bcu bzhi bsko las kun la sbyar/ / sdom dag chos de shes sogs klog la lnga/ / lan gsum bzla bar bcom brlag 16

༄/ /'du44༅0dkagagasadorabasdu'aratsosgob/lung las 'byung / / de phyir go na gcig gis chog 'dod 'khrul/ / mkhan slob ming nas smos tshul sum brgya bar/ / slob dpon slob dpon tshig dang ldan pas so/ / don sogs smos pa nye ba'i tshig byas te/ / 'dul bcas mkhan por gyur ba'i tshig dag brjod/ / rgan la btsun pa'i nye ba'i tshig gis brjod/ / gzhon la'ang tshe dang ldan pa'i nye tshig gis/ / de bzhin gnas brtan zhes bya'i nye tshig brjod/ / skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya thun mong min gsum steng / / srog phyir mi gtong 'phongs kyang gzhan mi 'tshol/ /ci za'i phud mchod rtag tu skyabs su 'gro/ / 'gro phyogs lhag par skyabs 'gro thun mong lnga/ / phan yon nang pa sdom rten sdig zad dang / / ngan 'gror mi ltung gnod pas mi tshugs shing / / don 'grub bsod nams rgya chen sangs rgyas brgyad/ /logs par zhugs min rmongs pas skyabs 'gro ni/ma byas bsnyen gnas sgye ba gang sbel gsungs/smad rgyud 'bag gis kha skong bdud tshig ste/ / dmar g.yog gtsang gsum dang ni rgya'i dge slong / / ke wang gyi wan gnyis dang lnger gsungs so/ / bzhi yis mi rdzogs sag lhas/gal te bzhi ni las brjod mkhas/ / tshul khrims ldan par gyur na ni/ /bsnyenadzogs ma smad gyur pa ste/ / zhes kyang ni zhes dgar tshig gis/ /las byed zur du bstan pa yin/ / tha dad mtshams gnas bcu gnyis rung /thag rgya'i mdo rtsom spyon ham che/ / der bas chu gtor de bas mtshar/ /skyes pa mchog gi sa bsgrub nyes bcas skye/ / ma chog nyes med kyis rdzogs pha yod de/ / mtshan 'gyur ro lo yi zhib cha 'dis shes so/ / mkhan po med dngakhyem pa las skye yang / / shes dang mi dga'i ming bsgyur sogs la min/yo byad 'ga' med la skye gtan med min/ / chos gos rgyu yis rung bar shā tam gsungs/ / mngon gyur bcu yi ston pa dge 'dun te/ / logs su 17

/ /sangs rgyas brdar btags ston ba'i sku/ / las dang bslab gsum lung rtogs chos mngon 'gyur/ mkhan po slob dpon bsnyen bar rdzogs 'dod dang / / yongs dag yo byad gsol ngang las mngon gyur/ / stod 'dul gsol bzhi'i gsol gsol brjod pa las/ / gsol de gsol bzhis bsdus phyir 'thad dka' la/ / smad 'dul gsol btab gsol dang gsol ba zhi las/ / bsnyen rdzogs dkyus la sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ / mkhan pos las slob sogs la gsol 'debs pa/ / mkhan po nyid du phyogs pa'i las dang gcig / bsgrub byas rang la mkhan por gsol ba dang / / des der chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed ster/ / lhung bzed bstan dang byin rlabs sdom dang bzhi/ / bsgrub bya bkar nas gsang ston spro dris bsko/ /deyis lkog tu dris nas nang du zhu/ / las byed bar yis tshogs la bsnyen rdzogasagasol/ / nang du bar chad dri dang sbyor ba brgyad/ / chos gos mi ston lhung bzed las yang ste/ / rgyu rung bdun dang kha dog gsum gsungs la/ / lhung bzed sa lcags gnyis la nag po nyid/ / rgyu yi byin rlabs mi chags lcags gong la/ / snod blo mi skye ras la gos blo skye/ / mtsho ṭīka las so rin chen phreng ba las/ / che chung skya bor lhung bzed blo skye phyir/ / rgyu yi byinazlabs 'chag bar thal bas bkag / gsang ston bskong nga nang du dri ba'i phyir/ / gsol ba 'ba' zhig 'dra yang phyi ma ni/ / thos rung bar chad med par nges zin phyir/ / zhes gsungs 'o na slar 'di ci phyir dpyad/ /bsnyen bkur gnas dang gnas min shes phyir dus/ / bslab shes pa srung phyiragadams pa mjug chog go / grib tshod nyin mtshan cha dang tshes grangs dang / / zla ngo dus tshod lo 'gros bdun char brjod/ / dkyus gcig brgya sogs bsgrub la grib tshod dpyad/ / mgo rgyal mchu sbo dgun gyi zla ba 18

༄/ /'dulabargya gsagararabasdusanoraba'iphrengagabazhi/ /nag pa sa ga sgon dang chu stod dpyid/ / gro zhun dbyar ro khrums stod tshes gcig thung / / khrums stod tha skar smin drug dbyar ring po/ /lngar phye dbyar thung ngos bzung de la dbyar/ / phyi ma khas len phyir ro gsum phyi ba/ / dman pa phyag dar khrod kyi tshad rtogs phyir/ / gso sbyong gzhi las dgun stod dgun smad dang / / dpyid dang so ga dbyar ston drug gsungs pa/ / bcu bzhi'i gso spyong bde blag rtogs phyir ro/ / gdams ngag pha la bcu gcig mar bcu gnyis/ / phye na phyag dar bsod stoms gnas shing drung / / sman bkos por ba tshangs spyod gnas pa bzhi/ / tshor ba sdug bsngal khro ba'i grogs yin phyir/ / zhe sdang can la ma gnang (dgon pas khron shing drung la yang 'dra bas bshad pa mang dogs pas dpyad/) dgu ma brjod/ / ltung byed pha ma bzhi dge sbyor byed pa'i chos/ / gshe khro brdeg mtshang 'bru yang slar min bzhi/ /'og ma brgyad dang nyi shu'o ma la yang / /sger gyi pham bzhi lci chos brgyad bsnan te/ / gnas bzhi'i shing drung bkol bas so gcig go /ltung byed nyes byas kyang dud zla ba phyed/ / mgu ba spyod phyir lce ba'o pha'i dge 'dun/ / la brten bsnyen rdzogs gsol dang zla phyed na/ / gdams ngag zhu dang mtshams po che bcad na/ / dpag tshad phyed gsum ma bcad gcig gi nang / / dge 'dun med par dbyar khas mi len gsum/ / gnyis gar bsten pa mgu spyod dgag dbye gnyis/ / dge slong gang zag la brten nyes mi gleng / / mi spyo gsar bu la yang phyag bya gsum/'phros don sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis ni/ / bsod stoms pa dang stan gcig phyis mi len/ / chos gos gsum dang phying ba phyag dar khrod/ /dgon pa shing drung ba dang bla gab med/ / dur khrod tsog bu ba dang gzhi ji bzhin/ / che long dbye ba'o zhib mo rnam bzhag tu/ / phye na nyi shu 'dris pa'i 19

༄/ /khyim tsam nas/ / za ba rnyed pas chog dang mthar chags kyis/ / za ba mthar gyis slong ba'i bsod snyoms gnyis/ / stan chu zas kyi mtha' ba'i stan gcig gsum/ / za 'phro btod nas zhag der phyis mi len/ / 'dra yang snga rol byen len lan gcig dang / / rim phyir dus gcig pa dang gsog bu ba/bor dang dus tshigs spyad pa'i phyag dur khrod/ / thams cad dur khrod phyogs 'ga' dur khrod gnyis/ / kun tu mi snyel cog bu che chung gsum/ / zas gos gnas mal spyod lam sred pa'i dgra / gsum gsum cog bu gzhan lnga go rim bzhin/ / bslab yul slob byed gnyen por gdams pas bsdus/ /gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams srung tshul la/ / phyi'i rkyen gzhan brten nang gi bsam phun tshogs/ / spang bya ngo shes bslab pa yongs sbyong sgos/ /bder gnas rkyen brten sgo nas bsrung tshul lnga/ / dang por gnas dang de la brten tshul gnyis/ / nye dgar brten nas lo bcu rgan zhugs brten/lnga ba nyi shu ston pa ljongs rgyu'i grogs/ / nyung bar gzigs nas tha ma rjes bcas mdzad/ / lnga lon ljongs rgyu rjes bcas la dgongs gsungs/ / nyer gcig lung gzhi'i bar sdom las/ / lo bcu lon dang 'dzin dang mkhas/rig dang gsal dang 'dzin 'jug dang / / slob dang slob 'jug rnam pa gnyis/ / phun sum tshogs gnyis rnam pa gsum/ / slob dang mi slob byung shes dang / / gnas 'cha' 'char 'jug ltung ba shes/ / lho yi ri la rgyu ba yi/ / sde tshan yang dag bsdus pa yin/ / lnga tshan dang po gnyis shes lnga pa ste/ / 'dul bas 'gyod sel mngon pas sdig lta spong / / bsam pa shes pas gnas 'dor gnas yul phyogs/ / lo bcu nye phyir mas bgrang tha ma yin/ / lhag phyir gzhan min don gyi dbu phrug gnyis/ / drug phrug bcu drug bdun phrug gnyis su gsungs/ / tshul ldan pham pas ma gos rang bzhin 20

༄/ /'dulabargya gnadararabasasanoraba'iphrengab/gyi/ / kha na ma thor 'dzem pa'o dud 'gro sogs/ / gsod pas 'chad 'gyur khang chen lhag mas min/ / 'chal ba'i tshul khrims mi dge'i gzugs migasungs phyir/ / mtsho ṭīka las so rin phreng de bkag nas/ / rab la lhag mas mgos dgos par gsungs/ / spyod sogs gnyis la mdo mngon dran ldan sogs/ / gsum la 'dul ba sde snod gsum 'dzin sogs/ /bdun la thun mong bstan bcos mang thos sbyor/ / kha cig rig gnas dang po bzhi zer yang / /sde snod gsum gyes bsdus pa'i lnga yod gsungs/ /mi brjed 'dzin dang 'brel gnas 'byed par mkhas/ / rtsom dang gzhan la 'chad pa'i rigs gsal gnyis/ / phyi ma chad lhag nor med 'grel chung gsungs/ / rang dbang can du thal bar mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ / mu stegs las lhag 'dul ba'i spyod pa dang / / sde bzhi'i 'dul dang bslab gzhi lhag so thar/ /phyi ma pha ma'i so thar gnyis su grags/ / lhag pa'i bslab pa mya ngan 'das pa la/ / dbang byas don phyir lhag pa'i don mi gcig / lhag tshul phyir yin tshul ldan dang mi zlos/ / kha cig zag med sdom phyir mi zlos lo/ dad gsum bcas rang ma gos phun tshogs tshul/ / mang thos mang po la thos mang dang thos/ / yid mi 'ong la dngos po yid 'ong ba/ / kha ma gang lus gang tsam las phri nas gtong / / tshul khrims ting shes zad mi skye shes pa'i/rnam grol phun tshogs mi slob lta phun tshogs/ / mi slob lnga bar mi zlos de'i tshul khrims/ / zag med phyir dang de ldan 'di yod par/ / ma nges bcas 'gal rgyan med drag bcom bzhin/ / dran ldan bsrings gnyis sgo nas yang dag bzhag / bying rgod bral ba'i mnyam bzhag tshogs la sbyar/ / slob pa bdun gyi zag med bslab gsum steng / / kun spang min phyir mos pa rnam grol dang / / shes bzod de shes de mthong ngo 'dod sdug bsngal/ / bzod 21

/ /gnas mos pa rnam grol bzhag par dka'/ / mi slob 'dus byas rnam grol zad mi skye/ / shes pa shes dang mthong ba mi slob lta/ / yul dang gang zag nyon mongs nye bar bcas/ / gleng gzhi'i dgag bya'i nyes dmigs rgyu mtshan dang / / gzhi dang bsam sbyor rgyu tshogs byed rgyu yin/ / gsum char byung pa'o byung ba 'di dang zhes/ / gsungs ba'i byung ba nyes yin 'dir mi gcigadage tshul gleng gzhir mi 'os phyir sgrag can/ / rdzun smras byung la ma bcas byung shes dang / / bcas dang rjes su bcas pa'i byung shes gnyis/ gnyis par mdor mu gsum dor mu drug / dgag rjes dgag pa rgyab mnyen dgon pa pa/ / sgrub rjes sgrub pa ma nus dbyar phyi ma/ / gnang rjes gnang ba lham gnang sgrub can gnang / / ma dor gsum po rjes bcas bsam ngo ba/ / dgag rjes dgag sogs bsam dor ma nges te/ / klur spyad rang gos brkus la sbom gsar bcas/ / gso sbyong ma grub byin rlabs bya ba dang / / klog gnang shā ri'i bu la dmigs bsal bas/ / gnang bkag tshang phyir mi 'dor yang mtshan nyid pa/ / rjes bcas gleng gzhi pham pa'i gleng gzhi min/ / spyor sbo ma pham pa'i tshe na byas sam dpyad/ / dgag rjesasgrub pa sngon bkag nyam ngar sgrub/ / mtsho ṭīka bu lon can gye nyo tshong gsungs/ / dgag rjes gnang ba nad par dus min zas/ / sgrub rjes gnang ba nad pas mi nyan rung / / dgag pa gnas brten 'dom na dbyar gnas bkag / gnang rjes bkag pa lham gnang krog krog bkag /gnang rjes sgrub pa dbyar nang byen rlabs nas/ / 'gror gnad dbyen zhi'i phyir du dgos zhes sgrung / / rin phreng grogs bcas 'grong gnang nad g.yogs bsgrubs/ / sngar bcas rgyu mtshan dor phyir dor ba ste/ / gnang rjes dgag pa rgyu mtshan gtan med dang / / phyi dro'i zas gnang zil gnon 22

sa / /'dul ༅rgya 2bsdus rdor༄9)che kyagadong pa'o/ / rang bzhin ltung ba dgag rjes dgag rten nyid/ / gnang ba mi srid 'o na rnam 'byed las/ / mngon pa'i nga rgyal can ni ma gtogs gsungs/ / lhag ma'i skabs kyang rmi lam ma gtogs gsungs/ /'du shes bsgyur ba med pa'i rdzun min la/ / ci dgar min yang bcas gnang tsam zhig yin/ / bkag pa mngon shes bkag pa srog phyir yang / / bkag ste bkag dang gnang tsam bcas pas bstan/ / sgrub pa'ang 'dis gnang min te ci dga' ru/ / bya'am ma byas kyang rung min phyir ro/ / dgag dgos log pa nges pa bzhir log dang / / gzhan gnyis dang por yul dus dngos gang zag / a sma ba ran tar khrus zla phyed khrus/ / so phag rim gsum las lhag ba lang bdag / byang du dus shes dgos phyir yul nges min/ / sngar nas gnang dang ma gnang dpyad bya'o/ / srog gcod thang ba'i bar gcod bzlog pa gzhan/ / rang nyid legs gnas rjes khrid rjes ston te/ / dge lalegs 'jog sdig las rnam par bzlog / thos bsam sogs la rjes su sgrub 'jug gsum/ / de de'i bsngags brjod rjes mthun gsum dang drugaltung ba ltung med lce yang so thar dang / / rgyas pa sde bzhi thon pa tha ma'o/lce yang 'dul ba bsdus pa las/ / ltung ba rnams kyi chung la sogs/ /rnam pa lngar ni rigs par bya/ / ngo bo nyid dang byed pa dang / / gzhi dang bsam dang tshogs pa'o/ / dang po pham lhag lhung byed do chad las sgos/ /yin gyi rnam smin min te 'chab pham las/ / dbye na lci la ma 'gro'i lhag las phyugs gsod lce/ / bshags yul mtshams kyi phyi nang dbye ba yod/ / chad las mi spyor spyir btang dmigs bsal 'khrul/ / byed pa'i sgo nas ma gus byas pa dang / / nyon mongs mang dang mi shes bag med gsum/ / gzhi yis mi dang mi min dud 'gro gsum/ / bsam pa drag zhan tshogs pa gcig 23

/gnyis yang / / gsum nas grangs shes bar 'bring mi shes lci/ / rten sgos blun lce mkhas yang sngar bshad dang / / mi 'gal khyad gsod med sgos yang mod kyang / / mi bshags phyir na lci'o lcags snod bzhin/ / dang po bcu bdun khyad can bzlos pa gzhan/ / gsum gnyis shes dang 'dul ba rkyang shes phyir/ / mtsho ṭīka gnas 'cha' 'char 'jug khyad can gsungs/ /bslab gsum slob dang slob 'jug phun tshogs 'og / slob dang mi slob 'phags nyid gzhan gnyis ga'i/ / de phyir 'dul rkyang shes pa 'phags par med/ / mdo mngon mkhas pas khyab lo mi 'thad de/ / lo bcu'i nang nas 'dul shes bslab gus shing / / blo mig ldan phyir gsungs pa'i lnga pa yi/ /bcas ldan dgra bcom lnga ba mi ldan yang / / rang dbang can gsum lnga pa rang dbang can/ / lnga tshan gzhan ldan mi ltos 'dzin 'jug gsal/ /slob 'jug gnyis dang bzhi las gzhan rnams so/ / lnga ba 'cha' ba'i gzhi byed lnga gzhan gyis/ / kha skong mi 'gro yan lag rang dbang can/ / dran ldan sogs so bzlog pa mang tshul gnyis/ / brtson shes bar chad yin min smra rjes ston/ / chad dang ma dag mi mkhas bcus brtan min/ / dang po'i thub pa'ang 'dir bshad brtan min la/ / sdom dag bcu tsam lon pa'i ma yang min/ / mtsho ṭīka lnga ba tha ma nges bzung ste/ / gzhan du sngon gnas 'chi 'pho zag zad pa/ / gsum rig yin yang mi bya gsungs phyir gsungs/rin phreng lo lngas drug cu mtshon pa ltar/ / lnga ba tha mas gzhan rnams mtshon par gsungs/ / de la brten tshul zhu ba dmigs bsal bcas /bsnyen bkur je ltar bya dang dman las bslang / / gsum mo dngos su ma zhus nyes kheg cing / / brgyud nas khrel yod bya shes gnas la gus/ / zhu bya mi rung mi zhu yid gnyis dang / / rung shes phal cher zhu'o 'do ldan las/ /24

༄/ /'dulabargya40dkagagasangarabasdusanorakhu'iphrengagakun tu spyad par rung ba dag bgyi zhes/ / zhu bya bstan gyi zhu tshul la bstan gsungs/ /gnam rtse ldeng mar bsdus ba'i zhu tshul mdzad/ / yul rten bya ba'i dmigs bsal dang por bzhi/ / bla ma med na rgan dang de med gzhon/bla ma nye bar mi gnas sa gzhan spyod/ / rten gyi brgyad de lnga lon ljongs rgyu dang / / tshol ba'i zhag lnga ngal ba'i nyin gcig gnyis/ / bla mas bkag dang dge 'dun gyis phyung dang / / tshangs spyod bar chad sogs so mtsho ṭīka las/ / dbyar nang gnas med rgan brten 'dir yang bgrang / / bya ba'i dmigs bsal dgu ste bshang gci nas/ / bskos bar zhar byung gzhan byung drug 'dir gsungs/ / 'od ldan chu btung mi zhu rdul sprug pa/ / ṭīkkar bkol lo de mtshungs mdor bsdus bcas/ /bla mar nan tur mi 'byung phyir bcos gzhir/ / sde snod 'dzin la de byed sbom por gsungs/ / zhe na skyon med phyogs 'khor mang la dgongs/ / gzhan du dbyung yang rung ste 'od ldan las/ / ka bar gyur pa mdo sde 'dzin gang dang / / de bzhin gzhan yang cho ga bzhin spyad bskrad/ / spo mgu dbyung gsum zhu ba'i grogs kyang byed/ /sde snod 'dzin pas gcig mdun bshag gsungs pa/ / sdom sems skye la dgongs pas 'dir mi 'gal/ / lhung bzed rgyu mdog dbyebs dngos cho gas rung / / bzhi ba lhan lnga ma phog spyad bzod do/ / lnga bas ma khyab 'brel med lhung bzed phyar/ / bod brer ya khyod nyer gcig de'i drug cha/drug phul yin zhing bdun cha bdun phul phyir/ / ma ga dha brer drug phul yin na gnyis/ / bdun phul do dang khyor pa gang shor phyir/ / 'bras 'thug ma ga'i bre gang btsos 'phel ba'i/ / phul drug tshod ma phul do stong phul gang / /dgu shod pha yi chung mtha' 'o bco brgyad che/ / snga ma ma yi che yin 'grang tsam chung / / sngar nas kun la yod phyir gleng gzhi med/ / ro 25

/ /dor rjes bcas chung ngu'i gleng gzhi yin/ / ma ga'i gser zho brgyad la de'i srang gcig / de'i srang bcu drug de yi bre gang tshad/ / de la bod srang sum cu rtsa gnyis yod/ / 'das pa'i rwa gcig ma 'ongs rwa gnyis pa/ / da lta rwa bzhi gsum ga'i rwa drug ma/ / smad gzhog zur bdun lcags kyi mdud bas bkag / bar du drang po'i ring bzhin gsom shing dang / / stod gzhog zur brgyad rwa bzhi mchod rten gnyis/ / a long bcu gnyis lcags kyu'o 'khor lo yang / / mkhar gsil dum bu gsum gyis bslab gsum mtshon/ chu tshag rnam lnga dpe ris steng nas nges/ / bud med bslab tshig gnyis po gsol gnyis kyis/ / dge slob ma mtshan gyur pa'i dge tshul la/ / dge tshul sdom pa rgyun gnyis yod dam dpyad/ / stong na skye tshe phul nyams dka' zhes grags/ / len tshe len sems log pa phul pa ste/ / mtshan gnyis byung ba'i rten nyams la mi skye/ /gsum ba spang bya shes nas bsrung ba la/ / sde lnga so so zhu ba spyir bstan gnyis/ / dang por pha ma'i sde lnga dang por yang / / thun mong bslab pa 'bul chog sde lnga dngos/ / 'bul yul tha snyad lnga ldan no ma nus na/ /bslab pa phul la dus gsum dgos pa gsum/ / dngos po rten dang bdag rkyen 'bul ba dang / / mi mthun phyogs khas blangs pa'i 'phul tshul bzhi/ / 'dir bstan phul nyams dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgos/ / phul ba go byed do dgag pa'i bslab bya gtso/ / rab byung rten la 'byung ba'i ltung ba de/ / dbye gzhi'o pham sogs khyim pa'i rgyud na yod/ / gsum du ma nges pham lhag ltung byed dang / / gnyis su ma nges lhag ma ltung byed kyis/ /bsdus phyir ma nges sde yang sde lngas bsdus/ / ltung ba bsdu tshul brgyad de dngos bsam sgos/ / sbyor ba'i sgo nas skad cig na re ba/ / ngo bo'i sgo nas 26

༄/ /'dulabargya gsagayorabasdusarnaraba'iphrengagami dge lung ma bstan/ / mthar thug 'phen pas 'grub ba srog gcod ngang /lusakyis myong la ltos pa mi tshangs spyod/ / gzhi yi sgo nas sems can yin min brten/ / byed pa'i sgo nas rang dang gzhan la bcol/ / 'byung ba'i sgo nas lus ngag las 'byung gnyis/ / bya ba'i sgo nas bya rung mi byed gzhan/'dir bstan bcas rang khyad par lung bstan min/ /mi dges bslang ba'i cha nas bzhag kyang spyir/ /srid nyon rang bzhin kha na ma tho yin/ /spyir gye sdig ltung mu bzhi brtsi sla la/ / gsod pham byung 'phral sdig ltung dngos gcig kyang / / stobs bzhis sdig dag ltung ba dag pa min/ / phyir mi 'ong gis spangs yang dag ming med/ / mtshan 'gyur thun mong min pa'i pham dag kyang / /sdig pa ma dag shin pham pa dag /shi dang mtshan 'gyur pham bas dag rgyu min/ / khrims kyi phan yon 'chal snyam 'gyod pa med/ / grags khyab bder gnyid lha yis srung sogs mang / / dgag bsgrub bslab pa 'cha' rgyu bco lnga sogs/ / bcas pa'i phan yon dge 'dun bsdu ba dang / / dge 'dun 'dod pa spangs bas legs par byed/ / ngal dub spangs pas bde bar byed sogs bcu/ / rang gzhan bsten bya bsten byed gnyis ga'am/ /gang rung lus las bkol ba'i sbom po'i tshogs/ / yan lag bzhi lhag ma tshang ba yang yod/ / bsam sbyor gyis dbang zhe nas bsngos pa'i yul/ /yul chos kyis dbang shog ma khral gyi rigs/ / rigs brgyud kyis dbang bu ni pha yi nor/ / nor der sangs rgyas bkas dbang chos kyi rdzas/ / lung rtogs de de ldan no dge 'dun la/ / phul ba de dbang de yang rnam bzhi ste/dbyar sogs dus kyis rnyed par khas blangs dbang / / shi ba'i yo byad sna tshogs so sor dbang / /glo bur rnyed pa dbang tshul yang bzhi ste/ / gnas 'dir 'dis zhes khrims su bcas pa dbang / / mtshams der phul la 27

/ /mtshams kyi sgrub pas dbang / / sbyin yul so sor nges byas de nyid dbang /mngon sum phul na gang la phul de dbang / / dgra bcom rdzas brkus pa la sbom por gsungs/ / dus dang gnas dang rku yul rku mkhan la/ / ltos nas rin tshang sbyor gcig nang du'o/ / thob blo skye ba yul gnyis gar nye ba/des brtsi mnyam na rkun ma'i gnas kyis so/ / mgron bu nyi shur gar ka na gcig ste/ / de bzhi sdom pa'i rin la ma sha zer/ / ma sha gsum gyis pham pa'ang dus kyis srid/ / rgya yis rta dang sbal ti nas khal bzhi/ / bu ston tshong 'dus mgur mo'i bzhin ma gsungs/ red mda' gser zho'i phyed sogs lugs mang yang / / rang lugs gser zho'i brgyad cha'o dngul brgyad char/ / gsungs pa dngul thur gyis zho brgyad cha la/ / bya yi 'deg bya'i rdzas ni dngul ma yin/ / zas dang dur zas gzhan don min pa dgos/ /pham par dud 'gro'i sde tshan (ma gha dha'i ) gzhan du 'gyur/ / gzhi med gsal bar ma smras bcas gzhan 'gyur/ / ltung med la bzhi dngos gzhi ltung med pa'i/ / ltung med nyung nyung brkus kyang ltung med do/ / ltung ba rnam bzhag med pa'i ltung med ni/ / nyes sdes gsod sems med par mngal blugs la/ / yi rang tsam ste srog gcod min phyir ro/ / der gtogs ltung ba med pa'i ltung med ni/ / do gsum len skabs rjen par blangs la ste/ /skabs gzhan rjen btsos gtogs pa'i nyes byas 'gyur/ / ltung ba gtan med la gnyis spyos pa sogs/ / bcas rang ltung ba mtha' dag med pa dang / / bcas pa 'ba' zhig ltung med rnam bzhi ste/ / dgag bya nyes dmigs med pa'i ltung med ni/ / rdo dang so phag rtsig dang phye ma rko/ / bar chad rkyen dang ldan pa'i ltung med ni/ / srog phyir bcas rkyang phal cher gnang pa'o/ / rang bzhin gnang med de 'dra 'dom tshe rang / / gsod du 28

༄/ /'du4rgyal dgagaga'ar༄'arakhu'isgogabacug kyang bsrung sems gsod sems min/ / spyon pa bcas zhing min phyir gnang ba min/ / bcas 'dom chung ngor che ba gnang srid de/ / dbyar ral nyes byas spang phyir nub lhag gnang / / bcas mnyam de 'brel dgag dgos gang che gtso/ / bsgrub mi nus pas zhugs kyang ltung med ni/ /mtha' 'khob bcu ma tshang par bsnyen rdzogs rung / / bag yangs dang 'brel ltung med rnam gnyis te/ / bag yangs kha 'thor dang 'brel srab rkyang tshe/'chang sogs bcu la ltung ba med pa dang / / bag yangs chen por 'brel ba phran tshogs las/ / phra mo phran tshegs dag la skabs dbye gsungs/ /dogs mtha' bzung na gzhis bsdus nyes byas tsam/ / yangs mtha' spang ltung man no gsol bzhis ster/ / re re tsam las mnyam du kun ster rtsing / / yod smra ma gtogs gzhan gyis tshul 'di bkag / 'dir 'phros bslab bya'i dbye ba sgom po gnyis/ / brgyud pa rgyud 'gror mthun pa'i bslab bya ni/ / ma bsrung nyin mo glos phab mi gnyid gsungs/ / sbyor ba rjes sgrub mthun pa'i bslab bya ni/ / ka ba la yang brdeg par mi bya gsungs/ /dgag bya nyes dmigs mthun pa'i bslab bya ni/ / me reg skabs su seng ger mi reg gsungs/ / sde lnga kun kyang sbom po'i sgras bstan te/ / pham lhag nyes pa che phyir sbom po dang / / gzhan ni dman phyir dman pa sbom por bshad/ / ming du 'chags pa'i sbom po sbom po dngos/ / yon tan sgra yi sbom po btags pa ste/ / gru na ya ni du ma la 'jug pas/ / nyes byas du ma bsdus pa'ang sbom por bshad/ / 'di ni rab byung sde lnga kun la yod/ /sbom po rnam bzhi dngos gzhi mi rdzogs pa'i/ / sbyor ba sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i sbom po dang / / rku ba dzogs par nges pa'i spyor sbom dang / / gsod min lag gcod dngos gzhi'i rnam pa'i sbom/ / lha dgra bcom bsad dngos 29

/ /gzhi'i sbom po'o/ / sbom po bzhir phye yig char shin tu bsngags/ / gsod pa'i gleng gzhi dge slong mang po ste/ / ri dwags bzlog ni phyi ba'i dge sbyong phyir/ / gleng gzhir 'dod pa mi legs zhing min phyir/ / dge slong bcu yis rim bzhin 'chi res mtshon/ / bsnun la ltung ba gang 'byung rtsod pa mang / / dmigs bsal ma gtogs skra can mi 'tshod la/ / gsod sar mi 'bul gra dag pa la rung / / rdzun gye gleng gzhi nya ba lnga brgya ste/ / mi min ma ning la smras sbom po ste/ / dud 'gror nyes byas mi la nor yang pham/ / mi'i chos myang 'das bla mgong ma'i sems/ / mi'i chos sgrib lnga bla ma de spang pa'o/gso ba dge 'dun la reg lhag ma las/ / reg pa'i skabs su byed po bud med gsungs/ / de ni reg dang 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur bsngags/ / nyal shom 'dug bgreng dben par 'dug 'greng dang / / lhan cig nyal dang lam 'gro chos ston bcu/ / bsdus kyang gnyis tshogs las ni spyan ma bsdus/ /'khrur 'jug la sogs na bsdus rgyu mtshan dpyad/ / khrims grogs lkug min glen min dmus long min/ / spyo min 'gro ba gzhan min mtshan gnyis min/khru brgyad phyed dang bcas bas nub lhag kheb/ / phal cher yol bas nub lhag chod par smra/ / khang pa khang chen gyi mi khyad par gsum/ / khang pa dkon mchog las gzhan don phyir dang / / khang chen tshogs sam sangs rgyas la sogs pa/ / dkon mchog yin na gcig gi phyir yang rung / / khang bar sa gzhi btsal dgos gzhan la min/ / khang tshad lhag dgos khang chen nges bzung med/ / che ba sbyin chen yin gyi tshad chen min/ / gcig dang tshogs gsungs dkon mchog ma yin pa'i/ / dbang byas khyim pa gzhir byas khang chen no/ / yon tan 'od dang chos bshes lkug pa la/ / skur ba gdab pa sbom por zhu bas bsgrubs/ / dge legs bshes gnyen lung de lhag par 30

༄/ /'du dka'aganagararabasdusanoraba'iphrengab/'dod/ / dbang po med par log spyod sbom po'i phyir/ / des skur sbom por gsungs kyang nyes byas lo/ / dge 'dun des bskos pa yis bzham bsgo byas/ / de dang gsol dang brjod pa snga gnyis mthar/ / sbom po re re gsum pa'i phyir gcig ste/ / bsgo gyur sbyor sbom lnga dang dngos gzhi bcas/ / bskyed par rnam 'byed drangs nas mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ / yig char brjod pa gsum par dngos gzhi las/ / zur pa med phyir bsgo gyur ltung lngar gsungs/ / bzham sgor nyes byas gsungs pa sde gzhan yin/ /dbyen byed lhag mar kha skong 'os mi dgos/ / 'khor lo'i dbyen gyi lhag ma mi srid kyang / /dbyen gye lhag mar mtshams med yod par gsungs/ /sbang ltung la ni thun mong mdo bcu bdun/ / zhu ba lam bsdus las la 'das na dang / / rang bzhin las nyams yang ngo zhes pa gnyis/ / de steng phyir bcos dang 'brel gsum yang ste/ / chung nyid dge 'dun gye dang med gtso gsum/ /ko lpags gzhi las spang ba la ni dang / de ni bsngos pa nyid na bral nyid gnyis/ / lhag bcu rnam 'byed bsdus par mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ /yig char ko lbags kyi lang rnam 'byed byas/ / de yang dus dang 'brel ba'i thun mong ba/ / bdag po dang 'brel shan dang phyir bcos dang / / sbang ba dang po gsum 'brel thun mong ngo / / de la dus 'brel ltung ba bcu dgu ste/ / 'chang gnyis 'jog gnyis 'phyis gnyis 'bral gnyis 'chab/ / nub lhag bung med dmag nang snang bcas nyal/ / spang ba rjes phyogs bsnyil dang lhan cig nyal/ / dngos bstan bco lnga'o rjes phyogs nang tshan yin/ / shugs bstan sngas gnyis 'chab pham reg ltung ste/ /phyi ma reg pa dang bcas nyal ba'o/ / de las zla 'jog ras chen bzhag 'phyis dang / / 'chang dang sman dang dgon bral nub lhag la/ /31

da / / sa stelasum cu bco lnga bcu bdun drug gsum mtha'i/ / skad cig dgos phyir rtsa bar nyin mtshan gyi/ / dang po min pa'am mthar skye de dag la/ / tha ma ma gtogs sbyor ltung med par gsungs/ / dus 'brel gzhan pa nyal lnga dmag nang gnas/ / 'chab pa bdun no sbyor ltung snod yang yin/ / nub lhag gong du sbyor ltung med pa la/ / bgrang yang nyal lnga'i grangs phyir 'dir bgrang gtso/ / gnang la tshang bzung ltung ba min phyir ro/ / las la 'das na nyi ma shar ba'i zhes/ / gso sbyong dgag dbyer lung las dngos su gsungs/ / dbyar gyi spyor chog sogs la mdor bsdus sbyar/ / spang ltung bco brgyad mi 'byung thabs gsum ste/ / bsdos ngang gzhan phyir bsrel dang rnam brtag go / rnam brtag cho ga lhag por cho ga'o/ / ltung nge yod na gzhan la shan 'byung yang / / dmigs bsal zhag bdun sman shan nang phan tshun/ / mar gyis mar dang hwags kyis hwags kho na/ / rdeg byed de yis rang gi brdeg bya la/ / nyes zhugs cha bzhag shugs de shan gyi don/ / shan shugs rjes zhugs rgyun 'brel rnam grangs so/ / gos dang lhung bzed sman dang ltung shan bzhi/ / dang por zhag bcu zla 'jog go lnga bsdus na/ / ltung gzhi rdzas shan spangs rgyu ltung shan no/ / rdzas shan rdzas su gsungs pa gzhi la dgongs/ zhag bcu pa yi bcu ba zla 'jog gi / zla 'jog shan ltung 'byung pa yang gzhan la/ / gzhan yang spang dgos gsungs kyang sbang ltung med/de phyir spang shan ltung shan mi 'dra'o/ / gang zag khyad par can gyi spang ltung yang / / bshags tshe dngos po de spang mi dgos la/ / tshogs kyi yin na chos gos dang bral kyang / / mi spong ngo mtsho ṭīka ltung byed 'bab zhig gsungs/ / khor yug khru gang med na spang mi dgos/ / zhes khru med kyang chos gos byen rlabs ni/ / 'chags na de yis 'bral spang mi bskyed dam/32

༄/ /khrugorgyamatshojagagagasangarabasduthosatsacob/zhag shan zur du 'dren yang zur du med/ / gos lhung sman shan gsum la khyad par can/ /yin min gnyis gnyis byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i/ / ma brlabs la zhugs khyad min ma brlabs pa'i/ / brlabs la zhugs pa byas par tsam yin te/ / phyi mar mnyam dang mi mnyam 'dren tshul gnyis/ /tshes gcig gos gnyis rnyed pas gcig byin rlabs/ / gcig shos bzhag na bcugacig skya rengs tshe/phyi mar rang stobs snga mar shan stobs so/ / tshes gcig gos rnyed tshes lngara'ang de mtshungs rnyed/ /drug la snga ma brlabs kyang phyi ma ni/ / ma brlabs bzhag na bcu gcig skya rengs mtshe/ / shan dang rang stobs sdom pa'i sngar ltung 'byung / / gsungs phyir gzhag rera'ang nyes pa yod dam dpyad/ / yod na gnang la tshad bzung min par 'gyur/ /mtshan mthab skya rengs la 'dod mtsho ṭīka bkag / bcas pa'i nyin dus yin yang spyir ni min/ / lhung bzed shan la khyad can yin min gnyis/ /zhag bdun nad las 'tsho bcing de dang 'dra/ / thun tshod la ni khyad par can min med/ /nyin gcig kho nar rlabs phyir mnyam du 'byung / / sman shan 'byung ba brdeg bya rdeg byed gnyis/ / gang la'ang byen rlabs med na mi rung phyir/ / rdeg byed brlabs pas brdeg bya byin rlabs dang / / ma brlabs la 'jug rim bzhin no mtsho ṭīka bzlog// bdag 'brel ltung ba bco brgyad mtsho ṭīka las/ / 'chang 'jog 'khrur 'jug bcu tshan bar pa dang /snod 'chang 'thag 'jug ras chen brtad dang mtha'o/ / zhes gsungs kha cig gzhan gyis mi spang phyir/ /'bral spang la yang rang gi dgos so lo/ /gang zag khyad par can gyi spang ltung dang / / snyim pa bcing grol spang ltung med par 'gyur/ /de yi sel ba gsum ste gzhan gyi la/ / gzhan gyir shes dang rang gzhan nor pa'o/ / gzhan la gzhan gyir shes na cir 'gyur ni/33

/ /'chang gnyis zla 'jog 'phyis gnyis ltung med dang / / rin chen reg la 'ba' zhig ltung gzhan 'gyur/ / lhag ma bcu gnyis rang rang na smad do/rang la gzhan gyir 'khrul na lngar ltung med/ / rin chen long pa gzhir gtogs na smad do/ / bcu gnyis snga ma las kyang na smad de/ / don dang 'du shes phrad pa med phyir ro/ / gzhan la rang gir 'khrul na bdag 'brel gye/ / ltung ba bco brgyad kun lan smad do/ / rigs zlog mi zlog shan la mu bzhi ste/ / rigs log shan 'byung chos gos med pa zhig/ tshes gcig la ni zla 'jog gos rigs rnyed/ / tshes bcur chos gos rnyed na bcu gcig tshe/snga ma'i zla 'jog rigs lo gzhag bcu gos/ / de yi ltung shan chos gos phyi mar 'byung / / rigs log shan mi 'byung ba zla 'jog gos/ / snga dro rnyed pa'i phyi dro chos gos rnyed/ / de nas gzhan med bcu gcig skya rengs tshe/ /gnyis ga'i 'chang sbang rang stobs skyed phyir ro/ / zla 'jog gos rnyed phyis gzhan ma rnyed na/ / rigs mi ldog cing shan mi 'byung bar gsungs/ /'on kyang kha skong re chad rigs ldog srid/ / rigs mi ldog la shan 'byung zla 'jog gos/ / de rjes kha skong rnyed kyang ma rlabs na/ / zla gcig 'das tshe phyi mar shan 'byung ngo / / sra brkyang bting la 'chang sogs gsum med pa/kun btang ngo re re ba yang gding rung phyir/ / dmigs bsal sra brkyang bsrungs pa'i dge slong der/ / bting ba'i sra brkyang gis kyang spang ltung skyed/byin 'phrog pham med rang yin 'du shes lo/ / gzhan gyes byin pa 'phrog pa'ang ṭīkkar gsungs/ / chos min ston pa dbyen phyogs sbom po'i rdzun/ /pham lhag 'bras chan 'geb sogs nyes byas so/ / na smad kyis bskur skyon smras ltung skyed na/ / ltung byed kyis bskur nyes byas 'gal lo zer/ / ston pas de la lnga'am drug gsungs na/ / lnga yis skyed dam zhe na phung bo ni/ /34

sa / /'du gnadangarabasdus ra༄'cher galnga ste gzugs phung zhes sogs bshad pa na/ / mdor bstan rgyas bshad de las log min phyir/ /lnga'o zur du bgrang na drug yin zhing / / de las lhag pa mi rung don yin no/ / bshes ngor byed pa gos kyis bskyed yin na/ /mtshan mthun dgos dang rdzun du 'gal lo zer/ / byed dang byas zhes bskur bganyis ka yod/ / 'dir ni 'dul ba khyad gsod tshig yin la/ / dge slong rnam dag thung du dgos par gsungs/ / mngon pa'i ltung byed nyes byas ci rigs skyed/ / 'og gi khyad gsod bslab pa'i gzhi yin no/ / lag nya mtshams btsos zhag lon rjen bcos kyi/ / nyes byas bzhi dang za ba'i nyes byas bzhi/ / rung zhing brtan par ma 'brel sta gon gnas/ / chud za'i rkyen med byin len ma byas dang / / byin len stobs par ma 'brel sman bzhi yin/ /'du shes ma 'khrul rang ngam chog gcig pas/ / byin len ma byas za 'dod las gzhan pas/ / reg pa lag nya'o byin len ma byas par/ / za 'dod kyis na ltung byed spyor bar 'gyur/ / mtshams btsos rung khang min par sus btsos kyang / / zos bas dge 'dun la ni nyes byes skyed/ / sa bon 'joms pa'i ltung byed mi 'dra'o/ / zas kyi sta gon byas te rung khang las/ / gzhan par rkyen med zhag lon zhag lon skyed/ / lhag ma bsdom bsdus phal cher rtsa bar gsal/ / nyes byas so gsum lnga lnga bzhi tshan gnyis/gnas dang gso sbyong 'dom tshe gso spyong bsdad/ / bla ma'i drung 'gror yod bzhin mi 'gro dang / / gnas med gnas der skya rengs shar ba dang / /bla ma 'bod du yod bzhin mi 'bod dang / / gnas drung gso spyong byin rlabs ma byas te/ / gnas dang gso sbyong 'dom lnga rtsa ba las/ / gnas med gso sbyong bsdad par mi bya gsungs/ / snga phyi'i dbyar dang gnas med 'dom pa na/ / gso sbyor la 'dom bzhin du lnga lnga'o/ /de bzhin snga ma'i dbyar gyi zla 35

/ /gcig yan/ / phyi ma'i zla ba gnyis lhag song nas ni/ / gnas dang 'dom na sngar bzhin lnga lnga ste/ / zla gcig 'das na phyis su dbyar med cing / /zla gnyis ma song dbyar don mi 'grub phyir/ / de cho gnas dang 'dom kyang dbyar gtso'o/ / bzhi tshan dang po phyi ma'i zla gnyis dang / / gnas 'dom tshe na gnas brten nyes byas dang / / gnas drung bsdad de dbyar ral nyes byas dang / / bla ma 'bod du yod bzhin mi 'bod dang / / ma bos tho rengs gnas med nyes byas so/ / bzhi tshan gnyis pa snga ma'i zla lhag dang / / gnas 'dom tshe na snga ma bzhin du bzhi/ / kha cig phyi ma'i dbyar dang gnas 'dom tshe/ / dbyar bsrung ngo gzhan du lo der dbyar med phyir/ / zla ba snga gnyis bsrung dang mtshungs so lo/ / khas blangs zin na lo de'i dbyar gtso yang / / sngar ni gnas brten gtso phyir mi mtshungs so/ /gcig las 'apros par mkhan po bzhi gsungs te/ / chos dang zang zing gnyis gas sdud dang min/ / shes byas gnas dang bltas 'gro sdod dang 'gro/ /spyir bstan don la sbyi dang yan lag gnyis/ / rnam 'byed shan phyir rjes gsungs zhu ba bzhin/ / rang bzo ma yin mi la dud 'gro dang / /bkag pas bzang dang 'dra gsum rnam 'byed gsungs/ / yan lag thams cad dang blang rin 'phreng bshad/ / rdzu 'phrul chos can ma yin 'dul byed de/ / lhag ma re gcig zhu bar 'byung phyir ro/ / dgos pa gsum ste sprul min mdor bsdus rtogs/ / rdzun sogs sum cur mthar thug don go zhes/so sor sbyar ba 'dir bsdus tshig tshogs bskyungs/ / bslab tshig gcig pa rdzun sogs bcu tshan gnyis/ / ma gtogs pa la so sor dngos sbyar kyang /'dir bsdus nyi shu la yang mdor bsdus sbyar/ / de phyir tshig bskyungs 36

༄/ /'du dga'aganadamadorabasdusanoraba'iphrengab/mdor bsdus gnyis ka tshang / / mtsho ṭīka bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ma gtogs gsungs/ / mtha' dag phal cher zhar byung spyir bstan gsum/ / dang po dang po'o bslab byin 'dra nyid ces/ / gnyis pa'o kha skong min phyir 'dun bsgyur dang / / mi smra 'gro la ltung byed dngos gzhi med/ / bslab byin 'ba' zhig tshogs pa ma gtogs so/ / sha mis dbyen gyi lhag ma mi skyed zer/mtsho ṭīka dbyen chags pa la kha skong dgos/ / dbyen byed lhag ma skyed la mi dgos gsungs/ / dgra bcom med phyir dgra bcom bden smra med/ /bden smra tsam yod nyis brgya nga gsum la/ / rang bzhin kha na mtho yod gsungs phyir/ / zhar byung mgu spyad don med ga ga tshil/ / sen mo sogs dang reg bya nyid ma nyams/ / yang dag len byed de ni snod yin drug /yan lag don la rten sogs lngar bshad dang / / tshan tshan yan lag bye brag bshad pa gnyis/ / dang por rten gyi yan lag yul yan lag / ltung tha dad rgyu sel ba dang bcas dang / / bsam pa'i yan lag yan lag sel ba lnga/dang por bslab bsam tshigs mtshan yan lag bzhi/ / dang por dngos dang zhar byung dngos la yang / / nyams ma chags dang ma rdzogs bslab bya byen la/ / cir 'gyur gsum mo nyams pa dgag sgras bstan/ / ma chags na yang nyes skyed sgrub pa'i sgra/ / gang gis nyams na 'chab bcas pham pas ste/ / shes byed ṭīkkar zhu ba drangs pa las/ / sngar ltung byung dang rku thabs dang po 'khrug / ma ming ma sun byas la nyes byas gsungs/ / bye smras rang la ston pa'i ltung byed dang / / pham skyed gzhan la gzhi med lhag ma skyed/ /rang gral 'gro zhing 'bul rgyu yod pa'i phyir/ / 'char bcas pham pas sdom pa mi gtong na/ / mdo 'dis mtha' dag spyir bstan ga la yin/ / gsod pham byung bas srog gcod sder gtogs bcas/ / gang la zhugs kyang nyes 37

/byas la dgongs lo/ / ma rdzogs pa la blangs 'das phyogs mthun nyis/ /bar ma'i gsum steng dge tshul dngos blangs bcu/ / bcu gnyis bsnan pas nyer lnga dge slong ma/ / pri dza'i bu la bslab gsum bstan pa bzhin/ /bsdus kyang phye na so drug rgyas par na/ / blangs 'das nga brgyad bar ma'i nyams pa gsum/ / srog gcod brgyad dang ma byin len pa lnga/ / 'gro lngar mi tshangs spyod lnga rdzun smra la/ / pham 'dra gcig dang bshags bya'i rdzun bcu gnyis/ / 'bru dang bcos chang 'thung gnyis glu gar rol/ / phreng rgyan sbos dang kha dog phyugs te bdun/ / khri gnyis stan gnyis phyi dro'i bza' bca' gnyis/ / 'gro lnga'i rin chen bdag gir 'dzin pa lnga/ / lnga bcu nga lnga dge tshul dngos blangs 'das/ / mkhan po las blangs gsum ni dngos blangs min/ / dmyal bar las lam gsum las med gsungs dpyad/ /rdzun yang ngan song gsum lha lha min gyis/ / sngar ltar phye nang lnga'i grangs tshang lo/ / tsug tsug sogs bzhir mngar skyur dro grang gi / 'du shes bsgyur ba'i rdzun bzhi mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ rin chen spang ltung gzhi na rang gir bsgyur/ / pham 'dra bshags bya'i nyes byas min 'dod 'khrul/ / mtsho ṭīka bshags bya'i nyes byas so bdun gsungs/ / bsnyen par rdzogs las dbye phyir pham pa med/ / bran tsam shi bas dmag dpung pham min bzhin/glu gar man chad bsnyen bkur go rim bzhin/ / phyogs mthun rtogs phyir nyes med dang por bstan/ / de yang bye brag bshad mdzod las/ / 'chang ba dang ni 'bral ba dang / / de bzhin sa ni rko ba dang / / rin chen reg dang me la reg / btang nas za bar byed pa dang / / ljon shing 'dzeg dang shing gcod dang / / byen len ma byas za ba dang / / rtsa sdon mi gtsang 'dor ba dang / / de bzhin gsog 'jog za ba dang / / sa bon 'jom dang 38

༄/ /khru4brgyal dgagasastongarabasduyodarakhu'iphrengab/bslab pa'i gzhi/ / zla 'jog dgon pa'i 'bral ba dang / / gsog 'jog byed dang dge tshul nyal/ / mi smra 'gro dang bco brgyad do/ / 'chad par gos lhung gnyis so gzhan grangs bzhin/ / khyim par bkag phyir nub lhag phyed du bshad/ /de dang bco brgyad phye bar dge slong mar/ /shing gcod nyes byas sa bon 'jom pa la/ / ltung byed bcas phyir gnyis byas pha'i sdom la/ /de gnyis gcig phyir byed dang bcu bdun 'gyur/ / ma la shing drung bkag phyir 'bral lhung med/ / de phyir ltung med gnang ba'i ming yang med/shing gcod sdom bsdus min phyir dge slong ma'i/ / sdom gye dbang byas gnang ba phyed bcu drug / dge tshul ma la 'bral ltung ma gtogs pa/ /bcu bdun steng du chos gos byin rlabs gnyis/ / mi rdzogs rjen pa 'tshol dang nyer gcig go /srog chags med pa'i sa rko bya mang phyir/ /dge slong la bkag de bcas kun la bkag / de las dge slob ma la rin chen regabyen len gsog 'jog za dang mi gtsang 'dor/ / sa brkor blangs 'das 'byung zhing gsog 'jog la/ / phyogs mthun 'byung phyir lhag ma bco lnga gnang / /zhu bar 'chang 'bral nyes gsungs yi ge nor/ /rdzun dang srog gcod bcu bdun pham gzhan gnyis/ / phyi dro'i kha zas ma bsgyur gos dang chang / / blangs 'das nyer gnyis ltung med rnams dang bcas/ / sdom bsdus sum cu rtsa phyed dgu ma gtogs/ /nyis brgya byed dang bco lnga phyogs mthun no/ /bsdu na bzhi bcu ṭīka las/ / rtags dang slong dang snod dang ni/ /longs spyod 'phyar g.yeng 'dod pa dang / /gnod pa dang ni gnas pa dang / / ma gus mi sbyong gzhi las byung / / zhes gsungs blangs 'das bcu yi phyogs mthun te/ /khyim pa'i rtags mthun rnga bal skra breg nyes/ /rang don rin chen slong mthun bsod sbags pa/ /rin chen khab ral phyogs 39

/ /mthun pa so sogs/ / phyi dro'i zas dang char mthun sgog btsong sogs/ /gar sogs khri sogs phyogs mthun chu yi brtsen/ / khang chen mi tshangs spyod mthun 'khrig tshig sogs/ / srog gcod dbyen sogs rjes mthun brdeg gzas sogs/ / gnas dbyung gnas pa'i phyogs mthun khyim pa sogs/ /mkhan por ma gus phyogs mthun rgan pa sogs/ / gso sbyong min mthun dbyar gyi dam tshig 'dral/ / zhes 'byung blangs 'das bcu bo dpyad par 'os/ / tshad dbyibs mi rung cho ga ma byas pa'i/ / khang chen khyim pa'i rtags spong blangs 'das gsungs/ / dud 'gro gsod phyir de la dgongs zhes zer/ / 'dod pa'i gzhi las byung bar gsungs dang 'gal/ / mtha' dag nyams pa pham pa'i phyogs mthun dang / / rtags sogs so sor nyams pa'i phyogs mthun gnyis/ / bsam pa'i yan lag gsal ba dang bcas ni/'gro ba gzhan gyi rnam pa zhes sogs byung / / shes dang rang bzhin mi gnas gang zag la/ / sde lnga phal cher mi 'byung na smad skye/ / spyo 'khrug sbug gzir sprul tshe 'du shes med/ / shes pa rang bzhin mi gnas gtso bo bzhi/gnyid spyos snyoms 'jug brgyal ba phal pa ste/ / de tshe nyal dang khang ltung 'byung phyir ro/ / gtso bo bzhi la khang pa grub gyur na/ / yan lag gang zhig ma tshang dpyad bar bya/ / gsod bzhi rku dang pham lhag dang po ltar/ / bal khur skye 'joms ma gtogs phal cher la/ / sprul tshe 'du shes yod na dngos gzhi skye/ / yig cha'i gzhi stod mtsho ṭīka mthun ched tsam/ / tshigs kyi yan lag tshigs sngar zhes sogs byung / / sde lnga kun la bslab tshigs gcig pa dgos/ / 'bab tshe sdom sems med phyir pham 'dra skye/ / snga mar sbyor byas phyi mar na smad de/ / sdom sems 'phel bas gsod sems log phyir ro/ /bslab tshigs phyi mar slar yang sbyor byas na/ / pham pa skye yang bslab tshigs 40

༄/ /khrulabargyam da gagasangarabasayongakhu'iphres/snga ma nas/ / brtsams te sbyor ba'i sbyor yin pham pa'i min/ / pham lhag sbyor ba sgom por gsungs phyir ro/ / zhar byung dkon zhing rin ches bskyed pa ni/ / srin bal 'ba' zhig cha gnyis dang / / bal khur mel dang gser dngul reg / mngon tshan nyo tshong bsod pa slong / / khab ral las gyur bcu gcig go/ rin phreng las so khab ral rwa yi dpyad/ / rtsam pas bsod slong bskyed par mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ / mtshan gye yan lag spyi don gzhung don gnyis/ / dang por thun mong yin min dbye ba dang / / don dang phyi ma'i mtshan la cir 'gyur gsum/ / thun mong lad yang mtshan nyid ci 'dra dang / rjes mthun ming tsam gnyis so dang po ni/ / pham pa bzhi dang spyan dang gzhi med dang / / bag tsam 'chang ba dang ni 'jog pa dang / / slong la sogs pa lnga dang gser dngul dang / / mngon tshan nyo tshong lhung bzed tshol sogasagasum/ / rdzun dang 'don dang mi chos bden smra dang / / sa bon 'debs dang rim gnyis phyogs gcig dang / / 'dug gnas la sogs gsum dang dus min zas/ / byen len ma byas srog chags bcas spyod dang /gcer bu dmag gsum me regs ma rdzogs dang / / kha ma bsgyur dang long pa khrus byed dang / / dud 'gro rtse dang sbed dang gzhi med dang / / rkun ma rko dang mgron gnyer rang 'dug dang / / ma gus phyogs gcig chang 'thung dus min 'gro/ / phyi dro grong rgyu rgyal po'i pho brang 'jug / khab ral gding dang g.yan pa bde gshegs gos/ / nga bdun 'dul 'dzin gsungs so rin phreng las/ / bca' dang ma gus bsal bas lnga bcu lnga/ / mtsho ṭīke bden smra sbed dang gzhi med bsal/ / khyim sun shing gcod bsnan ma bsang drug byas/ / 'on kyang gnyis gnyis sprod dang phul dgu ba'i/ / che chung lhung bzed tshol sogs ji 'dra min/ / rjes mthun la gnyis mtshan mthun mtshan 41

/ /mi mthun/ / yan lag dgos pa'o dang po rin phreng las/ / bsgo gyur bzhi dang 'phrog pa dang / / bsngos bsgyur skyon dang phra ma dang / / skyo sngogs gnas ngan bshes ngo dang / / khyad gsod 'phya bsgo khri dang gding / / phyis gnon 'byung ba spangs pa stobs/ / 'dus za brdeg gzas gnas ngan len/bde dang 'dun pa chos dang smra/ / dge tshul 'gyod pa sor mo sdangs/ /nyer 'jog nyan rna ma smras 'gro / ma gus zas bcas da gdod khri/ /gdal dang seng ge las gyur te/ / de lta bzhi bcu tham pa'o/ / snga dro grong rgyu 'dir bgrang yang / / phyi dro mtshan nyid ji 'dra'o/ / ma gus 'dir bgrang phyogs gcig ste/ / gzhan du sdom tshigs snga mar 'gal/ / mtshan mi mthun dgos de nyid las/ / 'khrur 'jug pa dang len pa dang / / khyim pa mo la chos ston dang / / de dang lam 'gro bud med nyal/ / de ltar de ni lnga yin no/ / 'bral dang spangs pa za ba dang / / gsog 'jog phyed dang za babazhi/ / bsnan na bzhi bcu rtsa dgur 'gyur/ / pha ma'i thun mong min gnyis 'dul 'dzin gyis/ / 'byin pa nas ni bsnyen bkur bsngags pa'i bar/ / khang pa khang chen dang ni srin bal nas/ / rmel ba'i bar dang lhung bzed 'chang ba dang / / brtad pa las byung dgon pa'i 'bral ba dang / /ras chen skrod dang ma bskos la sogs bcu/ / yang yang za dang bsod pa slong pa dang / / nyal shoms la khyim la 'dug dang 'greng pa dang / / gding med spyod dang ma lon bsnyen par rdzogs/ / ras chen so sor bshags pa rnam pa gsum/ / pham pa thun mong ma yin rnam bzhi dang / / lhag ma thun mong ma yin bcu gsum dang / / spang ltung thun mong ma yin bcu bzhi dang /ltung byed thun mong ma yin brgya rtsa brgyad/ / so sor bshags pa bcu dang nyes byas gnyis/ / zhes gsungs thun mong min par 'gyur tshul yang / /42

༄/ /'du gnadararabasdusanoraba'icher gamatshan phyir lus phyir bsam pa'i bye brag phyir/ / lus ngag nyes spyod mi 'dra bcas pa'ang / yod med mi 'dra yon 'bral nyin mo 'bral/ / che chung mi 'dra reg pham 'byin ltung byed/ / mang nyung mi 'dra 'greng bzhi sprod pa gnyis/ / sde tshan ma bsgos 'dug dang mi gtsang 'dor/ / lhung bzed zhag gcig bcu mthar spang ltung 'byung / / nyi shu ma lon rdzogs pa'i ltung byed ni/ / ma la'ang srid phyir so so'i zhib cha dgos/ /ltung byed bco lnga pha la ltung med do/ /ltung mnyam thun mong mi mnyam thun mong min/ / snga ma'i dbye ba yul dang yan lag sbos/ / gsum pa phyi ma'i mtshan la cir 'gyur ni/mtshan nyid ci 'dra ba rnams yongs su rdzogs/ / mtshan lan gsum du gyur tshe ma gtogs so/ / rjes mthun mtshan mthun dgos dang reg pa sogs/che las chung gyur chung las cher mi 'gyur/ / mtshan mi mthun dgos thun mong min phal cher/ / yod pa med par 'gyur srid bzlog na min/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la mtshan gyur ni/ / lhung ba'i zhing ngam rten du spyir bstan te/ / dmigs bsal ma yis 'byin pa'i sbyor byas nas/ /gzhan la rdzogs tshe bcas pa ches gyur kyang / / na smad don gyi spyor ltung sor gnas las/ / 'byin lhag mi bskyed spyor ba'i dogs gcod do/ / reg pham dzogs byas ma yang mtshan gyur na/ / bcas pa chung 'gyur na smad de yin no/ / 'on gang du dpyad mtshan gyur rten de la/ / gang bcas lhung bar nges sam zhe na min/ /'byin pa'i ltung byed byung ba'i dge slong ma/ /phar gyur tshe yang lhag mar mi 'gyur te/ / chung las cher mi 'gyur zhes bshad zin cing / / na smad pa ni rang gi nyid gsungs phyir/ / dgu nas gyur na dgu po zhag gcig cha/ / 'khor mang nyer 'jog ldan pa phar gyur tshe/bcas pa'i zhing min phyir na gtan nyams 'gyur/ / gyur tshe 'byin pa'i 43

/ /lhag ma dag gsungs kyang / / slar yang gyur na spo mgu dbyung gsum dgos/reg pham slar ldog mi ldog dpyad bya'o/ / bcab yul mtshan mthun yin phyir gyur tshe nyams/ / mgu spyod tshe gyur snga ma don med pas/ / gzhi nas zla phyed dam zhag drug mgu ba spyod/ / kha cig thun mong ma yin lhag ma rnams/ /gyur tshe dag phyir mgu spyad don med kyang / / thun mong lhag mar sngar gyi zhag bgrang zer/ / rang lugs bcas pa'am cho ga 'gyur phyir ro/ / yul la bzhi las dang po 'das ma 'ongs/ / la brten dogs pa bcad nas da lta'i lus/ / ltung ba'i yan lag ston par de'i tshe lus/ / zhes gsungs skyes par reg pa'i sbyor byas mthar/ / gyur na mo nyid lhag ma'i byed po yin/ /dmigs bsal mtshan med mngal la spyan byed dang / / khang chen rmang btsugs tshe na srog chags bsad/ / mtha' la srog chags med kyang lhag ma bskyed/ / dang po rtsod bcas gzhir brtsigs mthar zhi yang / / gnyis pa skye gnas gzhan brten dogs bcad nas/ / rang 'gror gtogs pa byed por ston pa ni/ / khrung khrung las skyes gnas brtan grags dang ni/ / nye grags lta bu'ang bsad na pham par 'gyur/ / mis bskyed mi min dud 'gro 'ang rang rang gi/ / 'gro ba yin phyir sbom po ltung byed rten/ / 'di mi mtshungs pa zad par 'byung bzhin sbyar/ / gsum pa dbyibs dang mdog brten dogs bcad nas/ / shes rgyud gar gtogs byed por ston pa ni/mi sbrul dud 'gro dud 'gror 'du shes kyang / / sbyor bar nyes byas bsad na pham pa skye/ / lhas sbyin bsams pas mchod sbyin bsad la min/ / rgyud tha dad phyir 'dir ni rgyud gcig pa'i/ / cha la ma 'khrul de nyid ngos bzung phyir/ / dgra bcom 'du shes med kyang pha bsad na/ / de dang gcig phyir mtshams med gnyis 'byung bzhin/ / 'dir drangs mdzod 'grel rin phreng 44

༄/ /'dul rgya gsagayorabasduganoraba'iphrengagaṭīkka mthun/ / gal te dngos gzhi pham na spyor sbom 'gyur/ / ma nges sbyor med brku pham 'di nyid las/ / spyor la de med de ma byas nyid min/ / zhes so mtsho ṭīka las ni ṭīkka bkag / mtshams med sgo gnyis nas ni spyos so gsungs/ / bzhi ba yon tan cha la dogs bcad nas/ / 'phen pa gcig bsdus byed por ston pa ni/ / gnas skabs gzhan thob pa ni gzhan min gsungs/ / bsnun 'og dgra bcom min gsungs dang mi 'gal/ / ltung tha dad rgyu sel ba dang bcas la/ / dngos dang zhar byung gnyis so dngos la yang / / bslab rgyun tha dad la brten ltung tha dad/ / kun slong gi rgyun tha dad bcas pa'i rigs/ / tha dad kun slong rnam pa tha dad dang / / 'bras bu tha dad la brten ltung tha dad/ / dang po nyes de med la 'ong tha dad/ /zhes so sbyor dngos bar du nyes pa de'i/ / bcas med khyim pas chod na sbyor dngosakyi/ / na smad tha dad skye'o stan gyis mtshon/ / gnyis pa ston par btang ba yang ngo gsungs/ / khang chen rtsigs 'phror 'dun log slar yang 'phro/ / bsgrub na sngar bzhin na smad tha dad skye/ / gsum pa gcig la du ma bcas sogs gsungs/ / du ma cig char 'byung tshul zhu ba las/ / dge slong skad cig spyad pas ltung ba bzhir/ / 'gyur ba mchis sam u ba li yod de/ / byin len ma byas mi rung gsog 'jog tu/ / bzhag par gyur pa dus min za ba'o/ / zhes gsungs rin phreng ldog chas phye bar gsungs/ / bzhi ba la gnyis kun slong tha dad kyi/ / dbye ba dngos dang dmigs bsal mtshon dper bcas/ / dang po de yi cha ni der gtogs gsungs/ / mtsho ṭīka cha can mi tshangs spyod kyi cha/ / 'byin sogs cha der gtogs zhes che can du/ / gtogs pa 'gog ched gsungs pa ṭīkka las/ lhag ma bshad dang mi zlos mdo 'di yis/ / 'byin sems kyis phyung pham pa'i sbyor sbom du/45
