/ha cang thal pa sel phyir gsungs dang mthun/ / rin phreng cha la gnyis te cha shas dang / / char gtogs so 'byin sogs phyi mar bshad pa yi/ / der 'dus spyor sbom lta bu cha shas kyi/ / ltung ba yin pa gcod gsungs gnad gcig go / rgyu mtshan de gnyis kun slong gzhan phyir ro/ / dmigs bsal phyungs pa thams cad la sogs gsungs/ / rma sgo gsum la 'byin pa'i bsam pa yis/ / phyungs kyang mthar 'gyur gzhan kun lhag ma ste/ / mi tshangs spyod 'dod kyis na sbom por 'gyur/ / lnga pa bya ba du ma'i 'bras sogs gsungs/ / nyung du brkus pa bsdom kyang pham pa min/ / sel ba phyed byas la phyed phyed sogs gsungs/ / khang ba khang chen 'khrur 'jug dang / /srin bal 'ba' zhig cha gnyis dang / / drug dang bal chel tha ga gnyis/ /rim lhag bzo byed khab ral bdun/ / bcu dgu rin 'phreng gsungs so skur 'debs skabs/ / pham pa'i lhag ma lhag ma'i ltung byed ltar/ / ltung byed kyis skur nyes byas yin te 'dir/ / na smad dag gi cha ni na smad gsungs/ / bsam pa'i yan lag sel ba dang bcas la bsam pa'i yan lag dang ni zhar byung gnyis/ / dang por dngos dang ha cang thal spang gnyis/ / dang po thams cad ze tshom zhes gsungs sogs/ / dngos gzhi bskyed la yul nges mi dgos te/ / mi'am dud 'gro yin yang gsod snyam na/kun slong spyi zhugs yod phyir pham sogs 'byung / / dud 'gror mi'o snyam na sbyorab la/ / pham pa'i sbom po 'byung zhing mi dud 'gror/ / 'khrul sbyor nyes byas skye ste sbyor ba la/ / 'du shes yan lag phyir ro dngos gzhi la/ /don nyid yan lag phyir na gang bsad pa/ / bsam pa de nyid yin gsungs rgyud gzhan min/ /gnyis pa ha cang thal ba spang ba ni/ / mi tshangs spyod dang khu ba zhes 46

༄/ /247ma jagagagangar༄'aratsoglob/sogs gsungs/ /ltung ba kun la don dang 'du shes phrad/ / dgos na ha cang thal te 'khrig 'byin la/ / reg bya gtso phyir yul ni nor kyang skye/ /don go gtso phyir smra yul nor yang rdzun/ / rdzogs 'gyur 'di ni 'od ldan rtsa bar yang / /'khrig pa la ni 'du shes gtsor bya min/ / zhes gsungs 'du shes gtso ba'i don la yang / / ma 'khrul nges bzung mi 'thad 'khrul ma 'khrul/ /gang rung nges bzung min te byen phrog la/ /gnyis ka tshang phyir gsod sogs sbyor dngos la/ / don mi gtso la don mi dgos pa min/ /zhar byung yan lag thams cad dang blang gsungs/ / lnga pa yan lag sel bston pa la/ / 'og ma dag la gzhan lan smad gsungs/ / 'og nas 'chad 'gyur yan lag tshang ba las/ / gzhan 'gyur ma tshang ba lan smad de/de yang yan lag bco brgyad mtsho ṭīka las/ /rdzu 'phrul can min ma nyams lus dngos dang / / tha snyad yan lag lnga dang khyim pa dang / /bsnyen rdzogs rnam dag mtshan dang lta ba mthun/ / rung ba tshad ldan rang don rang nyid kyi/bdag dang 'brel ba dag tu smras pa ste/ / 'og nas ston pa yan lag bco brgyad do/ / zhes gsungs nyams pas reg lan smad skye/ / yul yang nyams na du ma ma tshang phyir/ / de bas na smad nyes byas tsam zhig skyed/ /yan lag gcig tsam ma tshang ba yis kyang / / de bas na smad 'byung srid mis bskyed rnams/ /blun phyir dud 'gror rten 'byung reg pa bzhin/ / bstan bcos las bshad dud 'gro mi min gtogs/ / ltung med 'gyur dang ltung gzhan 'gyur sogs mang / /tshan tshan yan lag bye brag bshad pa la/ / gzhi'i yan lag bsam pa'i yan lag dang / / spyor ba mthar thug gi ni yan lag gsum/ / dang por sems can yin min las gyur gnyis/ / dang por mtshan mi mthun pa las 47

/ /gyur dang / / tha snyad las gyur khyim dang rab byung las/ / gyur pa bzhi'o dang por dngos zhar byung / / dngos ni rdzu 'phrul chos can zhes sogs gsungs/ / rdzu 'phrul can las pham lhag gsum ma gtogs/ / chags pa dgag byar byas pa'i ltung ba rnams/ / dngos med bya bzhin mngon zhen mi rdzogs phyir/ / bya 'dul rdzu 'phrul ston bzhin pa la bshad/ / sha mi thob la bshad pa ṭīkkar mthun/ / bud med la bsten nyer bzhi rin phreng las/ /reg pa 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur spyan/ / 'khu len bal rmel chos ston dang /ma bskos sogs dang nyal shom gnyes/ / nyal 'gro sor bshags dang po gnyis/ / zhes gsungs 'on kyang mtsho ṭīka las/ / ma bskos ston pa'i bcu tshan las/ / skur 'debs ma gtogs dgu dag dang / / zhes gsungs bslab bya chen mor yang / / skur 'debs yul la dge slong chos/ / brgyad ldan dgos par gsungs so lo/ / zas cung phyir ston mi bgrang na/ / bcu tshan de ni pha'i thun mong / / ma yin ltung bar mi 'gyur zhing / / zas cung ston pas ltung med 'gyur/ / zhar byung reg bya ma nyams zhes sogs gsungs/ / rnam par bsdos brnag 'bus gzhig pham pa mo /zos dmar 'thor 'tshigs rus pa la sogs nyams/ / gnyis pa dngos dang sel ba reg de dang / / 'drar bstan gsum mo mi yi 'gro ba pa/ / sogs gsungs tha snyad spyis bar bskyed bcu gnyis ni/ / spyan gyis skrad bya'i bdag po dang / / khang pa'i brtsal bya khang chen ched/ / mi chos bla ma skur 'debs gsum/ / khyim sun shes bzhin bshes ngo dang / / zas cung sdig lta brjod pa yi/ / go bya'i yul phyir bcu gnyis so/ / ma rdzogs pa spyis bskyed pa ni/'don dang gnas ngan len dang chos/ / nub lhag ma lon pa dang lnga/ /bud med spyi yis bskyed pa ni/ / 'dzin pa 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur baspyan/48

༄/ /'dulab gnagararabasdusarnaraba'iphrengagadaben par 'dug dang nyal dang drug / khyim pas bskyed pa so lnga dang /rku gsod lnga po ma gtogs pa/ / bcol rdzogs pho nya rnams zhes gsungs/bud med spyis bskyed khyim pa pho dang mo/ / kho nas bskyed pa rnams la mtshan gnyis ba/ /don byed nus pa yan lag nyid du rung / / zhar byung reg pa tha snyad 'dra gsungs kyang / / shes pa mi gnas phal bzhi lkugs pa dang / /don mi go la reg pa'i lhag ma 'byung / /der yang mi yin dgos la shes rang bzhin/ / gnas pa'i phyed phyir tha snyad phyed gnyis bskyed/ / de dag rdzun smras tha snyad yul ma yin/ / de gnyis smra shes don go ma ning min/ / tha snyad lnga'o khyim pas bskyed pa rnams/ / mtshan don mthun phyir ma ning min par grub/ / de phyir lnga ldan yin yang bzhi ldan zer/ / rab byung gis bskyed3mas ni gsum ldan te/ / mir yang grub phyir ro mtshan gnyis don yod dang / / ma ning nyid gyur rab byung yod pas dpyad/ / tha snyad khyab pa mtsho ṭīka las/ / rku dang srog gcod ma gtogs pa/ /mi yin des bzung kun la sbyar/ / bcol yang dzogs pa sum cu gnyis/ / rku dang srog gcod bzhi bkol ba'i/ / lhag ma nyi shu bdun la sbyar/ / zhes gsungs don ni btsal bar bya/ /khyim pa las gyur phyi ba'i rab byung pa/ / sogs gsungs khyim pa pha yis bskyed pa ni/ /nyal shom gnyis dang dmag gsum dang / /rkun ma dang 'gro drug yin no/ / khyim pa mo yis bskyed pa ni/ / chos ston pa dang nyal shom gnyis/ /lam du bgro dang rnam pa bzhi/ / gang yang rung bas bskyed pa ni/ /khyim sun 'byin dang slong sogs lnga/ / mngon tshan nyo tshong lhung bzed tshol/ / 'thag gnyis ras chen bdag gir byed/ / sbyor bcug yang yang za ba dang / / 'dug gnas phye dang bsod pa dang / /zan gcod mgron gnyer ma smras 'gro/ /grong rgyu pho brang 'jug pa dang / /49

/ /sor bshags bzhi ste nyi shu bdun/ / nyal shom gnyis gnyis sdom pas sum cu lnga/ / bsngos bsgyur 'dul 'dzin gsungs yang ba ma lngar/ / min yang dge slong ma las zas len 'dir bgrang ba/ / gnas kyi cha nas yin zhes mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ / phyi ba nyams ma skyes dang dge tshul gnyis/ / dge slongam ste rtags can drug po las/ / khyim pas bskyed pa rnams ni na smad gyur/ / ma rdzogs sbyis bskyed bslab byin gyis kyang bskyed/ / mtsho ṭīka lnga gsungs ma lon dpyad par bya/ / dge slong pha yis bskyed pa ni/ / mtshan mthun dgos pa bzhi bcu'i steng / / skrod pa zas cung gdengs ma lo na/ /gral rim nags brtags bzhi bcu drug / dge slong ma yis bskyed pa ni/ / 'khru dang len dang rmel ba dang / / ma bskos sogs dgu 'dug ma gtogs/ / so sor bshags pa dang po gnyis/ / de ltar da ni bcu bzhi'o/ rdzogs pa sbyis bskyed skur 'debs gsum/ / rab byung spyis bskyed rnam gnyis te/ / sbed dang ma smras grong rgyu ba'o/ / dge tshul spyis bskyed bsnyil ba'o/ / de ltar 'di ba'i bskyed pa lnga/ / mu stegs can gyis bskyed pa gnyis/ / 'dug gnas dang ni gcer bu'o/ / rin phreng las so lta ba mthun pa'i don/ / gzhi des pham sogs bskyed par 'dod mtshungs so/ /bye mdos bdag dang bdag med lta sogs min/ / mtsho ṭīka 'thad dang mi 'thad tshul gnyis bshad/ / sdig lta spangs bsnyil gsum la lta mi mthun/sel bar mi 'gyur de nyid yan lag phyir/ / lta la'ang rtsod pa 'byung phyir nyan rna yang / / gnyis pa sems can min las gyur pa gsum/ / shed kyis bskyed pa so drug mtsho ṭīka las/ / spang ltung bcu tshan dang po dang / / srin bal 'bab zhig cha gnyis dang / / drug dang mtho gang lam dang ni/ / rmel bdang ni tha ga gnyis/ / byin 'phrog ston zla tha chung dang / / dgon pa 50

sa / /'du' margya sa dros sherardo reche tsagabar dang ras chen dang / / bsngos bsgyur bshes ngo gnas mal dang / /gos gnyis kha bsgyur sbed dang gdengs/ / bdal la sogs pa tha ma lnga/ /gsungs so 'on kyang rin phreng las/ / 'phrog pa sbed pa yo byad tsam/ /yin la khri nas khri las kyang / / zhes gsungs lhung bzed khab ral gsum/snod spyad las sor ni 'phreng las/ / zas la brten pa nyer gcig ste/ /gsog 'jog sbyor bcu g.yang yang sogs/ / gcer bu bde dang mgron gnyer dang / /chang dang zas bcas sor bshags bzhi/ / gos rgyu bdun po kho dog dur sprig dang / / dmar sngon dkar nag lnga'o sum brgya bar/ /mtshal dang de bzhin rgya skyegs btsod rnams dang / / gur gum dag dang thang shing li khri dang / / smra shing leb rgan gyi rnams mi rung ste/ / brgyad bo tshon chen yin bas bkag phyir ro/ / rang tshad kyis bskyed rin phreng las/ / 'bral ba 'khrur 'jug slong sogs bzhi/ / srin bal la sogs rnam pa drug / dgon pa ras chen khri gos byed/ / sped dang gdengs med bdal sogs lnga/ / de lta nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ / zhes gsungs 'dul 'dzin bcu dgur gsungs/ / spyi tshad kyis bskyed 'dul 'dzin gyis/ / 'chang ba 'jog pa len pa dang / / slong dang slong bar rigs pa dang / / sbags dang so sor sbags pa dang / / bskur dang bal rmel tha ga gnyis/ /byin 'phrog brdung byung bsngos bsgyur dang / / bshes ngor byed dang gos byen dang / /kha ma bsgyur te bcu bdun no/ / snga mar rang tshad 'dir mchu zheng / /gnyis gar khru gang longs pas chog / bsam pa'i yan lag rang gi don/gtso cher yod gsungs rin phreng las/ / bla ma 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur dang / / 'bral ba gnyis dang byin 'phrog dang / / brtad pa ma gtogs nyi shu drug / bla ma 'phya ba sbyor bcug dang / / yang yang 'dug gnas phyed 51

/ /dang ni/ / bsod ma me dang mgron gnyer dang / / khab ral bdal ba sogs pa lnga/ / sor bshags bzhi ste bzhi bcu brgyad/ / mtsho ṭīka bzhi bcu rtsa drug gsungs/ / 'chang gnyis zla 'jog ras chen rnams/ / gzhan phyirayin na ltung med 'gyur/ / spyor pa mthar thug yan lag la/ / thun mong dogs gcod zhar byung dang / / sbyor ba bye brag bshad pa gsum/ /dang po rnam rig don go gsungs/ / mthar thug don go dgos pa ni/ / bla ma 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur dang / / gzhi med bag tsam shes bzhin bcu/'phya ba bsgo ba phyis gnon dang / / ma skos nyi nub zas cung dang / /stobs pa bde dang 'dun pa smra/ / dge tshul 'aspyod pa sdangs byed dang / /gzhi med bslab pa nyan rna dang / / ma gus da gdod sum cu gsum/ / rang ngagako nas byed pa ni/ / de las phyis gnod spangs pa gnyis/ / sdangs byed nyan rna ma gus ba/ / ma gtogs nyi shu rtsa bdun dang / / bsgo gyur bzhi dang 'khru ba nas/ / so so'i bar drug rmel ba dang / / mngon tshan nyo tshong lhung bzed tshol/ / ras chen tshol dang sdig lta dang / / ma lon pa ste bzhibacu bzhi/ / lus ngag gang rung byed pa can/ / bskur ba brtad pa bsngos bsgyur dang / / phyis gnon gos ster bshams dkrug dang / /spangs pa gsum dang ma gus pa'o/ / lus ngag gnyis ka dgos pa ni/ / de gsum bsod slong zas len pa'o/ / gzhan la bcol yang rdzogs pa ni/ /rku dang gsod pa bzhi dang spyan/ / khang ba khang chen srin bal dang / /'ba' zhig cha gnyis drug dang gser/ / thag gnyis byin 'phrog sa bon skrod/rim lhag me reg rin chen reg / chu dang sdangs byed sbed pa dang / / sa rko khab ral la sogs bdun/ / sum cu gnyis te khri gding gi / 'ding ba sor bshags mtha' gsum gyis/ / zas len bcol yang 'grub pa yin/ /52

sa / /'du gsaganadamadorab sanorabla'icher garin phreng las so gsod rku las/ / gzhan la smra po ma yin par/ / yod pa'i rnam rig yan lag min/ / zhar byung yang dag len byed gsungs/ / sdom pa len pa smra ba bor/ / ma zad lkug par yod pa yi/ / don go ba yang yan lag 'gyur/ / dbus pa'i skad kyis mtha' ba bsgrub/ / smra bos don go mthol bshags snod/ / sbyor ba bye brag bshad pa ni/ ngag rang bdag 'brel gsum dngos bstan/ / gsal la mngon sum ma nor gsum/ /bsnan pas lnga'am drug ldan dgos/ / gzhan yang nye du min dgos pa/ /nyer dgu rang lus dgos zhe dgu/ / gang zag gis bskyed rjes phyogs dang /bka' blo mi bde byin phrogs sogs/ / so gcig dge 'dun gyis bskyed ba/khang chen phyogs gcig bka' blo dang / / skyo sngogs bshes ngor byed pa sogs/ / bcu drug spyod lam bzhi shong gnas/ / dgos pa khang pa khang chen dang / / skrod gding phyis gnon sogs bcu drug / dog par nub lhag mi bskyed pa/ / 'byung ring phyir yin dgag bya che/ / khyim pa mtshan ldan tha snyad lnga/ / lus tha mal gnas nor tha dad/ / nye du ma yin ma bslang bar/ / mi ster khyim pa chos drug ldan/ / mtshan mtha' dgos pa bco lnga dang / / las dang 'brel ba'i dge 'dun gyis/ / bskyed pa bsgo gyurabazhi khyad gsod/ / 'phya bsgo sdig lta bco lnga'o/ / bsgo gyur bcu ni 'dul 'dzin pas/ / dbyin dang de rjes phyogs dang khyim sun 'byin/ /bka' blo mi bde sdig lta mi gtong dang / / bzlog pham dang ni dkon mchog gtong ba dang / / bde zhing gnas dang gnas su 'jug pa dang / / 'thab krol byed dang grangs ni rnam pa bcu/ / zhes gsungs gzhan rnams dang po las gyur ro/ / ma thob thob bar byed pa rab byung gzhi/ / mi nyams srung byed yongs sbyong gzhi gsum dang / / bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen bsten gzhi 53

/ /lnga'o/ / nyams na 'chos byed phyir bcos gzhi bdun te/ / las kyi gzhi ni gsum ga'i khongs su 'dus/ / las phyes gzhi ni ko'u sham bhi dang / /yangs can las tha dad phyir ko shasti/ / phyir bcos dmar ser can la nan tur sgos/ / byed du bcug phyir dmar ser can zhes btags/ / dus dang dus min bsdus pa gang zag 'dis/ / 'di tsam bcab grangs shes dgos phyir gang zag / sa gzhan gnas pa'i sbom gu spyod pa las/ /phyogs gcig ming gis sbo ba'i gzhi zhes btags/ / yongs spyong 'ang gso sbyong bzhag zhes phyogs gcig go / rab byung gzhi la gnyis te bco brgyad gzhi/ / sra brkyang gong du drangs pa 'jug rim phyir/ / gos gzhi gong drangs gos gsum rigs mthun phyir/ / sdom bzhin lung las las phye las kyi gong / / 'khor lo phye ba kun gyis mthar gsungs kyang / / spyod dang lta ba'i dbyen phyir lhan cig sbyar/ / rtsod gzhi'ang rtsod par mtshungs phyir de 'phros gsungs/ / phyir bcos dngos gzhi dbyar dgag gang rung min/ / chos 'dis bslab pa yongs sbyong chas bzhag pa'i/ / dge de chos 'di'i gso sbyong mtshan nyid do/ / de la dbye na zhi gnas bsgom pa dang / / dge slong dge tshul pha ma'i cho ga bzhi/ / sngon chog tshe na tshigs bcad gdon pa drug / cho ga lnga la mthun dang bkra shis dang / / gnod bzlog gco lnga bcu bzhi 'dren pa 'khrul/ / zhi gnas sngar bstan gtso dang nyung phyir ro/ / ma bcas dus kyi nang ba'i zhi gnas dang / / bcas rjes sdom pa ma blangs nang ba yi/ /zhi gnas kyang min bcas ba'i zhing min phyir/ / srang du mi sgom sprul phyir ma gtogs so/ / rab bdun gso spyong nang na rnam gzigs kyi/ / bzod pa dka' thub bzod pa dam pa ni/ / mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ / rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / / gzhan la 'tshe ba 54

༄/ /'dulabargya gagashararabasdusanorakhu'iphrengagadage sbyong ma yin no/ / zhes gsungs gtsug tor can gyis ni/ / bskur ba'i mi btab gnod mi bya/ / so sor thar ba'ang sdom las bya/ / zas kyi tshod kyang rigs par bya/ / bsam tha'i sems la gnas bar bya/ / zhes gsungs thams cad skyobs kyis ni/ / ji ltar bung ba me tog las/ / kha dog dri la mi gnod par/ / khu ba gzhib nas 'phur pa ltar/ / de bzhin thub pa grong du rgya rgyu/ /zhes so 'khor ba 'jig gi ni/ / bdag gis rigs dang mi rigs la/ / brtags par bya ste gzhan rnams kyis/ /mi mthun pa dang gzhan dag gi / byas dang ma byas rnams ma yin/ / zhes sogs gnas skabs skyon gang che'i/ / gnyen por sbyar ro thub pas ni/ / sdig pa thams cad mi bya ste/ / sogs gsungs mu stegs 'phya ba spangs phyir bcas/gnas ni grub pa rang grub byas pa ni/ / rang phyir byas pa'o zin pa gnas rnying ngo / / 'gro tshe thang la blo mthun mi 'chags phyir/ / mi dgos phyogs rer phyed gsum 'tshams po che/ / gnyis nas bzhi bcu'i gding shong mtsham bu chung / / bzhi bcu tsam shong dkyil 'khor pa yang yin/ / chos gos mtshams po che nang dkyil 'khor bar/ / bzhag na 'bral yang rang bzhin mtshams gcig pa/ / lcags ris bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhan du yang /mi 'bral 'bral la ltos na rtsigs mtshams gtso/ / mtshams po che yi gleng gzhi ka pi na/ /dgos pa las rnams spyi dang bye brag tu/ /gso spyong dgag dbyer 'dus pa'i 'dun dga' dang / / chos gos dang bral spang sla dbyar ral kyang / / spang sla gzhan du dbyar gnas yang sra brkyang 'byung / /mtshams po che der phyogs phyogs phyed gsum ldan/ / mtshan brtan mtshams gzhan min sogs khyad chos lnga/ / 'jig rgyu dge slong med par skya rengs shar/ / gnas tshad bab shi rten zhing min gyur dang / / mtshams gzhan 55

༄/ /byung ba zhing gnas min gyur dang / / cho gas gzhig pa'o gcad dgrol tshigs gcig pa/ / gcig gis dkyus gcig byed rung la dgongs te/ /dgrol ba gsol bzhi gcad pa gsol gnyis phyir/ / mtshams nang dkyel 'khor 'jig rgyu mtshams chen 'dra/ / rang la dge slong med pas mi 'jig gogaṇḍi che ba'i che ba srid du sor/ / brgya dang nyi shu zheng du nyer bzhi'o/ /bden rnam bcu drug mtshon byed ngos bcu drug / chen po'i chung ngu srid du sbyor ba'i lam/ / brgya dang bcu ltar brgya dang bcu gsungs dpyad/ /zhing du sems bskyed ngos la rten 'brel grangs/ / 'bring po srid du sgom lam go brgyad de/ / zheng du stong nyid nyi shu rnam thar ngos/ / chung ngu'i srid du brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'o/ / spong ba'i gaṇḍi chung du 'khar sil min/ / de tshad bcu gnyis sam nyer bzhir gsungs phyir dang / / gzhi 'grel 'khar sil de yi dod gsungs phyir/ / brdung tshe dang por shang tsha gsum byas nas/ /bco brgyad 'phel zhing bco brgyad phri ba rgyud/ / tsan dan dkar dmar bil ba pa la sha/ a smra a shāng tha sogs rgyu bcu drug / mtshams gcod ma gtogs da lta'i las kun la/ / 'dun pa'o gso sbyong dgag dbyer yongs dag kyang / / 'dun pa yongs dag gnyis ka sngags gcig gam/ / so sos dbul rung gcig gis rang dag cing / / 'dun pa phul pas dge 'dun las 'chag go / 'dun pa len yul mtshams gnas kha skong 'os/ / lus sam 'dun pas ma 'dus shes sam 'phrigs/ / spyos gnang ma thob dngos kyi grangs skong min/ / la sogs brgyad ldan no yongs dag len yul ni/ /gzhan 'dra kha skong 'os 'tshab bsnyen rdzogs sdom/ / gso rung yan chad dang ldan zhes sbyar ro/ / gang gis len pa dge slong tshos bdun ldan/ / 'gro ba bzhi bral blangs shes bcu gnyis ldan/ / 'dun rkyang gcig dang gso sbyong 56

༄/ /2labargyam ngotsogagasangarabasduyosakhu'iphrengagadagag dbye yi/ / yongs dag rkyang gnyis gnyis tshogs gnyis dang lngar/ /len po gtong dang des der 'bul lam dri/ / des 'bul blangs sam dris dang len pos brjod/ / lnga lnga phye bas cho ga nyer lnga'o/ / yul gye dmigs bsal mtshams nang dkyil 'khor bar/ / bya rung rten gyi dmigs bsal bslab byin dang / / spyod lam dmigs bsal 'gro bzhin gso sbyong bya/ /cho ga'i dmigs bsal bzhi ste yongs dag dang / / bzhir ma tshang na byin gyis rlabs pa dang / / sgra mi 'dod na gleng gzhi'ang mi 'don par/ /gsol byas tshigs bcad tsam 'don mdor bsdus dang / / dgag dbye'o gso sbyong min yang de dod thub/ / dus kyi dmigs bsal dus 'das mi chags kyang / / bcu drug nyi ma ma shar bar 'chags la/ / bcu drug dus kyang gso spyong bco lnga pa/ / de bzhin nor nas bcu bzhir byas pa yang / /bco lnga pa yin bco lnga'i nyin byas kyang / / bkra shis gso sbyong la sogs bco lnga min/ / 'on kyang gnyis ga'i phyir byas gnyis ka yin/ / mdo yi gdon 'tshams rgyas bsdus rtsa bar gsal/ / dbyar gyi gleng gzhi dge slong ljongs rgyu tshe/ / 'di dag gsod las ma log khug rta yang / / dbyar gsum zhum por gnas zhes 'phya spong phyir/ / tshul shing nye bar bzhag sogs spyor ba bzhi/dmigs bsal yid kyi dam bcas khas blangs 'gyur/ / sdom med bar ma yis kyang khas blangs dgos/ / brgyud pa'i dgos pa srog chags la gnod spong / / ma dad spong zhing srog la gnod pa spong / / don nyung shes rab 'phel zhing gnas 'chos dang / / dgag dbye sra brkyang 'byung ba'i dgos pa brgyad/ / 'on kyang phyi ma'i dbyar la sra brkyang med/ / dbyar gyi dam tshig drug ste 'khrug long spong / / thos brtson gnas 'chos gnas der yun ring gnas/ / dbyar ral spangs la dngos dang rgyu spangs gnyis/ / phyi mar 57

/ /rnyed bgod gleng dran nan tur gsum/ / dam bca' gnas su 'brel byed do de yi don/ / gang du gnas par khas blangs der gnas pa'o/ / gso sbyong rnyed pa'i khyad par rtsa bar gsal/ / dam bca'i der gnas mi byed nyes byas su/ / gsungs shing gnas pa dpe yin zhes gsungs don/ / chos gos lhung bzed bsod snyoms sman bzhi la/ / dam bcas las 'das nyes byas 'dis mtshon no/ / 'grel chung de de sbyin bsam las 'das gsungs/yang na phyag dar khrod sogs dam bcar sbyar/ / ltung ba gleng dran dgag dgyephyogs bcu yi/ / dge 'dun dbyar ral ma ral kun la bya/ / yig char gang zag 'jog pa dmigs bsal gsungs/ / mtsho ṭīka gleng ba po la bshad dang mthun/ / rin phreng ṭīkkar ltung ba'i gzhi la sbyar/ / ston zla 'bring dang tha ma'i nya la 'byung / / hor zla dgu ba'am bcu ba'i bco lnga'o/'di dang gong du dbyar gnas khas blangs dus/ / dbyar 'bring nya yi phyi de nyin gsungs pa/ / bcu gcig pa yi yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas/ / mgo bzung dus bzhir gsum gsum phye yin gyi/ / lngar phyes mar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbyar mgo ste/ / gro zhun zla ba'i tshes gcig yin phyir ro/ / dgag dbye tha skar 'jug gi nya la'o/ / ku sha 'jag ma 'gyur khyad do ram pa dod/ / yul gyi dmigs bsal gzhi dang gang zag 'jog / dus kyi dmigs bsal 'thab dkrol can 'ong na/ / gso sbyong gnyis song zin na gsum pa yi/ /gso sbyong dang sbyar glo bur dgag dbye bya/ / de las thung na dbyar go mi chod pas/ / de yi phan yon dgag dbye ga la 'byung / / tshogs kyi dgag dbye tshes grangs nges med de/ / dmag 'khrug dbang phyir lag brda yis kyang 'grub/ / gnas kyi dmigs bsal gzhan gyi dbyar gnas su/ / byed dang 'thab krol can tshe dkyil 'khor bya/ / cho ga'i dmigs bsal gnyis sam 58

༄/ /wa40lamad gagacadabasapharatsocab/thogs na gcig /rang phyogs ma rdzogs bud med dgag dbye min/ /rdzas kyi de las ltung ba'i dgag dbye gtso/ / dgag dbye chos dang tshul khrims dag par 'gyur/ /chos gos sra ba gzeb kyi sprog mar brkyang / / gtan pa zhes btags de steng glegs bu sogs/ /sdud bzhin 'dis kyang du ma'i byin rlabs 'dus/ / gtan pas mi 'khum 'dis kyang bag yangs byed/ /gtan pas chos gos la ni khyab par ltar/ / 'di yi phan yon dge 'dun kun la khyab/ / phan yon 'chang 'bral 'jog dang yang yang za/ / 'dus za gos slong ma smras 'gro ba la/ / nyes med rnyed pa thun mong 'gyur ba ste/rtsa bar dngos su bstan pa'i phan yon brgyad/ / rung bar ma byas gos mang 'chang ba dang / / snam sbyar med par ljongs rgyu don gyis bsdus/ / gang gis 'ding ba bcu gcig chos ldan te/ / sdom ldan tha snyad gsum ldan lta mtshan mthun/ / chos min phyogs min sa gzhan gnas min la/ / sa gzhan gnas pa'i rgyur yang gnas min te/ / las rnams kun la dgos pa bdun gye steng / /dbyar khas blangs dang de yang snga ma blangs/ /mar la de yang gnas der blangs pa dgos/ / gang zhig 'ding ba khyad par bzhi ldan te/ /rgyu yi khyad par spyi rdzas dbyar nang rnyed/ / dngos po rgyu dbyibs kha dog rung gsum ldan/ / bag yangs phyir na che tshad las lhag rung / / de phyir lhag pa yang ngo zhes tshad kyi dang / / grangs kyi lhag pa gsum phrug mang po'ang rung / /'ding ba'i byed po gsum phrug grangs snyed bsko/ / gsol gnyis kyi 'o 'ba' zhig las kyis gtod/ / dgu ba'i bcu drug nas bzung zla lnga ste/ / sa ga lhas smin drug nas ni khra yi bar/ / sra brkyang gding ba'i dus su gsungs zhes gsungs/ / dbyung bar bcos ma rang 'jug bral dang gnyis/ / bcom ma gsol bzhi'i dus sam snga bar yang / / nya shi gang rung 59

/ /zhig gi phyi nyina'ang 'byung / / rang 'jug bral la dge 'dun mtha' dag dang / / gang zag so so'i rang 'jug bral ba gnyis/ / dang por sra brkyang mtshams kyi phyir khyer dang / / brlags dang bsrung mkhan med par skya rengs shar/ / byed po dge slong min gyur re ba chad/ / dus min shes nas slar yang gso spyong byas/ / gding ba'i 'phen pa zad dang rnam pa bdun/ / so so'i 'jug bral ma ma sum cu dang / / gang zag zhing min gyur te so gcig go / ma las bu bzhin 'dir yang sra brkyang ni/ / dbyung ba'i nus ldan phyir na ma mar btags/ / 'tshams la re ba med pa'i ma mar yang / / spyor 'gros bzhi dang nges 'byed ma ma bzhi/ / dang por 'brel bcas gsum dang 'brel med gcig / sbyor ba 'gro tshe gnas 'dir zla ba lngar/ / mi 'khor snyam yang rnyed par re bcas na/ / dus kyi snga rol dge 'dun gyis dbyung tshe/ / de yi rnyed thob byed pa mthar thug dang / / rnyed brlags brtsams pa zhig pa'i gtam thos sam/ / len 'dod bsam pa'i rgyun chad gsum gyis dbyung / / dbyung ba dus na 'phen zad phyir 'di min/ / mi 'khor snyam par ma zad rnyed pa la/ / mi re 'tshams 'das 'brel med ma ma'o/ / nges 'byed 'brel bcas gsum dang 'brel med gcig / snga mar mi 'dra 'di la zla ba lngar/ / mi 'khor snyam pa mtshams phyir skyes pa yin/ / zla lnga'i nang du 'khor ram mi 'khor snyam/ / 'tshams la yid gnyis za ba'i ma ma brgyad/sbyor 'gro bzhi dang yid gnyis za ba bzhi'i/ / khyad dang 'brel bcas 'brel med sngar dang 'dra/ / mtshams la re ba yod pa'i ma ma brgyad/ /ldog 'dod rnyed par mi res de phyung ba/ / mtshams kye phyi nang thos pa'i 'brel med gnyis/ / gnyis gar re na byed pa mthar thug sogs/ /gsum ngo mtshams kyi phyi nang dbye bas drug / rnyed par yid gnyis za ba'i yi

༄/ /'dulabargya gnadamarabasdus ra༄ma ma drug / mtshams rnyed gnyis gar yid gnyis za ba yis mtshams las 'das dang mtshams phyir de skyes gnyis/ / mtshams la re med rnyed par yid gnyis kyis/ / 'tshams las 'das dang mtshams phyir de skyes gnyis/ /yig char bzhi po 'di las mi gsal la/ / mtshams la re bcas rnyed par yid gnyis kyis/ / mtshams las 'das dang mtshams phyir de skyes gnyis/ / bsnan pas drug ni mtsho ṭīka steng nas dpyad/ / bting ba'i chos gos sra brkyang ngo spyad na min/ / gsum phrug re re la yang kun gyi 'chags/ / dbyar gnas dge tshul rdzogs byas gding bar rung / / gter mdzod sum cur ma bu'i cha phye 'khrul/ / phyir 'ong na yang ngo zhes mtshams nad phyir 'ong nas/ / re ba chad pa'i zhig pa bstan no lo/ / rang lugs mtshams phyir zhig na phyir 'ong kyang / / zhig pa sor chud snyam pa ldog phyir ro/gos ni gzugs can snying bos 'tsho ba bar/ / btud las lus 'phags zhing ltar byed pa gnang / / bal gos sra ma la sogs gos rgyu bdun/ /'tsho ba rang dang lhag pa gzhan gyi dang / / mkho ba'i yo byad gnyis ga'i bsam pasaspyod/ / spyod tshul khyad par lo dri las/ / mi slob pa ni bdag por bshad/ / slob pa byin len spyod pa yin/ / bsam gtan 'don dang ldan pa ni/ / rjes su gnang rnams dka' thub can/ / zhes gsungs khrims ldan le lo can/ /bu lon no 'chal bar lcags gong 'dra/ / mtsho ṭīka ras bal las byas pa'i/ / ras ma zhes pa ma dag gsungs/ / lha gnas 'jug sogs kun bsdom na/ / tshigs bcad gdon pa'i skabs bcu bdun/ /gos gzhi lhag ma rtsa bar gsal/ / dbus nas mtha' rer dbag tshad bcu drug re/ / a sma bar na tar gnang sgrub bcas min/ /'dod khams pa yi 'tsho ba'i rten byed pa'i/ / dri ro reg gsum gyis bsdus kham zas de/ /61

/ /sman gyi don no tshags lam btsags pa'i/ / bza' ba dus rung tshags la btsags pa yi/ / btung ba dus min rung ba'o de la yang / / sman mtha' gsum dang a ru ra la sogs/ / bkres sel bza' ba'i rigs gnas dus rung sman/ / thun tshod mtha'i bar spyod rung thun tshod sman/ / dus rung las byung rus thang sla chus btab/ / bu khu sla ba zhag bdun las byung dang / / 'tsho bcing las byung a bar khu ba'o/ / dang po thun tshod mtha'i bar kho na dang / / gnyis pa zhag bdun nam thun tshod bar du'o gzhan/ /nam 'tsho'am thun tshod bar du byin gyis rlobs/ / 'og tu thun tshod rung dang zhag 'dun pa/ mi 'gal yang byin gyis brlabs byas gnyis 'gal gsungs/ / dpyad de zhag bdun byin brlabs thun tshod phyir/ / 'on kyang sman 'dis zhag shan 'gal lam dpyad/ / zhag bdun nam 'tsho'i bar ru de de'o/ / 'tsho bcing nga gsum mo bskab sman khur bshad/ / nad srog ji srid 'tsho la sbyor tshul gnyis/ / sman gsum nad pa'i byin rlobs byin brlabs dang / / byin len dus rung sman gyi dus su byed/ / dmigs bsal dge skos sogs kyis spyad du rung / / phyi'i dngos sman du mtsho ṭīka gsungs pa bkag / dri ro reg gsum re re ba yang yod/ / byin gyis brlabs la gsog 'jog mi 'byung yang / / bur ma zhag lnga'i ro 'gyur la 'byung ste/ / byin rlabs zhig kyang byin len ma zhig phyir/ / rung khang bzhi'i steng shes pa chung ngu'i dang / / 'jug pa mi zhan rung khang mdor bsdus sbyar/ / mtshams nang yin yang der zas 'tshod pa dang / / zhag lon bzhag tu rung phyir rung khang ngo / / las kyi gleng gzhi drug sdes grangs 'chol byas/ / dge 'dun grangs tshang kha skong 'os pa yi/ / las byed las gsum ci rigs ma 'khrul brjod/ / nyams myong thabs 'dir bstan las kyi 62

༄/ /'du dka'athanadararabasdusanoraba'iphrengagadon/ / las dngos mdzad po dge 'dun mtshan nyid dang / / rjod par byed po las mkhan mtshan nyid dang / / bsgrub par bya ba don gyi mtshan nyid dang / /las de 'chags pa bsam pa'i mtshan nyid dang / / las kyi ngo bo sogs su yod pa las/ / dang po grangs dang mtshan nyid tshang zhing mthun/mtsho ṭīka bzhi bcu nyi shu nyi shu gnyis/ / bcu gnyis bzhi bar bdun ma gtogs zhes gsungs/ / dbus su dge slong ma yi spo dbyung la/ / pha ma nyi shu nyi shu'o yul dbus su/ / bud med rdzogs la pha bcu ma bcu gnyis/ /mtha' 'khob ma dang dbus su pha dbyung bar/ / nyi shu'o mtsho ṭīka pha mthar nyi shu dbyung / / dbus su tshangs spyod nyer gnas dge slob ma/ / 'khor dang 'khor mang 'jog bzhir ma bcu gnyis/ / mtha' 'khor bud med bsnyen rdzogs bcu gcig go / dbus su dge slong bsnyen rdzogs la bcu'o/ma yi dgag dbyer pha lnga ma bzhi'o/ / ma yi spo mgur pha ma bzhi bzhi'o/ /tshangs spyod nyer gnas sogs bzhir mtha' 'khob drug mtha' 'khob pha chog pha yi dgag dbyer lnga/ / dgag dbye byed po ming bsko dgag dbye sogs/ /las rnams phal cher bzhi'o de ltar na/ / grangs tshang bye brag mi 'dra bcu gcig go / dbyar dang dgag dbyer kha skong lnga dgos lo/ /tshul shing zim dang dgag dbye byed pa por/ / bsko bya de yang kha skong grangs su 'khrul/ /mtsho ṭīka bzhi bcu nyi shu brgyad bzhi las/ / gzhan la ma tshang yang nyes byas 'chags par gsungs/ / yig char dgu lnga gnyis la mi 'chags gsungs/ / mtshan nyid tshang ba kha skong chos ldan de/ / gzhir bshad bcu'o mtha' gsum zhu bar bshad/ / lus tha mal gnas tha snyad gsum ldan te/ / rung mthun sbyar ba gnyis bcas chos bco lnga/ /dmigs bsal rim bzhin 'gro zhing gso spyong bya/ / bag yangs 'ga' dang 63

/ltung thun byin rlabs yul/ / phye tshe chos phyogs pa yang tha dad gnas/ /chos min phyogs kyi las la sdig lta can/ / ltung thun byen gyis brlab la 'khrul bcas te/ / bsdam byas nyes byas ldan yang 'khrul bcas phyir/ /sangs rgyas mdo gdon byed bor las ṭīka gsungs/ / thun mong las la mtshan mthun mi dgos shing / / thun mong min la'ang med mi rung min te/de tshe mtshan gyur 'chags par las ṭīka gsungs/ / ma yi las rnams pha yis byed par rung / / sa gzhan sbo mgu spyod ldan bcu gnyis dang / / ngo bo nyid tshol mthun sbyin bslab ba byin/ / bsdig smad bskrad phyir 'gyed bzhi gnas dbyung bdun/ / la la rgyal ba kha skong mi 'os phyir/ / 'dus pa phyir bzlog mi mthun mi bskyed zer/ / rgyu mtshan ma nges dge tshul kha skong min/'on kyang rang la bsnyen rdzogs bzlog pa 'chags/ / rgyal pa mi mthun byed nyid min gsungs pa/ / ma 'dus pa la lung las dmigs kyis bsal/ /'o na lag rdum rab byung bkag pa'i phyir/ / mi 'chags sam zhen dngos su min phyir min/ / glen pa nang bcas tshig mi brtan sogs bcus/ /dkrugs min chos min las ni des kyang ldog / rjod par byed po med na spo spyod sogs/ / gdon rung las brjod tsam la chos bzhi ldan/ / gzhi la sems can min brten bcu gcig ste/ / gnas la blo mthun gnas kyi sdom pa sbyin/ / mtshams che bcad dgrol mtshams chung bcad dgrol bzhi/ /rung khung blo mthun de dgrol mi 'bral ba'i/ / gnang ba sbyin dang sra brkyang 'ding ba la/ / blo mthun byed dang sra brkyang dbyung ba'o/ / de las 'ba' zhig shi rdzas byin brlab dang / / gnas la blo mthun mtshams gcod gsol gnyis te/ / sra brkyang dbyung ba la sogs gsol bzhi'o/ / sems can la brten khyim pa rab byung gnyis/ / dang por lhung bzed sbub bsrang mu stegs 64

༄/ /24༄70gsag 'dor༄pharatsosgob/kyi/ / gnas pa sbyin dang khyim gye bslab sdom sbyin/ / de nyid bag yangs byed pa dang bcas lnga/ /gnyis par bsnyen rdzogs ma rdzogs la brten gnyis/dang por rtsa ba'i dbye ba sbyin pa'i las/ / zhe brgyad bsko las so gsum byin brlabs dgu/ / mi mthun bcu gsum yo byad sbyin pa'i gsum/ /rjes gnang bzhi dang rang don la sbyar gnyis/ / rab byung ba la mkho bzhag bcu drug ste/ / rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag brgya nyi shu/ / sbyin yul bsnyen rdzogs gso rung yan chad ldan/ / shes pa rang bzhin gnas dang mtshon mthun dang / / gnas nas ma byung chos min phyogs ma song / / la sogs brgyad ldan no 'khor mang gnad sbyin yus/ / gso rung mi chog rnam par dag par dgos/ /spyos gnang sbyin yul ma yi mgu dbyung dang / / bsnyen rdzogs sbyin yul bzod pa sbyin yul dang / / mthun pa'i gso sbyong sbyin yul rim bzhin bkol/ / bsko yul bcu bzhi chos ldan ma'i dgag dbye/ /byed por bsko bya mtshan mi thun pa dgos/ / mi mthun las sam chad pa bcad pa'i yul/ / tshogs su ma long nad pa min sogs bcu/ / dbye ba zhal ta ba la ngo 'phya dang / / gzhogs 'phyas bsgo ba rna gzon mi smra ba'i/rna gzon byed la de yi grangs gzhugs bzhi/ / bsgo gyur bcu yi bzlog pa bcu sogs te/ / de las 'ga' zhig gzhi la dge tshul yod/ / 'du shes bsnyenadzogs sogs la bsgrub bya dang / / spyos gnang chad las dge 'dun sems kyis 'chags/ /'chags pa'i dus ni 'og ma med pa ste/ / gsol brjod mtha' de'i sum gnyis rdzogs na 'chags/ / yin kyis go na ma thos bar yang 'chags/ /go rgyu gsol bar tshang phyir de thos nas/ / song kyang 'chags la mi mthun mi bskyed do/ / bsgrub bya'i myong med sems can min brten dang / grags pa tsam gyis nan tur 'phrin chog dang / / mngon du 65

ra / / /sa lam gyur las bcu la sogs so/ / sdud po bsko dang dbyen spang sogs yod kyang / / mi mkho phyir na gtam gzhir brgya rtsa gsungs/ / gtam gyi gzhi las 'ba' zhig pa/ / nyer bzhi gsol gnyis zhe bdun te/ / gsol bzhi sum cu'o shā tam las/ / gsang dang nang du dri phyir dang / / gso spyong de la ltung bcas dang / / de la dge 'dun yid gnyis dang / / rtsod dang nges rnyed ma yin dang / / de yi don du lnga bo dag / thams cad dgag dbyer gtogs pa yin/ / dbyar gnas khas blangs nyid dang ni/ / shi ba'i rdzas dang nor 'dra dang / / chos gos sra brkyang gtad pa dang / / chos gos sbyin par bya ba dang / / gnas ngan len ni brjod pa dang / / grangs su gzhugs pabazhi dag dang / / khyim gyi sdom dang de gzhig dang / / lhung bzed kha srub bya ba dang / / de nyid bzlog bar bya ba dag / gsol ba 'ba' zhig las yin no/ / gso sbyong gdon ched gsol gdab ste/ / de 'og ltung ba byin rlabs bzhi/ / de bzhi dgag dbye'i tshe yang ni/ / 'byung phyir dgag dbye rang dang lnga/ / shi ba'i rdzas dang nor 'dra bsdoms/ / dbyar dang tshul shing 'brim pa bsdoms/ / sra brkyang gtad dang chos gos ni/ / ngan na dge 'dun sbyin pa bsdoms/ / gsol gnyis gnas la blo mthun nas/bag chos 'brim pa'i bar bco lnga/ / phran tshegs 'brim nas rgan po la/mi 'bral gnang sbyin par bcu drug / lhag ma bcu drug go dang po ni/ /gnas dang mtshams ni gnyis bo dang / / mi 'bral myos dang dgag dbye dang / / gnas mal stob par byed pa dang / / rung pa'i sa gzhi bsko ba dang / / sra brkyang dang ni de 'ding dang / / spong dang lag gi bla dang ni/gnas khang bsko ba la sogs dang / / zhes te mtshams cher mi 'bral gnang / / dgag dbye byed po bsko ba ste/ / gnas kyi zas thug bag tshos 66

༄/ /'dulabargya gnadamadorabasdusanor༄'iphrengagamatshon/ / phran tshogs 'brim dang snod spyad 'drub/ / gos dang ras chen sbed 'gyed bzhi/ / mngag gzhugs mdzes 'chos bsko ba yang / / gnas khang bsko zhes sogs sgras bsdus/ / lhag ma'ang garma shwa ta ma las gzung dang gsal dang sbed pa dang / /tshul shing 'grim par byed pa dang / / khang ba khang chen bstan pa dang / / gleng dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur dang / / zhes te tshul shing phyogs gnyis brtags/ / khyim sun 'byin la chos min gleng /lhag ma bcu drug yang shā tam las/ / stan dang lhung bzed 'grim ba dang /ma dad go bar byed pa dang / / ston pa dang ni nags nyul dang / / phyag mi bya dang mang phyir dang / / 'khar ba dra ba'i phyir dang ni/ / rnyed pa gcig tu bya phyir dang / / bslab pa sbyin dang nyer gnas dang / / bu dang nye du phyir 'gro ba/ / gsol dang gnyis kyi las yin no/ /lag blar lo drug stan gnang sbyin/ / ma yi ston pa bsko ba dang / / mang phyir zhes pa 'khor 'khor mang / /gso sbyor tha dad rnyed gcig bya/ / bu dang nye du phyir 'gro ba/ / gnyis kyis dbyar 'gro'i gnang ba'ang mtshon/ / gsol bzhi sum cu shā tam las/ / bsnyen par rdzogs par bya ba dang / / mu stegs gnas dang 'tshams dgrol dang / / mthun sbyin gso sbyong bdun po dang / / brgyad dang bran dang ma myos dang / / de nyid tshol du gzhug pa dang / / bsgo bar bya ba rnams dang ni/ / nyams pa sbyin par bya ba dag / gsol dang bzhi yi las yin no/ /zhes te mu stegs gnas pa sbyin/ / bdun po zhes pa'i las bcu gcig / bsdoms pas grangs phan gnyis yin te/ / bsdigs smad bskrad 'gyed gso spyong bzhag / dgag dbye bzhag pa drug gi steng / / ma mthong mi 'chos lta mi gtong / / gnas dbyung la bsdus de ltar bdun/ /nan tur yin phyir grangs phan gcig / bzod gsol logs su grangs phan 67

/ /no/ / sbo mgu gzhi nas spo mgu dang / / gzhi nas bslang ste sbo mgu dang /lhag ma dbyung dang sra brkyang dbyung / / brgyad bo brgyad dang zhes pas bsdus/ / bsgo gyur bcu po bsnyil dang bcas/ / 'chab med can la bslab pa sbyin/ / de rten gang la bzhag na pha nyid la/ / ma yi ston dang dgag dbye ras chen sbed/ / gzugs gsal gsal ba'i gsal ba bsgo ba drug / ma la phyag mi bya ba'i sdom sbyin dang / / bsgo ba lnga dang sngon rol sdom gnyis sbyin/ / 'khor dang 'khor mang bu dang lhan cig nyal/ / nye dur 'brel ba'i gnang sbyin bcu gnyis so/ / ltung bzed sgrub bsrang khyim sdom sbyin dang dgrol/ / dge tshul bsnyil lnga ma rdzogs 'ba' zhig la/ /bsgrub phyir thos pa'i mngon sum bya snyam pa'i/ / dog pa med phyir rtsa bar ma bstan la/ / rgyu mtshan de las bzlog phyir spyos gnang dang / / phyag mi bya dang mi smra longs mi spyod/ / gtsug lag khang gi sdom lnga dngos su bstan/ /mtha' gsum las min brgyad dang bzhi ru 'gyur/ / de phyir de bkol lhag ma myos gnang dang / / phyag mi bya dang khyim sdom lhung bzed spub/ / mthong thos gnyis ga'i mngon sum ma gyur las/ / bsnyel dang sdom gzhig lhung bzed kha bsrang gsum/ / mthong ba mngon 'gyur thos la mngon ma gyur/'di la rtsod pa ṭīkkar kha spub la/ kha bsrang bya gsungs longs mi spyod dang 'gal/ / khyim sdom byin la mi smra longs mi spyod/ der 'gro stan la 'dug cing chos ston 'gal/ / mi smra sogs gsum cho ga lung na med/ / de phyir mngon du ma gyur las yin 'gal/ / rtsod 'di gsum la go dka' gsum zhes grags/ / bya gsungs byas par ma gsungs dang po'i lan/ / 'gro yang za phyir mi 'gro gnyis pa'i lan/ / las su btags pa tsam ste gsum pa'i lan/ / de la las rnams thos su mi rung ba/ / 'di bas spangs te chos khu

༄/ /'du dga'agagasharorabasdusanoraba'iphrengab/min phyogs su song / / chos dang zang zing gis spang gnas dbyung ngo / /rnam dag las log pham pas nyams pa dang / / bde 'gro las log mtshams med byas pa dang / / bsnyen rdzogs las log ma rdzogs gyur pa ste/ / spangs pa gnyis dang log pa rnam gsum mo/ / kha skong mi 'os na'ang ma spang dang /ma log rnams kyis mdo gdon thos par rung / / lhag bor 'bras bu chung phyir brjod pa gcig / rang don sngags brjod gzhan la phal cher gsum/sor bshags mthol ba dgag dbye dus yol brjod/ / zhag bdun nyi ma 'das brjod ma gtogs so/ / gzhan gyi don du gang zag la brjod na'ang /brjod pa gsum zhes shugs kyis dge 'dun la/ / brjod do cog ni lan gcig brjod par gsungs/ / dge 'dun la brjod spo ba'i nyi ma dang / /gang zag la brjod dus min 'gro ba'o/ / sbo ba byed pos brjod na nyer gnas la/ / nyes bcas 'chags shing gzhan la nyes med 'chags/ / cho ga 'das la mi 'chags gsungs pa der/ /la la dge 'dun la la las chog zer/ / grangs tshang tsam dang cho ga bton tsam la/ / cho ga ma tshang phyir na de mi 'thad/ / rang lugs las 'chags thabs phyir gsum tshogs so/ /dge 'dun dang 'brel las la gsol bzhi sogs/ / gang rung min pa yongs dag 'bul ba'o/ /phyir bcos gzhi la ltung ba phyir bcos dang / / rtsod pa phyir bcos gnyis so dang por yang / / phyir bcos dngos nas 'khor lo'i dbyen par drug / dang por rang mi spro na phyir bcos rgyu/ / nan tur byed dang spro na phyir bcos dngos/ / nan tur gleng gzhi nab so 'gro mgyogs gnyis/ /mi 'dod bzhin du las kyi chad bcas 'jug bzod gsol dgos rung las de de yi don/ / mi 'dod bzhin zhes ngo bo nyid tshol sel/ / las zhes 69

/ /gnas kyis gnas bar chad bcas gcod/ / chad par bcas pa zhes pas grangs gzhug bsal/ / bzod gsol dgos rung zhes bas nan tur las/bzod gsol min yang gzhan stobs kyis grol sdud/ / sgras brjod dbye bas nan tur bco lnga ste/ / dbyung zhes bsdigs dang gnyen po chung zhes smrad/ / khyim sun gnas des skrod dang mdza' gcugs 'gyed/ / gnas dbyung bdun te ma mthong mi 'chos dang / / sdig lta mi gtong 'thab krol la 'bad dang / / rung dang mi rung rnam par gtan dbab kyang / / mi gtong nyer zhi'i phyir du gnas dbyung dang / / 'thab krol rgyu bsgrub pa dang dge slong mar/ / 'dres zhing gnas pa gnas nas dbyung pa'o/ / gso spyong dgag dbye bzhag bsnyil lhung bzed spub/ / bsdigs bas mi gtong gnas nasadabyung ba yi/ / rung mthun sbyar ba smad pas mi gtong na/ / gnas dbyung la sogs gsum ste bco brgyad do/ / bco lnga'i dang po bcu bzhi rab byung la/ / bya zhing gsol bzhi'o tha ma 'ba' zhig pa/ / nan tur 'go med pa la 'go gdags pa/ / rnam par gtan 'bebs ma zhi gnas dbyung la/mngon sum brgyad ka sngon 'gro'i chos gsungs pas/ / rung mthun gnas dbyung gzhan la'ang bzhams bsgo sogs/ / sngon 'gro sbyar ro sdig lta mi gtong la/ / bzhams bsgo dngos su gsungs zhes mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ /nan tur mjug med pa la mjug sbyar ba/ / bsdigs pa'i mthar dbyung gzhan gsum la sbyar ba'o/ / 'og tu bzhag cing bshung phyir nan tur ro/nan tur yul gyi rab byung gso rung sdom/ / nad pa gnas dbyung chos min phyogs dang tshogs/ / ma yin ltung ba gleng dran sngon song sogs/ / bcu ldan no khyim pa chos drug ldan pa ste/ / rang gi sbyin bdag gtogs zhing nad pa min/ / pham pas bskur zhing gshe spyo sngar spub min/ / gang gis byed pa 70

༄/ /khru4rgyal da gagasangarabasdu'ar cob/dge 'dun chos bzhi ldan/ / grangs tshang mtshan nyid tshang zhing mthun pa'o/dus ni dbyar nang min zhing ma g.yengs pa'o/ / dgag dbye de tshe bzhag phyir dmigs bsal lo/ / sbyor ba gleng mkhan bsko yi kun gshe ba/ mi mdzes mjug tu ltung 'di phyir bcos shing / / dge 'dun 'dis khyod bag yangasabyed 'gyur ro brjod/ / nan tur bslab bya gzhan gus bdag gir byed/ / rang bzhin gnas dang mnyam 'gro mnyam du 'grogs/ / mkhan slob byed dang gzhan stong gleng ba ste/ /khyad par can gyi spyod pa lnga spong zhing /bskrad pa gang bskrad sa der mi gnas kyang / / dge 'dun lhan cig spyod phyiraganas dbyung min/ / nan tur grol rgyu thun mong ma yin pa/ / gso spyong dgag dbye lhan cig byas na dang / / gnas dbyung min pa'i nan tur snga ma la/ / nan tur gzhan zhig phyi nas byas na'ang grol/ / thun mong bzod gsol bden mthong dgra bcom ste/ / bden mthong grol na dgra bcom gsar grol dpyad/ /mi 'du khas mi len yang nan tur rgyu/ /kun la grags pa tsam gyis bya bar rung / / kha cig bsdigs pa nan tur yod min te/ /ltung ba gleng dran sngon du 'gro dgos la/ /de tshe kun skabs mi 'byed lhag mar phyogs/ / phyogs 'gar mi 'byed brjod bcas phur bcas 'gyur/phye yang khas mi len na ma mthong dbyung / / len yang mi 'chos mi 'chos gnasadabyung la/ / 'chos na nan tur mi byed phyir ro zer/ / skabs mi 'byed nam ltung ba khas blangs na/ / skabs der nan tur gzhi btsan bya bar gsungs/ /phyir bcos mthol bshags gnyis las dang po'i yul/ /lus sa lta mtshan bsnyen rdzogs lnga ldan no/ / bsgo gyur mthol yul bsgo las mdzad po kun/ /sor bshags der 'tshog go gzhan ni dge slong chos/ /bdun ldan no ma rnyed so thar rigs brgyad rung / / de bzhin mtshams 71

/ /gzhan gnas pa yang ngo gsungs/ / dngos po sde lngar gtogs shing rang rgyud 'brel/ / shes sam yid gnyis za sogs bzhi ldan no/ / ltung gcig zhag gcig bcab dang zhag gnyis bcab/ / zhag mang bcab la nyes grangs shes mi shes/ / zhag grangs mi shes pa ni zhag dpag med/ / bcab pa'o de ltar mu lnga ltung gnyis dang / / ltung ba tshad med la sbyar ro nyes pa'i grangs/ /shes bkol lhag bzhi ltung pa dpag med la/ / sbyar te de ltar mthol sngags mu bcu dgu/ / gang gis mthol ba gnas phyung min pa dgos/ / bshags par bcab nyes bshags dang dngos bshags gnyis/ / dang por bshags tsam zhag gi chad las gnyis/ / bshags yul chos bdun steng du ltung ba yi/ming rigs mi gcig ma mtha' 'ang ltung mi gcig / rigs gcig spang ltung la mtshungs lta bu'o/ / zhag 'brel lhag ma lce chos spo ba spyod/ / spo ba len yul grangs tshang rang bzhin du/ / gnas las gang zag khyad 'phags min pas nod/ / bcab pa'i grangs snyed do khyad 'phags spyod lnga spong / /nang dus chos ston dus dang 'du ba'i dus/ / dus tha dad dus dgong dus dman spyod lnga'o/ / byung zhes brjod tsam gyis kyang bcab nyes khegs/ /dngos gzhi bshags la rtsa ltung lhag ma dang / / gzhan pa gsum mo 'chab bcas dman pas gso mi nus/ / 'chab med byung la nam 'tsho'i bslab pa byin/ / lhag ma sngar bzhin spo mgu spyod dgos la/ / dge 'dun mgu bar byed phyir mgu ba'o/ / 'byin pa'i lhag ma'i mgu ba spyod bzhin par/ / de byungalang len slar byung slar yang bskyar/ / snga ma zhig kyang phyi ma'i zla byed dam/ / zhag drug tshang na snga ma'i mjug mi dgos/ / lhag ma snga phyi'i bcab yun ring shos srid/ / sbo spyod mi mthun lhag mas mi 'jig na/ / spo spyod de la spo sbyin rung ngam dpyad/ / spo ba snga ma blangs kyang ma chags par/ / slar 72

༄/ /'dulabargya gagasharorabasdusanorakhu'iphrengab/yang lhag ma de nyid byung ba na/ spo ba len gyi gzhi nas spo ba min/ / 'on kyang bar ma mi 'dor phyir bcos bya/ / spo ba de yang gnyis ga'i don du spyad/spo gsum mgu gsum spo ba gsum po la/ / mgu ba gsum gsum phye bas bco lnga'o/ / mgu rkyang gsum dang spo ba'i mtha'i dgu ste/ / mgu ba dbyung ba rnam pa bcu gnyis so/ / bslab byin mdo sdes 'chab bcas gsor med pas/ /'chab med pham pas sbom po dag phyir zer/ / gong ma 'chab med kyis gtong slar blang yang / / sngar gyi pham pa de nyid dag ched gsungs/ /bye smra 'chab med kyis ni mi gtong yang / /ma dag gyur pa dag phyir mtsho ṭīka gsungs/ / sbyin yul bsnyen rdzogs gso rung yin zhes pa'i/ / tshab tu rab byung sde lnga gso rung zhes/ / sbyar te dge tshul bslab byin 'od ldan gsungs/ /yan lag gcig bral pham pa'i sbom po lci/ / mtshams bcad mtshams gtogs kun dang mtshams phyir drug / gnyis bral pham pa'i sbom po yang ba bzhi/ / lhag ma'i sbom po lce ba lnga la ste/ / ltung byed sor bshags nyes byas gcig la bshags/ / de ltar ming rigs sgo nas phyir bcos byas/ / mthar brtsal rkyen ma 'byor dang mtshan gyur dang / / dgra bcom thob dang bden mthong rnam thar rtogs/ / byang chub sems bsgom bdun gyis ltung ba dag / bden mthong tshe na ltung ba phra mo yang / / dag phyir don dam dge slong yin par gsungs/ /khyim par dge 'dun mi dbang phyir na der/ / kha spub nan tur min yang chad las 'dod/ / dge tshul smad pa nan tur yul min te/ / de la lhag ma 'byung ba med phyir ro/ /gang zag gzhir bcab lhag ma rang gi ste/ / gzhan gyi de ni 'chab pa'i ltung byed do/ / sa gzhan gnas pa'i gzhi ni nyer lnga'i steng / / bsnyil ba bsnan pas sa gzhan nyer drug go /zhib mo rnam 'thag dbye ba zhe bzhi ste/ / sngar 73

/ /bzhin spo mgu spyod pa bco lnga dang / / ldan pa bco lnga'o ldan pa'i don la dpyad/ / de steng bsdigs smad bskrad sogs sngar dang 'dra/ / de la bsdu tshul gsum ste ngo bo'i sgos/ / spang pa sa gzhan gnas dbyung bdun dang bsnyil/ / smad pa sa gzhan bsdigs smad bskrad 'gyed bzhi/ / rnam par dag pa sa gzhan gzhan rnams so/ / rnam grangs sgo nas gnyis te sa gzhan la/ / nan tur byas dang ma byas gnyis yin te/ / dbyung bdun bsdigs sogs bsnyil bcas dngos po gzhan/ / bslab bya'i sgo nas sa gzhan che chung gnyis/ / spo mgu bco lnga ngo bo nyid tshol dang / / bslab byin no 'di dag khyad par spyod lnga spong / / dman spyod lnga len chung ngu'i dman spyod min/ /spo ba 'khor bas spo spyod las grol kyang / / mgu ba mnos pas spo ldan las grol lo/ / yongs sbyong gzhi la gang gis gleng ba po/ / sdom dag lta mthun gleng byar zhe 'gras min/ / bud med kyis gleng tshe na mtshan mthun 'ang dgos/ / gang la gleng yul sde lnga gso rung ldan/ / nad pa gnas phyungs dge 'dun 'byed nus min/ / la sogs brgyad ldan no dben pa'i gnas su gleng / / tshogs dbus gleng gsungs tshogs nang nyes byas yin/ / gleng tshe dang por bsam bya'i gnas su bsams/ / brtags bya'i gnas su brtags par bya gsungs pa/ / rang la gleng byed mtshan nyid tshang ma tshang / / gleng bya yul dus sogs la brtags pa'o/ / phyogs 'gar skabs mi 'byed la brjod bcas te/ / khyod kyis brjod bcas byas zhes brjod sogs so/ / skabs 'byed khas mi len la phur bcas te/ / mi mnyen pa 'am dmu rgod 'dul phyir rta/ / phur bar gdags bzhin ltung ba'i gzhi dang ni/ / gang du byung ba'i gnas sogs gsal byed pa'o/ / de ltar byas kyang khas mi len la gnyis/ / brjed pa yin na ngo bo nyid tshol sbyin/ / shes bzhin khas mi len 74

༄/ /'du gnadagorabasas rakhu'iphrengagan ma mthong dbyung / /las phye'i gzhir gsungs chos ni mdo mngon no/ /chos min phyogs la ris brgyad phyag mi bya/ / 'on kyang dge slong ma sogs stan las ldang / / de la bzod par bya ba gsol bzhi'i las/ / de rjes mthun pa sbyin pa gsol bzhi'i las/ / de 'og mthun pa'i gso spyong sbyin gsolabazhi/ / de 'og lhan cig mthun pa'i gso sbyong bya/ / mi rung gzhi bcu zhi byed bkra shis ste/ / hu lu hu lu yi rangs dang / / kun spyad snod dang lan tshwa dang / /lam dang sor gnyis dkrugs dang gding / / gser gyi rung pa bya ba ni/ /mi rung ba yi gzhi bcu yin/ / zhes te chos min byas na a la la'i/ / rung bar byed pa hu lu hu lu'o/ / zhes sogs rgyas par bu ston chos 'byung gsal/ / sgra mi snyan ma gtogs par mtshams gcig tu/kha skong 'os pa brgyad yan so skyes kyi/ / chos min der 'du shes ba'i dbye ba'o/ /'khor lo bye ba lung gzhi las/ / 'o ma sha dang lan tshwa dang / /gos dras dgon par gnas pa dang / / zhes te ldog phyogs bslab tshigs lnga'i/ /tshul shing brim nas dge 'dun phye ba ste/ /zhag tu mi gnas de bar lam lnga chad/ / dbyen dang dge 'dun ltung bar 'byed po ldan/ / bcas pa'i dang po ba phyir lhag ma dka'/ / rtsod rgyu phyi na yod pa rnam bzhi ste/ /de bzhin nyid la log sgrub rtag smra sogs/ / spong pa zhes bya gdams ngag la sogs 'jog /ltung bcas lhag ma med na rtsod zla min/ / bzhi pa las la 'du ba mi ster ba'o/ /mi mthun smras la 'khon 'dzin rtsod pa'i dngos/ /che long dbye na 'gyed phyir mi gdams phyir/ / ltung phyir bya ba las phyir rtsod pabazhi/ / zhib mo rnam 'thag dbye ba bcu gcig ste/ / mi gdams phyir rtsod pa la rgyu bcas ni/ / ltung ba yod kyang gleng la mi nyan pa'o/ / rgyu med gyad bu nor la log g.yem gyis/ / gleng ba lta bu gleng ba'i gzhi med dang /75

/ /mngon tshan can gyi ltung ba byung ba la/ / nyo tshong gis gleng gzhi gzhan rjes sgrub dang / / chang 'thung yang phyir bcos byas pa mi shes par/ / gleng ba phyir bcos pa la mi ltos dang / / spyos par ma shes gleng ba rnam bzhi'o/ /ltung phyir rtsod la gnyis te gleng bya des/ / byung ba shes shing dran bzhin rtsod pa dang / / bzlog pa'o dang po la ni rnam gsum ste/ / phyir 'phros med pa kho rang gnyis tsam rtsod/ / re gnyis phyogs bcas phyir 'phros nyi tshe dang /mtshams nang dge 'dun mtha' dag rtsod pa'o/ / zhi byed gcig gis rtsod kun zhi ba dang / / rtsod pa gang la zhi byed kun 'jug dang / / so sor zhi byed so sor sbyar ba'o/ / dang po 'chi bzhin pa'am bslab dbul lo/ /gnyis pa bya ba las phyir rtsod pa la/ / dngos sam brgyud pas zhi byed thams cad 'jug / gsum par 'gyed phyir rtsod sogs zhi byed bzhi/ / dang por mngon sum dang ni gang mang gnyis/ / mngon sum la'ang brgyad de mtsho ṭīka las/ / rgol dang gzu dang dge 'dun bzhi po dang / / gsal ba dang ni gsal ba'i gsal ba dang / / dge 'dun gzhan dang sde snod 'dzin pa dang /gnas brtan mthu dang ldan pa'i mngon sum mo/ / zhes gsungs rgol dang phyir rgol mngon sum ni/ / brgal lan tshul gyis rnam par gtan 'beb po/gang mang zhes bya tshul shing zim pa ste/ / lta phyir yin gyi tshul khrims phyir ni min/ / mi gdams phyir rtsod zhi byed la gnyis te/ / rgyu bcas la ni mngon sum 'dis byed kyang / / rgyu med gsum la dran pa'i 'dul ba dang / / tha mar ma myos 'dul ba'i dag pa ster/ / ltung phyir rtsod gnyis ngo shes zhi byed gsum/ / phyir 'phros med pa'i zhi byed yang gnyis te/ / khas mi len zhing mi 'chos phyir rtsod na/ / khas blangs nas ni phyir bcos bya bas zhi/ /khas mi len phyir tsam rtsod blangs bas zhi/ / phyir 'phros nyi tshe ba la mngon 76

༄/ /khru4yomatshadaspyogs doraḥ'arartsesgob/sum ste/ /kun ni rtsa bkram bzhin du phan tshun 'dud/ /mi shes pa la ngo bo nyid tshol sbyin/ / las la rtsod na las la mthun pa sbyin/ / rtsod pa 'khrul ba rung mthun sbyar byas na/ /phyir 'phros med sogs mi gdams phyir la sbyar/ / ltung phyir rtsod la'ang gzhi med sogs bzhi sbyar/ / ltung phyir rtsod pa dang por khas blangs pas/ /zhi gsungs gnyis bar sbyar zhing gnyis pa la/ / mngon sum gsungs pa dang por sbyar du rung / / rtsod pa mthar bskyal ba ni mthar dbyung ngo / / 'thab cing ma zhi ba la bsdigs pa dang /brkyangs te ma zhi ba la phyir 'gyed do/ / phyogs res gcig gi sa gzhan mingasgos nas/ / mthol na kun gyi ltung phyir rtsod pa zhi/ / kha cig ngo bo nyid tshol nan tur te/ / dge 'dun dbus su bzhag nas bya gsungs phyir/rgan mthar gsol ba 'debs pa ma gsungs phyir/ / bsdigs bzhin mjug tu bzod gsol gsungs phyir zer/ / gsol 'debs rnam 'byed med kyang lung gzhir gsungs/ / nan tur yin na skabs 'dir gsungs pa'ang 'chol/ / rtsod pa bcu gcig so sor mngon sum kyang / / lan gsum bgrang ba'i zhi byed so gnyis so/ / zhi byed bsdus na lo dri las/ /mngon sum dran pa ma spyos dang / / de bzhin gang mang ngo bo nyid/ / rtsa rnams bkram pa lta bu dang / /khas blang bar yang bya ba'o/ /zhes te bdun no mtsho ṭīka las/ / brgyad pa las la mthun pa sbyin/ / gtsug lag khang mchog gtsang khang khyams dang bcas/ / rgyal ba'i bkas bkod ri mo rnam bkra bar/ zhing mchog rgan gzhon rim pa'i mdzad bzang gis/ / bshad sgrub bya ba las kyis bstan pa skyongs/ / 'di ni btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rang lo nyer gsum pa la lha ldan smon lam grwa skor gyi dus gtugs pas rtsa ba blo 'dzin ngos/ / der mi gsal ba kha 'geng dgos 77

/ /rnamasadape klog gang bgyis dran tho rags pa tsam sug bris su btab pa las/phyis dpe rim par 'khyar te chos grwa chen po dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi dka' ram 'dzin grwa'i chos grwa ba rnams nas rtsod pa la phan skyed che bar 'dug pas bar du 'khod dgos zhes par yig btab zin 'dug kyang / / spyir dang po nas rang gi brjed tho tsam du bsam ste tshig spyor sogs rtsom pa'i lugs su ma byas shing / lhag par de skabs rtsod pa cha tshang ma song bas gong 'og ma 'brel ba lta bu re gnyis 'dug pa zhu dag cung zad bgyis yod kyang / / da dung blo gros can rnams kyis dpyad par mdzad na legs so/ / 'dir 'bad legs byas gago'i klung rgyun gyis/ / nyes ltung rnyog pa'i dri ma rab sbyangs nas/ / chos 'dul rgya mtsho'i gling du phyin gyur te/ / bslab gsum nor bu'i mdzod la dbang 'byor shog sarba marga li/ /78

༄/ /mngonapamadzodakyis nargyamatshor 'jugasa'itsho jingag༄7//chos mngon pa mjod kyi bsdus don chos mngonaju mchor 'jug pa'i gru gzings zhes bya ba bzhugs so/tshogs gnyis rin chen las grub sku/ / dbyangs kyis skye dgu tshim mdzad gsung / / sgrib bral ting 'dzin 'bum bkra'i thugs/ / 'gro 'dren shākya seng ger 'dud/ / a sti mngon phyogs la sogs la/ chos kyang rnam bshad rig pa las/ / chos ni shes bya lam dang ni/ / mya ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul/ / bsod nams tshe dang mtho ris dang / / 'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o/ / spangs rtogs phun tshogs rang gi don/ / 'gro ba drangs pa gzhan gyi don/ / chos ston 'phrin las phun tshogs te/ / 'di dang gnyis pa'i khyad par dpyad/ / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes pa/ / zlos min nye tshig gus phyir dang / / 'dul ba bshad rnam bse ru dang / / skye mtha'i sems dpang rim gdags phyir/ / mun pa bcom tshul ba'i mtha' can/ / 'di'i zhes drug pa'i 'bru mang dang / / 'dis zhes gsum pa byed tshig la/ / sbyar ba gnyi ga 'gal ba med/ / gang spel slob mas nyon mongs min/ / ma spangs bzhed par mdzod ṭīka bshad/ / mi 'thad spangs pa'i bye brag gis/ / rnam lnga'o zhes gang spel gsungs phyir ro/ / rang gis thob pa chad tshul te/ / der yang skye mi rung mi dgos/ /79

/ /gzhan gyi dang ni shes sgrib 'dun pa la/ / 'dod chags bral ba'i tshul gyis spong phyir mdor/ / nga ni chos gcig yongs su ma shes shing / / ma spangs sdug bsngal mthar byed mi smra'o/ / mdzod ṭīka rgyu bzhi mi shes mun par bshad/ / sangs rgyas chos zab shes bya ring ba dang / / yul dang dus dang rnam pa'i rab dbye ring / / rgyu mtshan bzhi po spang bya tsam min la/ / de mthus blo 'das cha bzhi rgyu bzhi'o/ / ngas ni 'di yi thar pa yi/ / sa bon shin tu phra ba dag / tshon nam rdo yi gseb na gser/ / bag la zha ba'i tshul du gzigs/ / de skad mdor gsungs sgra gcan gyis/ / rma bya'i mdongs ni gcig pu yi/ / rgyu yi dbye ba sna tshogs pa/ / kun mkhyen min pas shes bya min/ / de mkhyen pas na kun mkhyen stobs/ / gtan du zhes pas khyad phye zhing / / rtogs pa phun tshogs shugs la bstan/ / dngos bstan drang bya lam zhugs te/ / thar cha'i dge rtsa smin gsungs phyir/ / rgyud bla dar ṭīka lam ma zhugs/ / lam yang thar cha'i dge rtsa bzhag / zag med shes rab gtsor gyur pa'i/ / zag med phung po don dam mngon/ / sems las 'byed la shes rab gtso/ / rjes 'brang bcas pa'i yin pa med/ /gzugs med phung po bzhi par mchims/ / gsungs kyang de na'ang zag med sdom/ / ldan yang ma nges bsdus min la/ / zag med gang du skyes pa'i yin/ / gsungs pa'i steng nas 'di la dpyad/ / 'di la spong sdom yod mod kyi/ / so thar sdom pa dang 'gal te/ / de ni sems rjes 'brang min phyir/ / thob byed tshogs spyor lam mngon pa/ / mthong lam gyur pa'i thos bsamasgom/ / gsungs pa shing rta'i yi ge nor/ / sde bdun don kun ma bsdus kyang / / gces gces bsdus phyir de yi mdzod/ / yang na sde bdun 'di'i 'byung gnas/ / yin phyir de la mdzod ces bya/ / 'gro ba drangs 80

༄༅/ /mngonapamadzodabyung nargyam ri 'jugapa'itshogasangagaphyir sde bdun ni/ / ston pa'i gsung bzhin bdag kyang bshad/ / bya yi rtsom pa kho na la/ /sbyar na ltag 'og 'brel med 'gyur/ /ye shes la 'jug gtso bo ste/ / de dag nam mkha' snang mun sogs/ / bshad kyang bye smras mdor 'dod la/ /ma rangs pas ni lo zhes pa/ /bdun la ma rangs tshig yin gsungs/ / 'on kyang don bkag de bkag 'gyur/ / khas len mi mthun mang mod kyang / / skabs 'dir slob dpon bye smra yin/ / sde bdun byed po dgra bcom yang / /min par dpe ston kha cig 'dod/ / phung bos ma bsdus khams sogs kyis/ / bsdus kyang kun byang rim med phyir/ / ma bshad zag bcas zag med spros/ / chos zhes bdag gnyis 'gog phyir ro/dmigs pa mtshungs ldan gnyi ga'i sgros/ / rgyas par ma nges dgra bcom mig / mtshungs ldan med kyang zag bcas te/ / gzugs can bcu dang rnam shes lnga/ / gcig tu sgom spangs nyid phyir ro/ / skye rung tsam min 'gog lam yang / / mkha' la chags sdang mi skye yang / / log par lta ba'i rnam pa mang / /sred pas bzung la gzhan 'byung ste/ / gsher ba'i ras la rdul bzhin no/ /nyon mongs zag pa'i bdag nyid mtshungs ldan rnams/ /bdag rkyen dmigs sogs sgo nas zag dang 'brel/ / 'phen byed las ni sred pa'i zag pas bcings/ / gong mar zag pa'i sa bon rjes su 'brangs/de skyed dmigs pa zag dang rjes su mthun/ / zag zad phung po zag pa'i rgyu las byung / /rtog dang gnyen po min sogs bshad pa mang / / zag med yul can drug po dmigs pa'i sgos/ / zag bcas yin kyang rang dmigs sgos zag med/ / zag bcas thob pa zag bcas kho na'i phyir/ / sangs rgyas thob pa zag med gsungs pa dpyad/ / so skye 'gog gnyis thob pa zag bcas te/ / spang bya min pa'i rnam gnyis 'dod gsungs phyir/ / gnas 81

/mas myang 'das gcig pu bye brag pas/ / rdul sogs 'gog byed yang sgra nges bzung don/ / rlung rten skyes dang ma skyes 'gog pa'i phyir/ / khyad paraco ba'i dbang byas rdzas grub gsum/ / nam mkha' 'gog med sems mthus gzhan 'gog srid/ / mchod sbyin ma'i mdor 'gog pa 'dra min gsungs/ / rdzas tha dad kyang 'dra rgyu med la dgongs/ / rkyen ma tshang ba brtag min kho na min/ / mi rtag stoms 'jug skye ba'i bsam gtan gsum/ 'gog phyir skye la gtan smos gzhan phyir gzhan/ / de dang brtag min rang ste 'gog pa lnga/ / da lta'i zag bcas brtag 'gog gzhi/ / ma 'ongs mi skye'i zag med gzhan/ / gnyis ka yin pa rnam gsum ste/ / gzhan du g.yeng ba'i dgra bcom gyes/ / ma mthong 'gag 'gyur gzugs 'dzin migangan 'gro'i skye ba rim bzhin te/ / skye la gtan du gegs bcas pa'i/ /skyeb su la ldan pa dpyad/ / gcig car thob gzhi dgra bcom 'bras/ /thob ma thag pa'i mig dang ni/ / rdor ting tshe na skye rung la/ / gnyis par mi skye'o chos can du/ / 'gyur nges rnams so rgyal sras mar/ / mthong thos pa yis nyon mongs pa/ / chen po'i gnyen po skyes pa na/ / nyon mongs chen po ma 'ongs pa'i/ / 'gog gnyis gcig car thob gsungs dpyad/ / rgyu yang du ma tshogs dgos phyir/ / byas pa'i steng du 'dus pa bsnan/ /'dus byas mdor rgyas rim pa'ang yin/ / mi skye rnams kyang der rung ste/lus gnas la yang 'o ma bzhin/ / lus gnas la yang 'o ma bzhin/ /gtam gzhi gtam gye rgyu yi don/ / gzhi bcas bye smras rgyu tsam la/ / bshad pa 'dir rung spyir min te/ / gzhi lngas gnod cing gsung rab las/ / ngo bo nyid dmigs kun sbyor dang / / rgyu dang longs bzung gzhi lnga 'dab/ /lta gnas don ni gang spel las/ / dus kun pa dang thams cad la/ / rnam 82

༄ / /mngonapamadzod ngos mtsho'i 'jugapa'i༄ jingagagrangs med dang mi g.yo pa/ / lta yin de phyir chags sogs dang / / ma rig pa dang ze tshom min/ / zhes so dbyibs 'di bye brag la/ / kha dog dbye ba dgos dbang ngo / / lag pas rnga sgra zin ma zin/ / gnyis 'dod kun btus dang mthun yang / / 'dir bkag 'on kyang gling bu'i sgra/ / zin pa'i mi ston snyan gsungs dpyad/ / ston pa rnam rig gsung gtsor dgongs/ / mchims ṭīka drang ba med gsungs kyang / / bkres skom ma gtogs lnga char yod/ / srang gis gzhal med so sor dgongs/ / dkar sogs mtshan nyid ring sogs gnas/ / gzugs khams nyer lnga kun btus gsungs/ / rnam rig min gzugs mtshan nyid par/ / 'dod pa bye smra thal 'gyur pa/ / rang kun slong ba'i sems gzhan rig byed min/ / rang gi tha snyad 'jug pa gzugs gzhan la/ / rag las khyad par bzhi ldan chos skye mched/ / gzugs dang byed pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa de/ / rnam rig byed min don no khyad par lnga / / dus kyi khyad par g.yeng dang sems med kyang / / ngo bo'i khyad par dge dang mi dger nges/ / rgyun gyi khyad par rgyun mchog rjes 'brel te/ / rgyu yi khyad par 'byung bzhi rgyur byas so/ / mig dang rig byed thob pa rim bzhin gcod/ / nges tshig khyad par rnam rig byed min brjod/ / brjod ces rang nyid gzugs su mi 'dod ston/ /skabs 'dir skyon drug 'dus bzang gis/ / 'di la ma tshang bstan bcos 'gal/ / nyams dang de min de nyid thal/ / yang sgra lhag brjod khyad par du/ / bya ba khyad par ma byas so/ / zhes te rig min dang po ni/ / rgyun min mtshan nyid ma tshang skyon/ / rgyun ni rdzas su ma grub phyir/ / rig min rdzas grub bshad par 'gal/ / g.yeng dang sems med kho na'i na/ /sems bcas skabs kyi rig min nyams/ / rjes 'brel zhes pas ma g.yeng 83

/ /dang / / sems bcas bsdus na rig byed sogs/ / de min pa yang de ru thal/ / sems bcas g.yeng bas bsdus pa'i phyir/ / 'grel pa'i yang sgra gcig lhag go / bstan med thogs med ces bya ba'i/ / khyad par ma sbyar skyon yang 'jug / de phyir rang gi 'dod pa ni/ / byas pa dang yang mi 'dra ba'i/ / sems pa'ang sems med pa la gang / / lung bstan thogs pa med pa'igazungs/ / de ni rnam rig byed min 'dod/ / ce na skyon dag yod min te/ / mtsho bzhin dang po'ang rgyun ldan yin/ / rgyun yang spyi tsam btags yod yin/ / ma g.yeng sems bcas yang sgras sdud/ / rig byed sems bcas kho nar 'byung / / gang zag gnyis phyir yang sgra gnyis/ /chos kun 'dir brjod ga la dgos/ / g.yeng dang sems med pa yi yang /zer bzhin rtsa bar sems med sngon/ / yang sgra med zer 'gal ba ste/ /der yang kyang 'ang don gcig phyir/ / rgya che gtos ches tha gru che/ / sra sogs khams bzhi 'jig rten na/ / 'byung gsum kha dog dbyibs la bshad/rlung ni gsung rab las 'byung bzhin/ / g.yol ba'i khams kyi reg byar bshad/ / sngar bzhin kha dog dbyibs la yang / / bye smras tshogs par 'byungabazhi bzhag / dpe ston sa bon tshul du 'dod/ / khams ni rgyu yi don yin yang / / 'dir khams de de yin pa dgos/ / kun btus de la mu bzhi bshad/ / myong yang myong pa yin mi dgos/ / mtshan mar 'dzin yang mtshan 'dzin min/ / de ni bdag 'dzin yin phyir ro/ / sngon gyi skal ldan khyad par can/ / sems gcig las gzhan sems byung sogs/ / med de sred pa 'pho ba'i mdor/ / sems nyid gnyis su snang ba ste/ / de bzhin chags sogs snang pa'am/ / dad la sogs par snang bar 'dod/ / nyon mongs dpe chos yod ma yin/ / btsun pa rā dza shrīs ni/ / sems byung tshor ༅

༄ / /mngonapamadzodakyibasdusado nargyas ri 'jugapa'igruthabangaga'adu gnyis su 'dod/ / phung po'i don ma shes pas nongs/ / btsun pa ku mā rā dza ni/ / tshor 'du reg sems bzhi tsam smra/ / de dag mi 'thad bsdu pa las/ / lnga nyid 'thad pa med phyir dang / / de yi gnas skabs skyon phyir dang / / byed rgyu bye brag med phyir dang / / lung dang 'gal bar 'gyur phyir ro/ / zhes te phung po lnga po mi 'thad dang / / byed pa gzhan phyir tha dad thal ba dang / / gcig la gnas skabs gnas skabs can yang 'gal/ /sems dang gcig phyir sems byung dge mi dges/ / yul dbang sogs rgyu 'dra phyir 'bras khyad med/ / chags pas sems nyon mongs byas lung 'gal lo/ / bsdu ba'i lung 'dis 'khrul nas sems sems byung / / rdzas tha dad zer gnyis ga'i rdzas so sor/ / gzung rgyu yod pas rdzas gzhan mi 'grub ste/bum dang bum gzugs so sor grub phyir ro/ / rdzas mtshungs re re'i don phyir 'dir mi gnod/ drug pa'i rten phyir yid bshad la/ / gos dmar sde bas snying du bshad/ / snying ni gzugs med khams su'ang bzhag / mdo las dus gsum phyi nang phra rags dang / / ngan pa gya nom nye ring sogs gsungs don/ / bye smras phra rags thogs bcas thogs med dang / / ngan pa nyon mongs can dang bzlog pa gzhan/ / nye ring da ltar dang gzhan no btsun pas ni/ / phra rags yid dbang yul ngan yid mi 'ong / / nye ring snang mi snang ngo chos skyob min/ / bye smras khams bzhin phung po rdzas/ / slob dpon gzugs rdzas gzugs phung btags/ / bye brag bshad par tshul gnyis te/ / gzugs nyid phung po zhes brjod tshe/ / phra rab rdul yang phung por 'gyur/ / gzugs rnams kyi phung zhes brjod tshe/ / phra rab phyogs sam btags par 'gyur/ / phung po lnga yi 'grel par 'ang gsungs/ /sems tsam phung don khur khyer phyir/ / dus gsum re re'ang phung po yin/85

/ /'dil mdo sde pa yis mdor/ / thams cad bsdus nas phung po zhes/ /gsungs par 'gal zer spung ba'i don/ / med phyir phra rdul dus gsum gyis/ / bsdus phyir blo yis bsdus pa'i sgos/ / phung por bye smras bzhag pa'ang bkag / tshor bas khyim pa 'du shes sam/ / lta bas rab byung rtsod phyir dang / / phung po'i rim rgyu'i phyir yang ngo / / de ni rnam bzhi phra rags dang / / kun nyon skye ba'i rim pa dang / / gzugs snod tshor zas 'du shes ni/ / bya na 'du byed byan po ste/ / rnam shes za pos 'dod khams ni/ /'dod yon gzugs ma tshor bas phye/ / gsum ni 'du shes rtse 'du byed/ / bye brag don gnyis dgu las gzhan/ / dbang don 'dir ni shes phyir dang / / so sor skye mched rtogs phyir ro/ / gtso bo'i don gsum thogs phyir dang / / bstan phyir 'jig rten grags phyir ro/ / phung po'i ming can phung pos bsdus/ / zil gnon la sogs skye mched de/ / bla mar bsten zhing chags bral dang / / mi bsten dbyangs kyis kha ton byed/ / mi 'don gzhan la rgya cher ston/ / mi ston rang gis zhib tu dpyod/ / mi dpyod mi sdug sogs bsgoms pas/ / chags bral rnam grol skye mched lnga/4bco brgyad khams dor lhag ma zhe bzhi yang / / der 'dus so sor bgrang bas re gnyis ni/ / khams ni bco brgyad sa chu me rlung bzhi/ / nam mkha'i khams dang rnam shes khams te drug / 'dod chags gnod sems rnam 'tshe nges 'byung khams/ / gnod med khams dang mi 'tshe'i khams te drug /sdug bsngal bde ba yid mi bde ba'i khams/ / yid bde btang snyoms ma rig khams te drug / tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes bzhi/ / 'dod khams gzugs dang gzugs med khams te gsum/ / gzugs dang gzugs med 'gog pa'i khams kyang gsum/ / 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar 86

ra ji/ /cas(sa pazab dzang kyitsho 95rgya ngathagakhams kyang gsum/ / dman pa gya nom bar ma'i khams gzhan gsum/ /dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan khams gsum/ / slob dang mi slob de gnyis min khams gsum/ / zag bcas zag med khams gnyis 'dus byas khams/ /'dus ma byas khams gnyis te re gnyis 'dod/ / bco brgyad drug tshan gsum dang bzhi tshan gcig / sum tshan drug dang gnyis tshan gnyis bcas pa'i/ / khams mang re gnyis legs par bshad pa yin/ /bco brgyad kyis bsdus 'dod khams dang dus gsum/ /lung ma bstan dang slob dang mi slob min/ / dman sogs zag bcas 'dus byas bcu gcig gochos yin bco brgyad mkha' dang chags sogs drug / sdug bsngal sogs drug tshor 'du 'du byed gsum/ / 'gog dang 'dus ma byas so 'gog pa'i khams/ / chags bral spangs dang 'gog khams gsum phyes min/ / chos yid rnam shes gsum du 'dus pa ni/ / gzugs med gnyis slob mi slob zag med lnga/ / sna lce'i rnam shes dri ngo bzhi bsal ba'i/ / lhag pa bcu bzhir 'dus pa gzugs khams gnyis/ / gzugs sgra yid khams rnam shes khams drug dang / / chos khams bcur 'du dge dang mi dge gnyis/ /lus dbang dge ba yod na 'di dang 'gal/ / rnam shes khams su 'du ba rnam shes gnyis/ / phyi nang gsungs phyir spong bar gsungs phyir dang / /skyes bu'i gdags gzhir gsungs phyir 'dus byas so/ / rang lugs nam mkha' ma byas bu ga sogs/ / nam mkha'i khams ni byas phyir mi mtshungs so/'byung bzhi sngar bshad lhag gnyis 'dir bshad kyi/ / bco brgyad khams kye rnam shes 'chad byed min/ / chu dang skam gnyis nyin mtshan gnyis thogs gzhan/ / mi nya chu srin byis pa gsod dang mi/ / 'ug pa rta dang stoms 'jug la sogs so/ /yul la thogs dang sgrib pa'i thogs pa la/ / mu bzhi 87

/ /semasadang yul lnga dbang po rtag / dmigs bcas yul can nges phyir mu gsum ste/ / yul thogs dmigs par mi thogs dbang po lnga/ / gnyis thogs sems dang gnyis min nam mkha' sogs/ / dbang shes dngos nyid rtog yin kyang / / nges rtog rjes dran rtog med la/ / dgongs nas mdo las rtog bral gsungs/ / rdzas brgyad rdul min bsags rdul chung / /khams bzhi sreg byed 'jal byar smra/ / kha cig med dang lcid tsam 'dod/nang gi lnga ni rgyu mthun las/ / byung yang byung ba gzhan gnyis las/ /gzhan du med phyir 'dir ma bshad/ / sgra ni rnam smin la yin te/ / 'dod dgur dbyung bas chog phyir dang / / bcad nas slar yang 'byin rung phyir/thogs med khams brgyad gnyis las byung / / rgyas byung med de mi bsags phyir/ / gang las ma byung rtag rdzas chos/ / tha ma chos yid rnam shes kyi/phyogs gcig rgyu mthun las min te/ / zag med skad cig dang po'o/ /sgom lam yin yang gnyis pa yi/ / dngos gzhi zag med gsar skyes kyang /gnyis bzhin kun 8byung chos bzod kyang / / zag med snga ma'i rgyun nam dpyad/ / 'di ni dmigs bsal ston byed yin/ / mig gsar thob la rnam shes gsar min pa/ / 'dod na dbang po rim gyes thob pa ste/ / rnam shes bar do'i dus nas thob zin phyir/ / gzugs med gnyis par skyes ma thag pa de/ / mig thob rnam shes gtan la thob pa yin/ / mig shes gsar thob mig gsar thob min pa/ / gzugs med gnyis skyes mig shes mngon byed pa'o/ / dge dang lung ma bstan ni 'dir 'brel med/ / ma sgrib lung ma bstan tsam mngon byed phyir/ / de yis mngon ma byas par thob min te/de ni 'das thob bcas par thal phyir lo/ / gzugs med ma zad 'dod dang dang po las/ / gnyis par skyes kyang 'dra ste der skyes tshe/ / snga ma'i 88

༄/ /mngonapamadzodakyibasdu nargyas me 'jugapa'itsho jingagamig shes thob pa btad phyir ro/ / mnyam thob gzugs med nas ni 'dod pa dang / /tshangs pa'i bar dor skyes pa'i ldan tshul yang / /mig dang ldan la mig shes mi ldan pa/ / de mngon mi byed bsam gtan phyi ma gsum/ /bzlog pa dmus long mer po mig nyams sogs/ / yin te 'dod na mig shes nges lda na phyir/ / kha cig gzugs med 'dod par skyes ma thag / ma sgrib lung ma bstan pa'i mig shes ni/ / rnyed min drug dang drug dang gnyis rnyed do/ / gsungs phyir khyab ste gong nas 'dir skyes tshe/ / nyon mongs can gnyis dge ba skyes thob rnyed/ /dgra bcom 'dod pa'i nyon mongs kyis nyams tshe/ /gong ma'i nyon mongs gnyis dang slob sems rnyed/ / ma sgrib bsnan na bdun du 'gyur phyir ro/ / chos khams rten bcas rnam shes skyed pa'i don/ / yin phyir mi 'dra ma mthong 'gag 'gyur dang / / mi skyes dbang po rnam shes de mtshungs nyid/ / gzugs sogs lnga ni rnam shes so so la/ /ltos nas rten bcas de mtshungs gnyi ga yin/ /nub phyogs pa yi mi skyes dbang po la/ / rnam shes ldan dang mi ldan gnyis su bshad/ / sna lces yul mnyam 'dzin gsungs che chung ngo / / mthong spangs mtshan nyid thob pa'ang mthong spangs yin/ / de phyir nyon mongs can du ma nges la/ /'dir bros dbang po'i sems pa las gang dpyad/ / gong ma'i lus la 'og ma'i mig mi brten/ /'og ma'i mig gis gong ma'i gzugs mi mthong / /rdzu 'phrul dang ni gzhan brten ma gtogs lo/ / gong ma'i rnam shes 'og ma'i mig la min/ / shes dang mi 'dra gnyis par 'og mngon byed/ / de phyir dang po'i mig blos sa kun mthong / / mig shes gong 'og sa gsum mthong ba ltar/ / lus la'ang gong 'og rang sa'i gzugs mthong zhing / /ci rigs par ni gsum ga'i rnam shes brten/ / 'di dag lus rma sgra shes 8 9

/bzhir yang sbyar/ / dbang yid gnyi ga'i yul lnga yin yul gzhan/ / srog tshor dri med dad sogs chos kyi phyed/ / nang khams bcu gnyis dbang po'o gzhan ma yin/ /rang gi don la lhag par dbang byed pa'i/ / cha nas bzhag pa'i 'dus byas dbang po'i don/ / lnga yis lus mdzes bsrung dang rnam shes skyed/ /thun mong min yul la dmigs rgyu bzhir dbang / / gnyis kyis pho mor bye brag phyed pa dang / / skad gzengs mtho sogs khyad par gnyis la dbang / / srog gis mtshams sbyor srog 'dzin gnyis la dbang / / yid kyis phyi mar sbyor zhing de'i dbang gis/ / lus sogs dger 'gyur mthun par dbang byed gnyis/ / de dag mi 'thad mdzes byed dbang rten yin/rkyang bas mi mthong bsrung la rnam shes gtso/ / dbang po med kyang pho mo'i dbye ba rung / / nyon mongs can min srog mtshams sbyor byed min/ /mtshams spyor byed po yid nyid yin phyir yang / / gsum gyis kun shes byed dang kun shes ldan/ / lhag med 'das thob sogs sgras mthong sgom gyi/ /spang bya spong zhing bder gnas la dbang byed/ / mdzod ṭīka gong nas gong dang myang 'das thob/ / sogs pa la ni dbang byed phyir zhes bsgyur/ /lasakyi dbang po lnga sogs mi bgrang ste/ / smra ba slob dgos khas len rkang med 'gro/ / khas kyang gtong phyir ro grangs nges rgyu mtshan la/ / bye smra bkod kyang rang lugs 'jug pa'i gnas/ / mig sogs drug dang skyes pa pho mo gnyis/ / srog gnas tshor lnga nyer spyod bcu bzhi'o/ / de bzhin 'khor ba ldog pa'i dbang byas rten/ / dad sogs kun shes byed pa skye ba dang / /kun shes gnas dang ldan pa la dga' la spyod/ / bsam gtan gsum pa las gzhan na/ / lngar phye'i bde ba lus tshor yin/ / de na nyon mongs can ༅

༄༄/ /mngonapamadzodabyer nargyamatshor 'jugasa'itsho jingagagyi yang / /sems bde yod de chos bcu drug/yul du 'gyur tshul bshad pa'i skabs/ /sems bder spang byar sa lngar gsungs/ / dad sogs lam ma zhugs nas yod/ /kun btus dang ni bsdu pa las/ / kun shes byed dang kun shes la/ / sbyor mthong mthong sgom gnyis gnyis bshad/ / kun shes ldan nam bsrung bar mthun/ /bzo gnas spyod lam sprul sems sogs/ /rnam smin min te 'bad bya'i phyir/ / tshe yi gtor 'jog tshul ya yang / /rnam smin 'dod tshul gtong 'jog tshul/ /srog tshe'i khyad par gtong 'jog gi / dgos pa bzhi'o dang por yang / / yo byad phul nas rab mtha' la/zhugs las langs te smon tshig gis/ / tshe rgyu ra bsgyur phyir tshe 'jog pa/kha cig tshe 'di'i rnam smin zer/ / la la snga ma'i las lhag ma/ bsgom mthus drangs phyir snga ma zer/ / dbyangs sgrogs bsam gtan rgyas byung ste/'dod pa'i yul la'ang ting 'dzin mthus/ / bsam gtan sas bsdus 'byung ba tsher/ / mthun dang 'gal ba mngon byas nas/ / rim bzhin 'jog dang gtong bar smra/ /slob dpon de tshe rgyas byung dang / /lhag ma'i rnam smin cha gnyis bzhag /srog ni gcig tu rnam smin du/ /slob dpon mi bzhed gang spel gsal/ / btsun pa mtha' sa go chas ni/ / tshe yi rnam par smin pa'i las/ / mthong chos myong bar rigs min te/ / mthong chos dbye ba 'chad 'gyur phyir/ / gnyis pa'ang mi rigs mthong chos la/ /myong 'gyur la sogs 'chol bar 'gyur/ / gzugs kyi 'byung bas gnod med phyir/ / gtong ba mi 'thad tshe 'phos par/ / thal phyir sdom pa'ang btang 'gyur zer/ / slob dpon srog gi lhag ma ni/ / 'dod phyir skyon 'di 'brel bar dka'/ /lan la bye smras mthong chos 'bras/ / yin yang skyon med mchod rten sogs/ / gsol pas tshe 'phel mdor gsungs phyir/91

da / / sa la'adir yang mi 'gal shugs bstan yin/ / ris mthun gnas phyir bzhi pa'ang nyams/ / tshe dang longs spyod rnam smin ni/ / smon pas bsgyur ba gtong 'jog tshul/ / gling gsum rten la dus mi sbyor/ / rnam grol lam pa zhig gis byed/ / srog tshe gcig kyang sngon du lta'i/ / 'bras dang ris gnas tshe dang ni/ / 'tsho ba srog sogs 'dod tshul mang / / gtong 'jog dgos pa slob dpon gyis/ / 'chi dang tshe la mnga' brnyes gsungs/ / bye smra bdud rgyal shes ched de/ / yangs pa can du 'tsho btang bas/ / phung bcom byen rlabs 'chi bdag bcom/ / 'chi bdag gyad kyi yul bcom 'khrul/ / rnam par smin pa bcu gsum las/ / 'dod par dang por lus srog gnyis/ / mer mer lus kyang dbang po min/ / yid dang btang snyoms sogs de tshe/ / skye srid nyon mongs can du gsungs/ / mchims mdzod de'i tshe'ang yid sogs la/ / rnam smin nges med la dgongs gsungs/rdzus skyes mtshan med mtshan gcig dang / / mtshan gnyis pas ni drug bdun brgyad/ / phyi ma ngan song kho nar yod/ / mig sogs srog yid btang snyoms brgyad/ / gzugs gtong 'dod na mtshan sngar bzhin/ /dge bas 'chi la lnga lnga bsnan/ / dbang po 'phos na tshor gnyis te/ /mthar gyis phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras/ / dbang po brgyad dang dgu yis 'thob/nges ldan rnams kyang phan tshun du/ / yod par ma nges sems med gnyis/gsum pa'i zag med bde thob pa'i/ / gzugs med phyir mi 'ong dgra bcom/ / nges ldan gsum dang de bzhir ldan/ / 'di ni bcu gcig ldan min nam/ / bsam gtan mtha' dang gzugs med kyi/ / so skye ma gtogs thams cad la/ / bde ba ldan phyir lus ldan la/ / lnga dang mi ldan gang yin dpyad/ / mig sogs bzhi dang ldan pa ni/ / nges ldan gsum 92

༄/ / mngonapamadzodakyibasdu nargyas ri 'jugasa'i༄khajingagalus rang ste lnga/ / yid bde ldan yang bde ste lnga/ / bsam gtan gnyis pa'i so skye la/ / bde med lus bde dang pos bsdus/ / gsum pa'i sems bde ma thob phyir/ / zhe na ma grub gsum pa yi/ / sems bde nyon mongs can ldan phyir/ / 'on kyang gsum pa'i sems thob min/ / sdug bsngal ldan la nges ldan gsum/ / chags bral yid mi bde spangs phyir/ / tshor gzhan bzhi dang bdun ldan no/ / pho mo yid mi bde gsum yang / / snga ma'i bdun steng rang ste brgyad/ / dad sogs nges ldan gsum ste brgyad/ /kun shes la ni de yi steng / / bde gnyis rang ste bcu gcig go / kun shes ldan la'ang gzhan bcu 'dra/ / zag med bde gnyis gzugs med na'ang /sa 'phos zag med gtong rgyu min/ / dbang sbyangs gtong yang rno thob 'gyur/ / kun shes byed pa 'dod rten phyir/ / tshor bzhi dang sogs srog lus yid/ / 'di la pho mo gang rung gi / dbang po nges ldan zhib cha gnyis/bshad kyang 'dod lha bzhi yis gnod/ / dge med 'dod na 'ching ldan phyir/ / byes pa dri med ma gtogs pa'i/ / bcu dgur ldan rnams sdom ldan min/ / mtshan gnyis byung bas gtong phyir ro/ / chags bcas 'phags par mtshan gzhan dor/ / dri med gcig ste bcu dgu rung / / de ldan dge slong sogs kyang rung / / phyir mi 'ong la mang na yang / / bco brgyad yid mi bde spangs phyir/ / gzhi lngar skur ba zlog pa'i phyir/ / rdzas grub lnga bshad grub mtha'i gzhung / / slob dpon rdzas brgyad 'dus pa'i rdzas/nus par bzhed phyir rdzas rdul med/ / bye smras rdzas rdul blo yis kyang / /gzhig med che chung bsags rdul 'dra/ / de brgyad 'dus kyang mi che ste/ /bye ma chu dang me lcags bzhin/ / kun kyang 'byung bzhi gzugs dri ro reg bzhi'i/ / bdag phyir sra gsher mi 'dra med ces rtsod/ / bye smras che chung 93

/shas zer mdo sde pas/ / nus pa tsam phyir rtsod lan gnyi ga bkag /mtshan nyid kyis na dbyibs rdzas sogs phyir nyung / / skye mched kyis na 'byung bzhi reg bya'i phyir/ / mang zer rang lugs rten dang brten pa yi/ dbang byas 'byung bzhi rgyur byas bzhi bzhi yin/ / 'dus byas mtshan nyid dang ni kun skye yang / / ma gtogs pa la thob med rgyud gtogs kyang / /khyu mchog ltar ldang be'u ltar 'brang bas/ / de min grib ma lta bur lhan cig 'byung / / kho na dang phyir 'am zhes rnams brtag mdzad/ / kun btus sde tshan drug dang nga gcig gsungs/ / 'dir ni brjed nges shes bzhin min dran pa/ / rnam g.yeng ting 'dzin gti mug med lta blos/ / bsdus phyir sa mang lnga dang ma nges pa/ / brgyad de sems byung bzhi bcu rtsa drug gsungs/kun btus kun 'gro yul nges rtsa nyon lnga/ / dge ba bdun te nyer gnyis rdzas yod gzhan/ / mngon par shes bzhin ma yin brjed nges g.yeng / /tshul min yid byed log mos lnga gsung zhing / / phran tshegs mi dga' glal byed sems zhum dang / / rmya ba zas drod mi zin yid mi byed/ / tha dad 'du shes 'khrugs sogs nyer bzhi gsungs/ / sdoms kyang don bdun mi 'gyurader 'dus te/ / dang po lnga ni sems dang nyon mongs pa chen po'i sa pa gnyis yin rmongs sogs drug / nyon mongs kho na'i sa pa'i dbang byas bshad/ / sems kyi sa pa kho na tshor sogs lnga/ / mu bzhi'i rtsi tshul dge la yod med dpyad/ / sa ni go skabs can don khams gsum dang / /sems can kun kyang sa mang po yi sa/ / log mos sogs lta gti mug med/'tshe dang mi 'tshe dgu btags yod/ / gsungs so lhag ma lugs 'dir dpyad/ / mchims kyi rdzas yod don yang dpyad/ / som nyir shes rab khro la 'dun/ / ma dad la mos shas chung ste/ / ba tshwa'i rgya mtshor chu bzang 94
