༄/ /mdzadapamadzod ngos nargyar ri 'jugasa'i༄khajingagabazhin/ / kun btus ma 'dris dran par dpyad/ / don gnyer 'dun pa'o mos pa dga'/ / sems kyi 'jug pa yid byed do/ / rang 'grel bcu po 'di dag ni/ sems kyi skad cig thams cad la/ / tshogs par 'byung ngo zhes grag go / zhes gsungs grags zhes 'dun sogs ni/ / kun la med par phung po lngar/ / gsungs phyir 'byung tshul mi 'thad cing / / rtsol bcas yid la byed pa dang / / rtsol med 'du byed btang snyoms gnyis/ /gcig la 'gal phyir bye smra pa'i/ / mtshan nyid la yang ma rangs so/ /gzhan rtsol gzhan la rtsol med lo/ / dmigs pa mi mtshungs thal bar 'gyur/rtog dpyod rig par 'dra'o lo/ / slob dpon rang yang phung po lngar/ /yid byed kun 'gror gsungs pa'i phyir/ / btang snyoms dang ldan 'dod dgos zer/ / mtshan nyid khyad par yod dam dpyad/ / gti mug med pa blos bsdus phyir/ / 'gal zla gzhan ston dgag sgra yis/ / gzhan la rtsa ba gnyis zhes bshad/ / lus kyi shin sbyangs dbang shes su/ / kun las btus kyi dar ṭīka dang / / mchims ṭīka bshad kyang yig char min/ /rgod pa'i rgyur dpyad 'tshigs pa bsdigs/ / nyes sbed g.yo dang bzang rdzu sgyu/ /nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa yin te/ / ma rig tsam dang mtshungs ldan phyir/ / mtshungs ldan grogs kyis chung ba dang / / 'di dag sgom spang kho na'i phyir/ / spang bya ris kyis chung ba dang / / yi shes kho nar 'byung ba'i phyir/ / 'byung sa rten gyis chung pa'o/ / ma nges rnams ni de ma yin/ /rtog dpyod la gsum 'aspyod dang po/ / gnyid la snga gnyis chags sdang la/phyi gnyis nga rgyal the tshom la/ / rgyu mtshan bar ba ma tshang phyir/ / 'dod sems dge la nges can du/ / nyer gnyis mang na nyer bzhi 'byung / / ngan byas 'gyod pa'i ngo bo ste/ / 'di tsam yin min dpyad/ / yid la bcag 95

/ /par de btags pa/ / yul gnas rgyu ming gsum btags yin/ / lta ba blo las gzhan med pas/ / lta ba gsum ldan ma 'dres 'dra/ / chags sogs bzhi dang khro sogs 'gyod/ / rang rang bsnan pas nyer gcig go / lta gnyis la ni bco brgyad de/ / 'dod na ma sgrib lung ma bstan/ / sems kyi bcu dang rtog dpyod ldan/ / sgrib pa lung ma bstan yang ste/ / nyon min ma rig yod phyir lo/ / nyi 'og pa ni ma zhu bar/ / cis zos rtsig par cis ma bris/ / snyam 'gyod yid mi bde ba yang / / lung ma bstan zer bzlog par dka'/ / dpyod pa yang zhes yang sgra yis/ / gtso 'khor med phyir g.yo sgyu bkag / mdo sde pa yis de'i khyad par/ / brjod pa'i sgra slong rtogs dpyod smra/ / rgyag pa dga' min khams gsum pa yi phyir/ / de la dbye ba lnga ste bshes springs las/ / rigs dang gzugs dang thos pa lang tsho dang / /dbang thang che bas rgyag pa dgra bzhin gzigs/ / bye smras dge dang mi dge 'byed pa'i sems/ / don shes yid dang dmigs shes rnam shes lo/ /dge sogs bag chags bsags sems rten gyur phyir/ / yid dang brten par gyur phyir rnam shes so/ / khams dang skye mched kyang de'i dbang byas te/ma 'ongs 'das dang da lta'i phyir yang ngo / / sems tsam stug po bkod pa'i mdor/ / sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ / de la ngar 'dzin yid yin no/ / yul la rnam par rig pa gang / / de ni 'jug pa'i rnam shes 'dod/ / ces so dbang por brten phyir dang / / yul 'dzin khyad 'byed mnyam pa'i phyir/ / rten dmigs rnam bcas mtshungs ldan gsungs/ /thob la rnyed ldan dang por yang / / sngar med rnyed thob chos bzod dang / /nyams las rnyed thob mis bsams gzugs/ / ldan thob de yi skad cig gzhan/ / rnyed bsams ma thob ldan ma thob/ / dgra bcom srid nyon ma 96

༄/ /mngonapamadzodakyibasdu nargyamatshor 'jugapa'igru jingagathob pa/ / sngar med rnyed pa'i ma thob dang / / mig long nyams las rnyed ma thob/ / de dag skad cig gnyis pa nas/ / ldan pa'i ma thob yig cha las/ sbyor lam mthong dang mi ldan pa/ / sngar med rnyed pa'i ma thob gsungs/de ni thog ma med pa nas/ / ldan pa'i ma thob ma yin na/ / ldan pa'i de lan ma zhig 'gyur/ / thob rnyed ldan gsum don gcig pa/ / bkag pa gsum du phye ba yin/ / thob dang ma thob yod mnyam mo/ / yid kyi ma thob su'i yod/ / bye smras thob pa rdzas grub ste/ / mi slob yan lag bcu ldan kun/ / 'jig rten pa yi sems mngon byas/ / 'phags min thal ba rigs pa'o/ / slob dpon 'khor sgyur rin chen ldan/ / mthong spang spangs phyir mi 'dra gsungs/ / 'gog gnyis rgyud du ma gtogs phyir/ / 'gog rnam gnyis zhes dmigs bsal gsungs/ / dus gsum so so'i dus gsum yang / / rang gi snga phyi bar la sbyar/ / mchims ṭīka 'das pa'i 'das pa ni/ / rang dang lhan cig 'gag ma thag / da lta'o de nas ma 'ongs gsungs/ / skye ba'i chos can ma 'ongs kyang / / rang dus ma 'ongs da lta bar/ / 'phos tshe da lta de rjes 'das/ / zhes gsungs mi skye'i chos can dpyad/ / ma gtogs rnams kyi rnam bzhi ni/ / brtag min gang zag dbye bas gsum/ / brtag thob zag bcas gong ma gnyis/ / gzhan dang lam bden gar ma gtogs/ / slob dang mi slob min thob la'ang / / slob par byed dang mi slob dang / / de gnyis gang yang ma yin gsum/ / brtag 'gog slob dang mi slob kyi/ / thob dang so skyes de thob pa'o/ / thal 'gyur pa yang slob 'phags par/ / 'dis 'grub tshogs spyor slob min na/ /slob skabs tshogs gnyis ma bsags 'gyur/ / slob par gang zag dgos min te/ / slob 'bras gnyis ka min gsum du/ / slob pa'i bral 'bras 97

/ /gsungs phyir ro/ / ma sgrib lung bstan min thob lhan cig skye/ / mig rna'i mngon shes sprul sems spyod lam bzo/ / ches goms sbyor bas khyad par stobs ldan phyir/ / dus gsum thob ldan so thar srog gcod sogs/ /'dod pa'i gzugs dang gong ma'i sgrib gzugs la'ang / / 'das thob med kyang de'i gzugs dge la yod/ / 'das ma skyes gsum da lta'i bar ba med/ / thob byar dus mnyam thal phyir ma thob 'gal/ / 'das pa'i 'das thob mchims kyis rang dus la/ / sbyar bar 'dis gnod 'di dang 'dra phyir ro/ / 'das pa la yang snga phyi gsungs mod kyi/ / snga mar rang dang lhan cig ma gsungs sam/ / yig char 'ang 'das pa'i da lta zhes pa yi/ /da ltar 'das pa'i rang dus la bzhag dpyad/ / ma thob rgyud ldan gar gtogs sa yis bsdus/ / zag med ma thob zag bcas bzlog pa gzhan/'dod khams sa 'phos kyis gtong spangs pas min/ / skal mnyam sems can smos pas 'bru sogs gcod/ / tha dad min spyi'i skal mnyam sems can tsam/ / bye brag tha dad skal mnyam lha mi sogs/ / skal mnyam spyi ni blo mthun 'jug pa'i rgyur/ / smra phyir gzhan sel mi 'dod 'dra ste dpyad/ /nges 'byung 'dod pa'i snyoms 'jug da ltar thob/ / skad cig gnyis par gnyis ldan langs tshe 'das/ / skyes nas myong 'gyur gsungs phyir gnas der med/ / de ni phyi mar 'dod pas skyes phyir ro/ /'gog pa zhir gnas don du srid rtser brten/ / nub phyogs pa yi byang 'phags ldang ba 'dod/ / rang lugs zad pa mkhyen dang dus mnyam mo/tshe bsod zad 'chi mu bzhi'i gcig bzlog dka'/ / myu gu skye bas myug dang gnas sogs gsum/ / skye de'i skye sogs bzhi ste brgyad po la/ / skyed pa'ibyed pa 'jug cing skye ba'i skyes/ / skye la byed 'jug thob pas thob pa 98

sa / /mnganapaca zhud gas 'jugasa'i༄9sangagabazhin/ / skye bas brgyad char skyed na yang / / rgyu rkyen tshogs la ltos pa'i phyir/ / ma 'ongs thams cad gcig car min/ / skal mnyam rgyu mthud las byung dang / / sems can ston dang lus bstan min/ / tshogs gsum 'du la de'i steng du/ / rnam smin las byung khams gsum gtogs/ /mtshan nyid rnams dang thob pa la/ / rnam smin rgyu mthun las byung gnyis/ / ma thob snyoms 'jug rnam smin min/ / phan 'dogs rig gnasargyu yi don/ / rgyu drug ming tsam gong mas 'dod/ / skyer gegs mi byed byed rgyu ste/ / mi 'tsher rgyal pos bde byas bzhin/ / mchims ṭīka skye rung mun dang snang / / byed rgyur gsungs so yig char bkag / sems byung rnams ni rgyu mtshan bcus/ / sems rjes 'jug ste skye gnas 'gag /gcigal min yang dus tsam gcig 'di yis mi skye'o chos can sdud/ /'bras dang rnam smin rgyu mthun gcig / 'dir yang zag med ma gtogs so/'bras bus byed dang bral 'bras bsdus/ / lhan cig 'byung dang mjug thogs 'byung / / dus gzhan 'byung dang mi skye bzhi/ / yod phyir byed 'bras rnam smin dang / / rgyu mthun gnyis las logs su bstan/ / dge sogs su yang gcig pa ste/ / ma sgrib sogs kyang ma gtogs so/ /gnyis pa ma sgrib sems kyis ni/ / sems byung mtshan nyid bcas lnga bcu/ / rang gi rtsa ba'i mtshan nyid bzhi/ / rjes mthun bzhir bcas nga brgyadaskyed/ / tshur la lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen/ / nga bzhis byed de rjes mthun gzhis/ / dngos su mi nus nying bran bzhin/ / sgrib pa'i skal mnyamakhyad chos gsum/ / no rtul dang ni dus mnyam pa/ / dbang po rgyu rgyas ma nyams pa'o/ / zag med khams su ma gtogs phyir/ / zag bcas rang sa'i mnyam khyad par/ / ma 'ongs go rim med phyir dang / / kun 'gro 99

/skal mnyam rang 'bras las/ / sngar skyes nges phyir dus gnyis pa/ / las gzhan yod kyang ma bshad lo/ / byed rgyu rtag phyir 'dir ma bshad/ / mdo sde pa dang bye smra gnyis/ / 'gog bden bral 'bras byed 'bras dang / /med dgag yin min rtsod tshul mang / / dpe ston ma byas dmigs rkyen min te mdor/ / rnam shes skyed pa'i rgyu gang yin pa dang / / rkyen gang yin de dag kyang mi rtag na/ / gsungs zer bye smras skyed pa'i gsungs phyir zer/ / skyes bu pa ni lhan mtshungs gnyis/ / de la de las gzhan yang yod/lung bstan phyis 'byung rgyas byung gcod/ / rgyu mthun 'bras la cha gnyis te/ / skal mnyam la ni rnam pa 'dra/ / kun 'gro dang ni ris 'dra'o/ /de phyir skal mnyam kun 'gro'i rgyur/ / mu bzhi 'dod chags kun 'gro min/'jig lta ris gzhan skal mnyam min/ / 'jig lta rang ris gnyi ga yin/gang mthus gang skyes byed 'bras gsungs/ / dpyad/ / 'o na 'gog bden 'dir mi rung / / ma skyes phyir zer gang spel las/ / thob la skye ba'i sgrar gdags gsungs/ / rgyal phras ma las de yin yang / / rtag phyir 'dir ni ma bshad gsungs/ / gang spel bshad pa gzhung dang mthun/ /byed rgyu ma gtogs lnga yis 'dzin/ / 'dzin pa skyed pa'i nus ldan don/ /yang na 'bras bu yin pa'i don/ / kha cig 'bras bu'i mtshams 'dzin zer/lhan mtshungs gnyis kyis de ltar 'byin/ / gnyis kyis 'das dang da ltar te/ / skal mnyam kun 'gro dag sgras bsdus/ / rnam smin 'das pa kho nas 'byin/ / skal mnyam 'bras bu 'byin 'dzin la/ / dmigs med dge dang mi dge sgrib/ / ma sgrib lung ma bstan bzhi dang / dmigs bcas sems kyang dge sogs bzhir/ / bzhi bzhi byas pas re bzhi'o/ / nyon mongs can la rnam smin rgyu med cing / / rnam smin skyes la kun 'gro ma gtogs te/1ཿ

༄/ /mngonasamadzodakyibasdusado nargyamatshor 'jugapa'itsho jingagagazhan rnams kun 'gro rnam smin gnyis char dang / / zag med dang por de gnyis skal mnyam yang / / de yang sems dang sems byung dbang byas kyi/ gzugs kyis bsdus pa'i nyon mongs can sogs bzhir/ / mtshungs ldan ma gtogs lhag ma sngar bzhin sbyar/ /rgyu dang rkyen gcig rgyas bsdus phung khams bzhin/ / byed rgyu ma gtogs lnga po rgyu rkyen yin/ / de ma thag rkyen 'bras 'dra phyir/ / bar du chod kyang rigs 'dras min/ / rgyud rgyu yang mtshungs de ma thag rkyen lo/ / nyams pa'i nyon mongs dngos kyi nyer len 'dra/ /slob dpon gyis bkag de ma thag rkyen dang / / mtshungs pa de ma thag rkyen mu bzhi ste/ / 'jug sems ldang blo'i de ma thag rkyen min/ /'jug sems 'gog stoms dang po'i mtshungs de min/ / gnyis yin 'jug sems snyoms 'jug sems dang po/ / gnyis min 'jug sems snyoms 'jug gnyis pa'o/ / sems med phyir na gsum pa gzung bar dka'/ /zhib char mtshungs pa de ma thag pa zer/ / gzhan las lhag pa'i phyir na bdag rkyen no/ / lhan mtshungs 'gag dang da ltar la byed cing / / rnam smin skal mnyam kun 'gro skye la'o/ / de ma thag dang dmigs rkyen gnyis po la/ / rgyu yis byed tshul gnyis po bzlog ste sbyar/ / sems la rkyen gzhi 'gog la dmigs ma gtogs/ / gzhan la rgyu bdag gnyis so dbang phyug gtso/ /rdul dngos dus min rim sogs nges sogs phyir/ / 'byung bas 'byung la lhan cig skal mnyam gnyis/ /'byung 'gyur la ni byed rgyu lnga byed de/ / skye gnas rten rton 'phel ba'i rgyu yin phyir/ / sngar me skyed dang 'phel 'grib rjes 'gro ldog / re mos rtsig gzhi 'dra dang rgyun gnas byed/'phel bar byed phyir ro de skud rang nyid kyi/ / 'grel par skyed phyir rten phyiraganas phyir dang / / rton pa'i phyir dang 'phel byed phyir zhes gsungs/101

/'byung 'gyur phan tshun lhan cig skal mnyam dang / / rnam smin gsum mo 'byung la rnam smin gcig / lam gnas skabs brgyad de rgyun gyi tshe/ / sa mtshungs tshe dang nyid mtshams sbyor pa'i tshe/ / stoms par 'jug tshe de las ldang ba'i tshe/ / snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyis gzir pa'i tshe/ / sprul la 'jug tshe sprul las ldang tshe'o/ / 'dod sems dge las rgyu nas gnyis kyi bzhi/ / thob zin slob dang mi slob zag med gnyis/ / nying mtshams spyor tshe 'dod dge skyes thob las/ / gong ma'i sgrib gnyis 'dod dge sbyor byung las/ / gzugs dge sbyor byung ngo mi lcogs med nyid zer/ / la la khyad par can 'dod dbyangs sgogs ni/ / thod rgal tshe na gnyis pa'ang 'byung ngo gsungs/ / gzugs med dge min bzhi yis ring phyir te/ / gzugs la 'dod pa'i sprul sems mngon byed kyang / / gzugs med gang yang mi nus rten gyis ring / / 'dod la rags pa'ang mi lha rnam pas ring / / 'dod la mi dmigs phyir na dmigs pas ring / / 'dod pa'i gnyen po mi byed gnyen pos ring / / dge de rgyun sa'i bzhi dang snyoms 'jug las/ / ldang tshe zag med gnyis dang gzugs kyi dge / sbyor byung ngo de tshe skyes thob 'jug mi srid/ / nyon mongs kyis gzir gzugs kyi sgrib las te/ / de las mchog phyir ro de ltar brgyad las 'byung / / gzugs kyi sgrib las 'byung pa'i dge 'dod par/ / ma nges rang rang 'og mas bstan phyir ro/ / 'di ni 'og ma dag la ci rigs sbyar/ / mi dge rgyun sa'i bzhi dang mtshams spyor tshe/ / gong ma'i drug las 'byung ngo rang las bzhi/ / sgrib pa bcu las skyes shing de las bzhi/ / ma sgrib bzhi dang sprul tshe gzugs dge las/ / de las bzhi dang gong skyes nyon mongs gnyis/ / sprul las ldang tshe gzugs dge bdun 'byung ngo / / gzugs dge rgyun sa'i gsum dang ldang 102

da / /casangazug / 05rgyab pa'itāpyo stengabagaba'i tshe/ / 'dod dge sprul la 'jug tshe 'dod ma sgrib/ / mtshams sbyor 'dod nyon gnyis dang gong ma'i sgrib/ / snyoms 'jug gzugs med dge dang zag med gnyis/ / 'byung ngo rang gsum 'jug tshe 'dod dge dang / ldang tshe zag med gnyis dang gzugs med dge / sprul las ldang tshe 'dod pa'i ma sgrib dang / / sngar bzhin gzir tshe gong ma'i sgrib las 'byung / /sgrib pa rgyun sa'i gsum dang mtshams sbyor tshe/ / gzugs med gsum dang 'dod pa'i ma sgrib dge / nyon mongs can las gong ma min gsungs phyir/de las gsum dang spyor tshe 'dod nyon gnyis/ / gzir tshe 'og dge 'byung zhing ma sgrib las/ / gsum dang sbyor tshe gong 'og nyon mongs gsum/ /gzugs med ma sgrib pa yang phyogs 'dir 'dra/ / gzugs med dge la gsum dang ldang ba'i tshe/ / gzugs dge snyoms 'jug tshe na zag med gnyis/spyor tshe 'dod nyon gnyis dang gzugs kyi sgrib/ / 'byung ngo rang gsum 'jug tshe gzugs dge dang / / ldang tshe zag med gnyis so gzugs med kyi/ sgrib pa rgyun sa'i gsum dang mtshams spyor tshe/ / 'og ma'i dge dang ma sgrib bzhi las 'byung / / de las gsum dang sbyor tshe 'dod nyon gnyis/ /gzugs kyi sgrib pa'o gzir tshe gzugs dge 'byung / / khams gsum dge dang zag med gnyis te lnga/ / slob dang mi slob gnyis la mthun par sbyar/bcu gnyis nyi shur phye tshul gzhung nyid gsal/ / gzugs na bzo med kun rdzogs gos bcas phyir/ / nyi shur phye ba'i dgos pa khams gang na/ / thos bsam sgom yod shes dang 'chi sems kyang / / dge bas byed tshe'ang 'chi sems mi gsal phyir/ / skyes thob kho nas byed dang ma sgrib pas/ / byed tshe rnams smin sbyong lam gyis byed kyang / / bzo dang sprul sems gsal phyir mi byed dang / / 'dod las gzhan la skyes thob mi gsal phyir/ / 'jug ldang 103

༄/ /sbyor byung kho nas byed rtogs phyir/ / gzugs med gzugs su skyes tshe dge nyon gnyis/ / 'dod gzugs sprul sems gnyis rnyed nyams tshe gnyis/ /gzugs med nyon mongs kyis nyams de dang slob/ / gzugs skyes dge mngon myur tshe gsum gsar du/ / rnyed srid sprul sems gnyis dang rang nyid do/ /slob mngon gyur la bzhi srid rang nyid dang / / sprul sems gnyis dang gzugs med dge ba'o/ / slob pa 'phags pa yin pa 'dir yang bshad/ lhag ma drug tshe rang rang gcig pu rnyed/ / dga' dang skyabs med na ra ka / / mi ldog yid btags bre ta ste/ / dud cing 'gro bas tirya ka /dmyal brgyad gling bzhi lha drug ste/ / nyi shu grang dmyal gling phran min/ /'khor phyir nyi tshe nges med phyir/ / ma bgrang ba las grang dmyal brgyad/ /gling phran brgyad dang bcas so drug / dge chung bde chung sogs su'ang btags/ / bzhi la gzugs can gnas med do/ / srid po rnga yab gling gnas mi/ / lha min 'gro ba gsum du bshad/ / sprul sems chags bral la yod phyir/ / de la ji ltar rgyas she na/ / gzhan gyis rgyas shing rang gis kyang / / nyams dran chags skyed des sprul ba'i/ / dro rong skye phyir brgyud nas yin/ / bar min dri za lha'i rol mo/ / gzhan yang ci rigs tshul gyis bsdus/ / 'dir bstan khams dang 'gro ba la/ / mu bzhi grang dmyal bar do sogs/ / bar do'ang gzugs sogs rten can te/ / bar 'da' gzugs su 'da' phyir ro/ / mngal du mtshams sbyar gzugs khams mtshar/lngar skyes tshangs ris lha rnams ni/ / 'du shes gcig kyang phyi skyes rnams/phyis 'byung 'dod pa'i lha mi ltar/ / gnyis ka tha dad 'od chung sogs/nyer bsdogs dngos gzhi'i btang snyoms bdes/ / skyo bas res byed shes 1khu

༄ / /mngon pacas(da 〉༅ 'jub pa'i༄1gzingagatha dad/ / gsum par bde bas skyo med lo/ / dpe ston rgan gzhon me 'jig tshe/ /'jig bcas 'jig med phyir zhes bshad/ / gsum par lus dang 'du shes gcig / ngan song sdug bsngal rtse 'gog pa/ / bzhi pa 'du shes med pas 'joms/ / bzhi pa srid rtser bcas te dgu / bdun gyi nang tshan rnam shes bzhis ma bsdus/ / bzhi pa'i gzugs phung la sogs bdun gyis min/ / mngal du skye mched dod las gzhan sgong skyes/ / lnga len bu dang ri dwags 'dzin gyi bu/ / mchims ṭīka de'i ma sa ga'i bu zhes bshad/ drod gsher nga las nu dang de'i brla las/ / mdzes dang nye mdzes gnyis so tshangs byin gyi/ / brang las bu mo thi ba'i 'phreng ldan ma/ / shing las a mra skyong ma'o mchims ṭīka las/ / mdzes dang nye mdzes phrag skyes brla las ni/ / mdzes ldan mdzes can brang las phreng ldan zer/ / mkha' lding bzhi yi gcig gis klu bzhi za/ / bye smra kha cig yi dwags rdzus skyes zer/zhag rer du bcu za ba du mar bshad/ / skye gnas mchog dang mang ba rdzus skyes ni/ / yin yang dgos pa gsum phyir ston pas dor/ / phal chen sa ston bar srid med de mdor/ / bram ze na tshod khyer zin rga ba dang / / na bayin te gshin rje'i drung du phyin/ / bar na khyod kyi gnas kyang yod min zhing / /khyod kyi lam rgyag kyang ni yong ma yin/ /zhes dang lus des dmyal lhung gsungs phyir yang / / bar srid med zer gzugs rgyun rim 'gro ste/'bru bzhin no chad nas 'byung ste gzugs brnyan zer/ / sha shel 'byung 'gal gzugs gzhan med phyir dper/ / ma grub grub kyang rgyun min phyir mi mtshungs/ / mgur nas srid pa bdun gsungs mdo yis 'grub/ / mi 'don mngal 'jug dri za nyer gnas gsungs/ / phung po zhig pa nyer gnas zhes 'don na/ / rta len bu'i mdor de yi rigs dang phyogs/ / gang nas 105

/'ongs dris zhig la ji ltar rung / / mi 'don phyir mi 'ong lngar gsungs mdos 'grub/ / phal cher bar ma do bya'i lha zhig lo/ / la la tshe yi bar dang tshe phal cher/ / rdzogs nas 'da' ba bar 'da' skyes 'da' lo/ /gzugs med bar 'da' yod par thal phyir min/ / nyid kyi 'grel par drangs pa'i sdom tshig las/ / bsam gtan dag gi bcu tshan bzhi/ /gzugs med kyi ni bdun tshan gsum/ / 'du shes kyi ni drug tshan du/ /mdzad nas tshoms su yang dag bsdebs/ / zhes te bar 'da' dor phyir ro/mngal gnas dmyal ba'i srid pas bsreg min te/ / las kyis mtshams bcad phyir ro 'og min gyi/ / khri dang drug stong ldan yang 'dir 'grub rung /ma ning long pa'ang de tshe dbang po tshang / / glang chen rnam par lhums zhugs rmi lam tsam/ / mnar med bar srid brgyad khri bzhi stong thub/ /'khorasgyur skye srid nyon mongs can nam dpyad/ / lnga len bu ni rang rgyal yin yang rmongs/ / mi thogs lcags gong nang shi srin 'bus shes/ / the tshom yid mi byed rmugs gnyid rgod sogs/ / bcu gcig skyon bral sgom byung migadag pa/ / rta glang khyi dom dus bzhir 'dod spyod pas/ / gzhan tshe bong bu ba min spyad dred 'gyur/ / mngal gyi lnga dang bcas pa'i gnas skabs lnga/ / nur mer nar po mkhrang 'gyur rkang lag 'gyus/ / byis gzhon dar ma dar yol rgas pa'o/ / tshe dang yan lag rgyud sogs gzhan du blta/ / bye smras reg tshor lhan cig bsgyur rgyur 'dod/ / dpe ston khams gsum dge sogs gsum gyi slob/ / slob la yod phyir sa mang por bshad kyi/ma khyab reg la tshor med rang 'grel gsungs/ / btang snyoms yid byed gnyis la'ang 'dra'am dpyad/ / dbang tsher nyer rgyu med kyang mdo yi don/de yis yid kyi nyer rgyu sgrub la dgongs/ / gsum pa'i bde ba'ang brtan 106

༄ / /mngon rtsa da mi 'jub pa'i༄ gagingagaphyir nyer rgyu min/ / slob dpon rang lugs yul der chags bral bas/ /der dmigs zag bcas tshor ba'ang nyer rgyu min/ / chags sdang gnyis dang mtshungs par ldan min phyir/ / phrag dog ser sna khro 'tshig 'gyod pa ste/ /chig rkyang thub pa lnga las gzhan pa yi/ / rang sa'i nyon mongs log lta yis kyang sbyor/ / skye 'chi lung bstan min nyid gong ma'i lugs/ / mchims ṭīka 'tshig pa'i tshab tu 'chab pa bgrang / / srid pa gzhan gsum la ni dge sogs gsum/ / bar srid ma gtogs gsum po gzugs med na'ang / /khams dang zas la mu bzhi zag med khams/ / reg pa khams zas sdug bsngal tshor ba'o/ / phyi mas gnod phyir zas su ma bshad kyang / / dmyal ba'i khro chus skom pa sel phyir zas/ / dgra bcom rnam smin spyod lam gnyis kyis 'da'/ / gang spel mi dge spangs shing zag med gsal/ / zag bcas rnam smin bcas phyir 'dis 'dor gsungs/ / kun btus sdud phyogs mang yang snying gar 'pho/ / phal chen yab sras mjal sogs tshul mang bas/ / 'di las gzhan pa dus 'khor gcig pu min/ / rlung 'jam ldang tshe chags pa'i mgo rtsom yang / / rlung dkyil min te yas nas chags pa'i phyir/ / 'thab bral ma chags bar du de mi chags/ / chu dkyil mi 'bo las kyis brten pa ste/ / bza' btung ma zhu long khar mi lhung bzhin/ / sde gzhan rlung gi bang bas bskor bar 'dod/ / rlung la gnas zhes rus sbal la sogs 'gog / chu mtsho bsdoms kyang gser dkyil mi khebs te/ /'bum phrag bcu gnyis brgyad brgya don lnga las/ / med kyang g.yas g.yon re rer chig stong dang / / nyis brgya brgyad cu rtsa phyed brgyad lhag go / la la 'bru phung bzhin du rtse rting zer/ / lcags ri gnya' shing 'dzin gyi chu mtshams yan/ / sum brgya phyed dang bcu gsum bzhi khri'o/ / klu dbang 107

/ /rol gnas zab mtshungs rang rang ri'i/ / chu mtshams yan dang zheng mtshungs gzhung lugs las/ / bsil dang zhim dang yang ba dang / /'jam dang dwangs dang dri nga med/ / 'thungs na mgrin dang lto ba la/ / mi gnod yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ / zhes so mi yi bzhin yang rang gling 'dra/bi sha tsi skad smra phyir sgra mi snyan/ / mtha' chus bskor phyir gling zhes sher mdor gsungs/ / khyad chos lnga pa phal bas mi bgrod pa'i/ / gangs dang nye bar mtsho la bdun bskor nas/ / gaṅgā siskyo pa si ta 'bab/ / las stobs che phyir dmyal sogs gling 'di'i 'og / yod do 'bru phung 'dra phyir tshud par smra/ / sa las ma dros mtsho yi'o 'og tu gsungs/ / yi dwags gtso bo mi dges 'phang ba ste/ / dmyal srung yang ngo de 'bras phyis myong yang / /las kyis mtshams bcad phyir na tshe der min/ / dpe ston 'byung ba 'or lug ri bzhin zer/ / sems tsam sems su smra ste spyod 'jug mthun/ /dus 'khor go la'i dbang gis mi 'chol gsungs/ / go lar 'khrul nas rlung gcig smra mi rung / / nyi ma'i snying por rnga bong byed por bshad/ / shambha la srol bde mchog stod 'grel las/ / rab byung rnam byung sogs gsungs rgya nag gi / lo skor bcu gnyis shing me sa lcags chus/ / phye bar gnad gcig 'on kyang mgo mi mnyam/ / kha cig dus kyi dang po lo yin te/ / zhag ni nyi zla'i bar du med do lo/ / dbugs kyis brtsis pa'i de ni kun tu rung /dus kyi rnam grangs a ma ra koṣar/ / de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig / de dag bco lnga phyogs su grags/ / snga phyi'i phyogs ni dkar nag gnyis/ / de gnyis bsdoms pa 'jal byed do/ / mchu zla la sogs gnyis gnyis la/ /de tshigs de gsum bgrod pa gcig lho byang bgrod pa gnyis la lo/ / zhes so tshes zhag khyim gyi zhag zla lo/ / phyogs re'i bco lnga'i cha ni tshes zhag ste/108

༄/ /mngonapamadzodakyibasdusad nargyamatshor 'jugasa'itsho jingaganam langs nam langs bar ni nyin zhag go / nyi ma ldog nas ldog bar brgya brgyad cu'i/ / cha 'am lug glang 'khrig pa garka ṭa/ / de bzhin seng ge bu mo srang sdig pa/ / gzhu dang chu srin bum pa nya rnams kyi/ / nang nas khyim gcig rdzogs par sum cu'i cha/ / khyim zhag go de'i sum cu de zla sogs/ /khyim zla'i yun tshad skar khyim gnyis gnyis dang / / skar rkang re res rdzogs phyir rags rtsis su/ / tshes zhag so gcig zhib par zhag sum cu/ / chu tshod gcig srang lnga bcu dbugs bzhi dang / / 'dod cha brgyad kyis khyim zla gcig rdzogs phyir/ / khyim lor tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig 'byung / /yar ngo nyin zhag mar ngo tshes zhag dang / / lo la khyim zhag gtso phyir gzhan smra 'khrul/ / gsum po phyi ma phyi ma'i dod mi thub/ rgya nag zla bshol stag sprul sprel phag bzhi'i/ / rang rang zla bstun gso sbyong der mthun no/ / rgyun gyi bcu bzhi pa ni lo dri las/ / rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga can/ chu stod khrums smadaspen drug can/ / 'di rnams kyi ni nag po'i phyogs/ / zla phyed gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa/ / blo gros legs bzang gling bzhir dus mnyam ste/ / lho bgrod mthar thug phyi dro nub gling gi / lho mthar nyi ma gnas pa mthong phyir te/ / dkyus gcig rgyu skar phyed lhag 'dir mthong phyir/ / rlung nye myur phyir zhag gcig 'khor ro lo/ / 'di ni paṇa chen gyis kyang 'thad lo byas/lo mgo shar lugs hor zla brgyad pas bzung / / nye ma'i snying por brten rnams dgu ba zer/ / 'dul mngon mkhas mang bcu pa'i mar ngor gsungs/rgya dang hor gyi rgyal pos dbo zlar bshad/ / gser 'od dbyar ra snon nas lo mgo bzung / / gdan bzhi rdo rje mkha' 'gror rgyal nas te/ / nag rtsis so ma rā dzar bcu gcig pa/ / nag rtsis phal cher hor zla bcu gnyis pa/ /dus 'khor yar ngo sngon 'gro'i nag zla dang / / mar ngo sngon 'gro'i byed tshe sa 109

/gas so/ / gnam la sgra can rlung dang rang 'gros kyang / / g.yas skor nyi zla'i rang 'gros g.yon skor ro/ / sa la khyim dang dus bzhi bcu gnyis zla/g.yas skor ro bcu gnyis dum bur khyim bcu gnyis/ / mnyam gnas zla ba ren sngon mar ro/ / zla ba dum bur mi 'dra yod med dpyad/ / shar gyi dgun mtha' sa gas nya dgos te/ / zla bas zhag gcig nya skar mang mi spyod/sa gar dpyid kyis ma khyab bcu gnyis 'gyur/ / gzhan gyi lo mgo nyin mtshan nam yin dpyad/ / 'dul mngon mgo zla zla ba bcu gnyis gang / /zhe na yar ngo mar ngo phye nas brjod/ / nor lha brgyad dang drag po bcu gcig dang / / nyi ma bcu gnyis tha skar bu gnyis te/ / nye dbang so gnyis brgya byin gzugs bzhin skye/ / sprul par spyod pa gnyis te 'dod spyod gsum/tshangs ris 'dzam gling bar snyed tshangs mdun 'phags/ / gzugs can bar bskal bzhi bcur bar bskal byas/ / stong gsum lcags ri mdzod rtsar bshad dam dpyad/ / 'jig pa'i bskal pa'i me ni rangs sa bsdus/ /rkyang ba gnyis po bul phyir khug par mnyam/ / 'phel 'grib mchims kyis dge sdig la rag gsungs/ / bsod grags gang spel drangs nas nyis brgyar bshad/ / gnas pa'i mgo ni dpag med nas 'grib ste/ / 'di'i gcig dmyal bar skyes pa nas yin phyir/ / sa sder brten nas brgyad khrir 'dod pa 'khrul/ / nyi zla skar gsum las ni 'phyi 'am dpyad/ / 'khrig rku gsod rdzun rnams kyang rim 'byung ste/ / rdzogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis ldan rtsod ldan dang / / bstan pa rdzogs ldan la sogs rnam grangs mang / / sngon tshe bar bskal nyi shu thub gsungs dpyad/ / bskal chen gcig la mi lo mi 'khrugs bdun/ / 'dir ni sangs rgyas 'byung dus spyir bstan kyang / /dmigs bsal maze bong can du bcu pa'i tshe/ / skar ma la dga' 'byung 110

༄/ /mngonapamadzodakyibasdusad nargyamatshor 'jugapa'igrubajingagazhing brgyad khri las/ / sngar yang 'byung ba bskal pa gzhan la yod/ / byang sarabaskal pa chen po re re yang / / grangs med tshul gsungs rgyan snang sna tshogs gsungs/ / mang bkur 'od mdzes dge ba dge mchog dang / /gso sbyong 'phags te sngon gyi rgyal po lnga/ / nga las nu nas mdzes ldan lnga 'khor bsgyur/ / bar bskal gsum du skye ba 'gog phyir 'bad/ /rig byed nags la me zhugs bzhin gnas phyir/ / ngag gi tshogs pa'i gdangs gcig de yin gyi/ / ming tshig gcig tu lung ma bstan phyir ro/ /gnas mas mi 'jig gzhan 'gro'i rdzas zhig 'dod/ / skad cig ma phyir rgyu med 'jig phyir ro/ / sgyur phyir tho ba bum pa'i 'jig rgyu lo/ / mes kyang rdza bum ngo bo sgyur byed phyir/ / phan gnod gnyi ga'i byed por thal bar 'gyur/dpe ston rdzas grub dbyibs zhig rig byed min/ / dbyibs ni reg pas shes phyir rdzas ma grub/ / reg byar thal phyir kha dog la btags zer/ / phra rab la med phyir yang rdzas med lo/ / rig min sgrub byed bzhi dang skul byed mdor/ / kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang / / mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang / / glo bur nad pa nad g.yog dang / / yul ngan byung tshe sbyin pa ni/rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun/ / bzhugs dang gshegs rtsom lam zhugs dang / / phyin pa thos dang mthong ba dang / / chos thos bslab pa'i gzhi 'dzin la/ / dga' dang dad pa skye ba ni/ / rdzas las ma byung bsod nams bdun/ / rig min khyad chos gsum las rgyu mthun gyis/ /ma bskyed chos bzod sdom pa'o skye tshul/ / 'dod gtogs rgyu mthun zin pa'i 'byung las skye/ / lus ngag tshogs phyir spong ba'i 'byung tha dad/ / gong ma ma zin rgyas byung 'byung las skye/ / sems dang 'dra phyir 'byung ba'ang tha dad med/ / mthong spangs kun slong ni gsungs dus la dgongs/ / rjes 111

/ /'jug mu dgu thub par gsum las med/ / mnyam gzhag 'phags lam gnas gnyis da ltar ldan/ / gsungs phyir sems rjes 'brang ngo sdom gnyis la/ / yig char rig byed byed min gnyis gsungs dpyad/ / gzugs can bcu ni sgom spang nyid phyir ro/ / dngos gzhir gyur pa'i bar chad med lam gyi/ / zag med sdom pa spong sdom yin min dpyad/ / sdom dang sdom min bar ma rnam rig min/ / yod par ma nges yod na dus gnyis ldan/ / rig byedabyed min ldan la'ang chu bzhi ste/ / rig min ma thob pa yi sems zhan pas/ / gsod sogs las lam rdzas byung ma yin pa'i/ / dge sdig byed do 'di la zhib cha dgos/ / snga ma'i rnam rig btang zhing phyi ma 'di/ / ma thob 'phags pa rig min kho nar ldan/ / gnyis ldan sa thar sdom pa thob ma thagagang dang mi ldan gzugs med so skye'o/ / 'dod gtogs sdom pa sbyor dngos thams cad dang / / sems can yin min gnyis las so 'di nyid ni/'das dang ma 'ongs las min sdom gzhan gnyis/ / bcas dang sbyor mjug las min phyir mu bzhi/ / sbyor ba sbyor bas spangs zin yin nam dpyad/ / yan lag mang nyung rgyu dge chung 'bring che/ / 'dir 'phros skyes bu gsum gyi rnam gzhag bshad/ / mi dge'i rtsa gsum gcig car mngon gyur pa/ / med phyir sdom min rgyu tshogs kun las min/ / bshan par skye bas las der zhugs pa dang / / gzhan gyis khas len pa las sdom min thob/ /dngos gzhi'i sdom pa sa 'phos nyams pas gtong / / nyer bsdogs zhan phyir 'phags min 'chi bas gsungs/ / dngos gzhi'i sbyor lam gyis ni bden mthong 'gyur/ / sdom min gtong rgyu gsum mo bya rgya sogs/ / dor bas mi chog nad sos sman la ltos/ / bar ma'i dge dang mi dge gtong rgyu drug /dad dang sngar ba'i blo shugs chang bas gtong / / khas blangs dus tshod 112

༄༅/ /mngonapamadzodarjangasasado 'jugasa'i༄9gozengagardzogs pa blangs pa chad/ / bsnyen bkur bya zhes ma byas bya ba chad/ /gtsug lag khang sogs zhig pa don chad de/ / tshe chad dge rtsa chad pa yis kyang gtong / / sems mi brtan phyir ma ning sdom min zhing / / min der phal cher sdom pa skye rung dgos/ / yig char bde dang mi bde gang rung min/myong 'gyur lung ma bstan gsungs btang stoms dgongs/ / mchims mdzod phal cher ram nyer zhi'i bder dgongs gsungs/ / gsum pa man na'ang btang snyoms myong 'gyur yod/ / khyad par bsam gtan rnam smin yod phyir dang / / gcig car bde sdug btang snyoms myong ba zhig /gsungs shing 'dod las gzhan la mi rung phyir/ / rnam smin sdug bsngal dbang po'i tshor ba ste/ /yid mi bde la rnam smin mi bzhag phyir/ /lan du khyad par bsam gtan rnam smin la/ / dbang tshor bde ba 'jog dang tshor med par/ / smra ba mang yang gsum pa man la yang / / rang lugs btang stoms myong 'gyur bzhag gam dpyad/ / myong 'gyur lnga yi thog mtha' tshor ba ste/ / kha cig myong 'gyur gsum steng ma nges la/ / gnas skabs ma res rnam smin nges pa dang / / gnyis char ma nges pa ste lngar bshad cing / /dpe ston gnas skabs nges la rnam smin min/ / rnam smin nges la gnas skabs ma nges dang / / gnyis nges gnyis ka ma nges bzhir bshad do/ /gal te myong na mthong chos myong nges la/ / smin par ma nges dang po'o nges gzhan sla/ / kun la 'phen pa bzhi zhes spyir bstan nas/ / dmyal ba'i dge la mthong chos myong 'gyur med/ / chags bral phyis pas skyes myong mi byed pa/ /de med don te gsar bsags la sbyar na/ / lan grangs gzhan myong la yang thal phyir ro/ / 'dod rtses nyams kyang 'chi ba med phyir min/'dod pa'i bar dor bar do rang nyid dang / / mngal gyi lnga dang skye ba'i 113

/ /gnas skabs lngar/ / 'phen pa bcu gcig nges dang ma nges kyis/ / phye bas nyer gnyis de las nges bcu gcig / mthong chos 'bral can no bar srid skye srid gnyis/ / 'phen byed gcig gis 'phang ba'i ring mthun tshe/gcig pa gnas phyir mthong ba'i chos zhes btags/ / 'byung 'khrugs g.yeng ba ma gtogs 'phags la med/ / sgra mi snyan na spyo ba lnga char med/ /skrag pa'i sems zhi rnam smin las skyes kyang / / yid mi bde bar gtogs phyir rnam smin min/ / gzugs med dge ba dkar las 'di min te/ / rgyu 'bras tshang ba'i dbang byas min phyir lo/ / zag med las kyang dkar ba min gsungs pa/ / de la dkar ba'i rnam smin med la dgongs/ / mthong bzhi sgom lam brgyad de sems bcu gnyis/ / nag po zad byed do dgu ba'i 'dod dge ste/ / de srid der dmigs nyon mongs mi spong zhing / / de ni chags bral tshul gyis spong dgos phyir/ / dkar po zad byed mi brjod dgra bcom las/ / dkar po zad pa'i las su thal phyir ro/ / dpe ston brnab sems sogs kyang las su 'dod/ / dus kyi kun slong sdig kyang rgyu'i kun slong / / dkar na dger 'gyur 'dir mtshungs yig char gsal/ / g.yem bcol med phyir rig byed byed min gnyis/ / drug kyang rang gis byed na gnyis 'byung la/ / 'chi srid phra mor rig byed yod med dpyad/ / sdom pa'i dbang byas dge ba bdun kyang gnyis/ / sbyor mjug sdom pa'i spyor mjug gis spong zhing / / yid kyi gsum la sbyor mjug med gsungs phyir/'gags ma thag pa'i chags sdang rtsa bar bshad/ / dge dang mi dge bdun gyi nyer bsdogs ni/ / rnam rig ldan no drag na gnyis gar ldan/ / de phyir byed min 'gyur ba'am ma yin spros/ / 'on kyang lus kyis rdzun dang yid tsam gyis/ / srog gcod rdzogs pa yod phyir zhib cha dgos/ / mjug ni 114

༄ / /ma rngon pa na15catsukhyer 'jub pa'i༄1gzingagasbyor las bzlog ste rig min dang / / nges ldan de mthun byed na rig byed kyang / / log lta'i gzhan ni ming gzugs la sbyor dpyad/ / gong ma'i dge ba med cing 'dod sbyor byung / / sngar nas log lta chung ngus nyams phyir min/kha cig zag med gong ma'i yul can rnams/ / rang la dmigs sgos zag pa rgyas rung yang / / yul der dmigs pas rgyas par mi nus pas/ / stobs chung phyir na gcod byed min no lo/ / rang lugs des kyang gcod phyir kun gyis spros/ / sgom spang spong tshul ji bzhin rim dgus gcod/ / rtsa chad log par nges la mu bzhi'o/ / sbyor tshe dgu po gcig car ro mtshams med can/ / tshe der mi sbyor rgyu'i ngang rkyen stobs kyis/ / chad gnyis dmyal nas 'chi dang skye tshe sbyor/ /mi dge'i rtsa gsum gcig car mi srid phyir/ /mang na rang nyid brnab sems log g.yem gnas/ / lus ngag gzhan drug bcol bas brgyad 'byung srid/ / brnab sems gnod sems med pa 'bral med phyir/ / gcig dang min no gnyis dang lhan cig pa/ / dbang shes dge dang gzugs med la brten pa'i/ / zad shes sogs te rnam shes lnga yi blo/ / nges rtogs med phyir lta min gsungs phyir dang / / zad dang mi skye'i blo lta min gsungs shing / / gzugs la brten na spong bdun 'byung phyir bkag / gzugs med yid shes dge ba gzhan la gsum/ /lung ma bstan gnas dge bsnyen spong ba bzhi/ / de ni dbang shes dge bas len na drugalung ma bstan gyi bsnyen rdzogs spong ba bdun/ / dbang shes dge bas de dgu yid dges bcu/ / sdom pa'i dbang byas yin gyi bar ma la/ / lung ma bstan gyis spong ba gcig len na/ / gcig ldan yid shes dge ba gnyis dang lnga/ / len pa lnga brgyad ldan yang 'dir ma bshad/ / gzugs med 'phags par zag med sdom 'das ldan/ / rang 'grel de la ma 'ongs ldan 115

༄/ /gsungs dpyad/ / gzugs med 'du shes med pa lhag par byas/ / khams dang 'gro na dge bdun mngon gyur yod/ / dmyal bar snga ma'i srog gcod ldan nam dpyad/ / glu len log 'tshor 'gro med mdo dang 'gal/ / yid kyi gsum gyis 'bras gsum 'grub tshul dpyad/ / zag bcas zag med spong lam la lnga bzhi/ / spong min zag bcas zag med la bzhi gsum/ / dge 'bras dge la rnam smin ma gtogs bzhi/ / mi dger skyes bdag gzhan la rnam smin bsnan/ / mi dge'i 'bras dger skyes bdag mi dge la/ / rgyu mthun dang bcas gzhan la rnam smin bsnan/ / lung bstan min 'bras dge la skyes bdag gnyis/ / gzhan pa gnyi gar de steng rgyu mthun bsnan/ /yig char de 'bras lung ma bstan pa la/ / bral 'bras bdag 'bras ma gtogs gsum yod phyir/ / gsungs pa yig nor rnam smin med phyir ro/ —dge dang lung ma bstan pa phan tshun du/ / rgyu mthun ma gsungs mi dge la gsungs pa/ / mchims ṭīka nyon mongs can du 'dra phyir gsungs/ /'gog bden dge 'bras min zhing lung ma bstan/ / yin na'ang de 'bras dge yin tshig la gzabs/ / 'das pa'i 'bras bu dus gsum bzhi bzhi ste/ bral 'bras dus kyis ma bsdus phyir na dor/ / da lta'i 'bras bu ma 'ongs 'ang de bzhin no/ / da lta'i da lta la ni skyes bdag gnyis/ / ma 'ongs ma 'ongs la ni bral 'bras dang / / rgyu mthun ma gtogs go rim med phyir ro/phyi mas snga ma mi skyed phyir ma bshad/ / rang gi sa pa bzhi ste bral ma gtogs/rgyu mtshan mdzod ṭīka de sas ma bsdus phyir/ / gsungs pa mi rigs sa dgu lam phan tshun/ / rgyu phyir sa gzhan gyis kyang zag med la/ / rang sa ji bzhin skyes bdag rgyu mthun gsum/ / byed par 'gal te sas bsdus min phyir ro/ / gzhan sa'i zag bcas skyes bdag gnyis las med/ / slob 116

༄ / /mchon paca dzad yis 'jub pa'igrub zengagapa'i 'bras bu slob dang mi slob pa/ / skyes bdag gnyis dang rgyu mthun gsum gsum dang / / gang yang min pa skyes bdag bral 'bras gsum/ /mi slob 'bras bu bdag 'bras gcig pu dang / / skyes bdag rgyu mthun gsum dang skyes bdag gnyis/ / nyams ma thag tu nyon mongs mngon gyur las/ / slob sems mi 'byung phyir na byed 'bras min/ / gnyi ga min pa'i 'bras bu slob sogs la/ / skyes bdag gnyis gnyis dang ni lnga char 'byung /mthong spangs 'bras bu spang bya rnam gnyis la/ / rnam smin bral 'bras gnyis dang bral 'bras dor/ / de 'bras spang bya min pa bdag gcig pu/sgom spangs 'bras bu spang bya rnam gnyis la/ / skyes bdag gnyis dang bral 'bras ma gtogs bzhi/ / zhi rags lam gyi bral 'bras yod pa'i phyir/ /spang bya min pa skyes bdag bral 'bras gsum/ / spang bya min 'bras bdag dang skyes bdag gnyis/ / spang bya min pa rnam smin ma gtogs bzhi/ /nyon mongs can ni rigs min skyed pa ste/ / kha cig spyod lam nyams pa'ang rigs min lo/ / rang 'grel sems med snyoms 'jug dag gis kyang / /ris mthun pa ni 'phen par mi byed de/ / las dang lhan cig mi 'byung phyir gsungs bas/ / 'phen byed de yi tshogs pa'i sdom pa'am/ / sems rten bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi gang yin dpyad/ / stoms 'jug thob par bcas de dzogs byed yin/ / nyon mongs shas che ba dang no pa las/ / gcig spangs snga phyir snga ma nyon sgrib yin/ / dbyen gyi ltung ba rdzun no dbyen ldan min/ /lha sbyin drang srong mngon shes lnga ldan du/ / skyes 'khor ston pas phye ba'i rnam smin lo/ / yul gtong ba la bu lon ldang ba bzhin/ / bzod sogs thob tshe las kyis shin tu 'gog / nges gnas khyad chos drug dang las gsog pa'i/gling sogs khyad chos drug kyang rtsa bar gsal/ / tog dkar mer mer 117

/ /mngon shes gsum gyis dpyad/ / bsod nams brgya yi 'dren tshul la bzhi ste/dge bcu'i spong sems 'god bsngags yi rang bsngo / / lnga bcu 'phen rdzogs dbye bas brgyar 'dod dang / / 'phen byed dang ni mi g.yo'i las la dpyad/ / las lam bcu la rgyu lnga dmigs pas bcur/ / dbye tshul dge bcu'i lam dag sbyor ba dag / rtog pas ma smras dran zin myang 'das su/bsngo ba lnga bcu de ltar smon lnga bcu/ / chos gzugs skur dmigs brgya ste mtshan so gnyis/ / ma 'dres bco brgyad dang bcas lnga bcu la/ /dmigs pa lnga bcu smon pa lnga bcu'o/ / khams gsum grol smon bdag grol smon pa dang / / 'dod pa nyi shu gong ma nyi shu dang / / grang dmyal brgyad la dmigs pa'i snying rje rnams/ / snga phyi gnyis gnyis dbye bas brgyar yang gsungs/ / bar du bdun khri lnga drug bdun stong bkur/ / ya gcig 'greng ste zhag bdun bstod pa ni/ / skyes bu khyu mchog khyod 'dra'i dge sbyong gzhan/ / 'jig rten gzhan dang lha yul sa la med/ / 'jig rten 'di na yod pa ma yin zhing / / rnam thos bu yi gnas na yod ma yin/ / lha yi pho brang gnas mchog dag na yang / / yod min phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag na'ang med/ / ri dang nags su bcas pa'i sa yi steng / / rgyas pa kun tu yul zhig ga la yod/ / sman gzhir bskal pa dgu phrag 'dums par gsungs/ rigs pas bskrun pa bris rko snyan ngag dang / / grangs sogs 'dzin pa lus ngag yid kyi las/ / kun byang rnam grangs smos pas mngon pa sdud/ /las de'i rtsa ba phra rgyas bye smras ni/ / chags sogs dpe ston sa bon gnas mas thob/ / phra rgyas nyon mongs gzhi gcig tha dad smra/ / 'dir yang tha ma'i chags sogs phra rgyas min/ / 'jug pa'am byed bcu mchims ṭīka las/ / rtsa ba brtan byed thob pa'i rgyun/ / rgyud gnas byed pa phra rgyas 118

༄ / /mngonasamadzod ngosasad 'jugasa'i༄1gozengagargyun/ /zhing ni rang rgyud phra rgyas gzhir/ / rgyu mthun sgrub pa nye nyon skyed/las kyi srid pa sgrub par byed/ / rang tshogs 'dzin pa tshul bzhin min/dmigs la kun rmongs mi shes nyid/ / rnam shes rgyun 'khrid srid par 'phen/ / dge las g.yo ba nyams pa yin/ / 'ching ba khams las mi 'da' ba/ / rnam pa bcu ni gnas 'dir yang / / rab tu bstan pa yin par 'dod/ / ces gsungs 'dod chags de bzhin zhes 'dod chags/ /rgyas rung de la khro sogs rgyas par bstan/ / thar blo zlog phyir bshad kyang slob dpon ni/ / ro myong sred yul lus ni srid pa nyid/ / yin phyir gsungs te gzugs med khams la dpyad/ / de ste bdun nam lta bcas phra rgyas bcu/ /so gnyis nyer brgyad nyer brgyad sdom pa yi/ / mthong spangs gya brgyad steng du sgom spangs bcu/ / kun btus mthong spang brgya rtsa bcu gnyis gsungs/ / bsdu bar bden pa phyi ma gsum gsum la/ / lta ba gnyis gnyis dor bas go bzhir gsungs/ / lam dang sdug bsngal tshul zhugs khyad par dpyad/ /phyi mas lam mthong spang byar dmigs sam brtagadangos gzhir mi dmigs spang bya ris gzhan phyir/ / nyer len phung dmigs bdag gam bdag gir dang / /der dmigs rtag chad lta shes nyon mongs can/ / 'jig mthar lta ba'o lam dmigs bdag 'dzin yang / /yod na zhen yul med par mngon sum du/ / rtogs pas spong phyir sdug bsngal mthong spang lo/ / sdug bsngal mthong spangs dmigs dang zag med 'gal/ /de phyir mkha' dmigs log lta bzhag par dka'/ / dpe ston dngos gzhi thob kyang 'dod nyon yod/ /mngon shes can gyis log lta'i srol btod phyir/ /bye smra de la sdig sems byung ba'i tshe/ /mngon shes nyams te lhasbyin bzhin zhes zer/ / dbang phyug rgyur lta rgyu la log zhugs phyir/ /119

/ /kun 'byung mthong spang zhe na rang byung rtag / bdag gi rnam pas 'jug phyir sdug bsngal lo/ / 'o na ba lang brtul zhugs la sogs pa/ / mtho ris rgyu dang thar pa'i lam lta ba/ / kun 'byung mthong spang mi 'gyur ci zhe na/ / bye smra'i tshul de sdug bden yin phyir zer/ / rang 'grel lam gyi de med thal pa 'phang / / rtag bdag phyin ci log pa gnyis tsam mam/ / ma yin gtsang bde rtag bdag bzhi yi phyir/ / de bzhi mtha' lta'i phyogs gcig lta mchog 'dzin/ / 'jig lta gsum sbyar log dang mthar lta'i phyed/ / sgro 'dogs med phyir tshul zhugs mtha' gcig tu/ / log min gzhan la nges rtog med phyirador/ / 'o na sems dang 'du shes phyin ci log / ma dor gsungs dang 'gal nges rtog med phyir zer/ / skyon med de ni lta ba'i dbang phyir ro/tshor bar thal bar mi 'gyur ma grags phyir/ / khengs lhag nga rgyal nga mngon cung zad log / lhag dang nga rgyal cung zad gsum las dgu/ / ma spangs mi spyod skye sred 'jig sred gnyis/ / spangs rkyang spyod pa gnyid dang mig la sogs/ / skal mnyam khams kun 'gro ba sdug kun gyi/ / lta bdun ze tshom gnyis dang ma rig gnyis/ / ma 'dres pa ste chags can kun 'gro min/ /'dod khams ma lus dmigs tshul med na yang / / ris lnga'i rang ldog tsam la gcig car dmigs/ / 'jig mthar ma gtogs dgu ni skal mi mnyam/kun 'gro 'dod pa'i tshangs pa rtag lta ba/ / log shes tsam ste lta ba lngas ma bsdus/ / bsam gtan mtha' dag srid rtser sa skal mnyam/ / ma gtogs med de 'og mar mi dmigs shing / / rang sar skal mnyam khams kyi ming med de/ / gzhan du sa bzhin khams dgur thal phyir ro/ / mchims ṭīka 'dod pa dang ldan gzugs gzugs med/ / dang ldan la dmigs phra rgyas gang dag ces/ / 'byung phyir gsungs kyang mchan bur gnyis bsdoms la/120

༄ / /mngonapamadzodakyilasdu nargyamatshor 'jugasa'itsho jingagadamigs srid gsum bsdoms pa la nus med gsungs/ / phra rgyas kun tu 'gro dang rgyu kun 'gror/ / mu bzhi ma 'ongs phra rgyas kun 'gro dang / / da lta'i de yi 'dus byas mtshan nyid bzhi/ / 'on kyang 'bras bu gzhan phyir thob ma gtogs/ / gnyis yin da lta'i phra rgyas kun 'gro'o/ / de ltar go brgyad las ni kun 'gro ba/ / kho na nyer bdun bzlog pa re lnga ste/ / sdug kun ma rig drug la cha gnyis so/ / 'gog lam yul can log lta the tshom rmongs/ / 'gog dmigs gsum po rang sa kho nar dmigs/ / sa drug chos shes kun kyang 'dod log lta'i/ / yul yin de bzhin sa dgu'i rjes shes kyang / / gzugs dang gzugs med kun gyi log lta'i yul/ / lam la chos shes khams gsum gnyen gsungs kyang / / gong ma'i log lta'i dmigs yul ma yin te/ / gong ma'i mthong spangs gnyen po mi byed phyir/ / lhag ma phra rgyas brgyad cu'i zag bcas dmigs/ / lung bstan min rtsa'i shes rab rnam smin sogs/ / je tshom rtse gnyis nga rgyal mthor 'jug la/ / rtsa ba brtan cing gting na gnas phyir min/ / kha che'i yul sogs mthar gnas nyi 'og pa/ / sred lta nga rgyal spyad pa'i bsam gtan pa/ / gsum po ma rig dbang gis 'jug phyir bzhi/ / dus kun mi skye yul yang khyad par phyir/ /khongakhro chags rgyal nyon mongs rang mtshan pa/ / lta dang ma rig the tshom spyi ba'o/ / 'das dang da lta'i khro chags nga rgyal gyi/ / dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ldan byed rgyud ldan min/ / ma 'ongs yid kun dbang pos da lta ba/ / 'on kyang mi skye dbang blos kun ldan byed/ / lhag ma lha sogs gsum gyis kun dang ldan/ / dus kun rdzas yod rtag 'gyur yod min na/ / ldan par 'gal zhes rtsod la bye smras lan/ / mdo las 'das gzugs yod par ma gyur na/ / zhes dang rnam shes gnyis rten skye gsungs phyir/ / rigs pas 121

/ /'grub ste dran pa'i yul yod phyir/ / 'das pa'i las kyis 'bras bu skyed pa'iphyir/ / thams cad yod par smra bas yod smra ba/ / 'bras bu 'das dang ma phyin da ltar yod/ / 'bras phyin 'das dang ma 'ongs rdzas med par/smra ba rnam par bye ste smra pa'o/ / de yang yod smra'i grangs yin dul ba lha/ /gzhi kun pa dang 'od srung sde/ / sa srung sde dang chos srung sde/ / mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / / rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde/ / thams cad yod par smra ba yin/ / zhes gsungs yod smra la yang lugs bzhi ste/ / chos skyob dngos 'gyur gser snod bzhin zhes zer/ / dbyangs sgrogs mtshan nyid shas che chags bzhin zer/ / dbyeg bshes gnas skabs rtsis kyi rde'u bzhin 'gyur/ / ma bu gzhan gzhan 'gyur ba sangs rgyas lha/ / dang po mi 'thad grangs can lugs phyir ro/ / gnyis pa mi 'thad mtshan nyid 'chol phyir ro/bzhi pa mi 'thad gsum gang thal phyir ro/ / gsum pas bya ba byas dang ma byasakyis/ / bzhag phyir cung bzang de la rtsod pa ni/ / de mtshungs mig gis gzugs la mi lta phyir/ / da ltar mi 'gyur ro zhe na bye smras ni/ / skyon med 'bras bu 'byen 'dzin byed phyir lo/ / rnam smin skal mnyam kun 'gro 'das pas kyang / / 'byin phyir da ltar thal lo de dag la/ / 'dzin pa ma tshang mtshang zhe na 'di'i cha nas/ / 'das dang 'byin pa'i cha nas da lta bar/'gyur phyir 'chol ba'am yang na phyed gar 'gyur/ / gzhan yang bya ba nges byed res mi byed/ / mi rung rtag tu yod phyir gegs byed su/ / de yang ji ltarakhya bas 'jug ces pa'i/ / bya ba 'das pa las ni gzhan min te/ /dus kyis ma bsdus phyir na rtag par 'gyur/ / bya ba 'das dang gcig na da lta yang / / yod phyir de 'gag cha nas 'das dus su/ / mi rung da ltar bzhin du dus gnyis kyang / / yod na ci phyir ma skyes zhig ces bya/ / ngo bo 122

༄/ /mngonapamadzodakyibasdusado nargyamatshor 'jugapa'igrubabangagaspangs kyang sdug bsngal mthong spangs dang / / 'dod nyon brgyad sogs dmigs pas ldan tshul gnyis/ / khams gsum spang bya bco lnga zag med bcas/ /'og ma 'og ma'i mthong spangs kun 'gro'i yul/ /'og ma gong ma'i nyon mongs yul min pas/ /sgom spangs yul 'gyur snyoms 'jug dag pa'i ste/ / bsam gtan dge yul yod dgu yin gsungs phyir/ / sdug bsngal mthong spangs lam mthong spang bya'i yul/ /min te lam la kun 'gro med phyir ro/ / sdug kun mthong dang sgom spangs gsum/ /'dod bsdus lnga yul gzhan brgyad bcu/ /khams gsum 'gog lam mthong spangs ni/ /rang bsnan drug dgu bcu gcig yul/ / chags sogs snon gyi zag med pa/ /kho na'i yul can lta sogs min/ / zag med khams gsum spang bya ris/ /tha ma gsum gsum zag med bcu'i/ / yul lo 'dod pa'i sgom spang dpyad/ / phra rgyas bcas la rgyas pas khyab bam na/ /nyon mongs can la bcas shing rgyas pa dang / / bcas kyang mi rgyas pa ste mu gnyis yod/ /spangs dang ma spangs phra rgyas rim bzhin no/ /nyon mongs can min la ni phyi ma med/ / yig char nyon mongs bcas la mi rgyas yod/ / dgra bcom rnams la 'das sems nyon mongs can/ / nyon mongs pa dang lhan cig gnas rnams dang / / ma 'ongs mi skye'i chos can sems nyon mongs/ /dang bcas lta bu yin pa'i phyir gsungs dpyad/ / 'dod na ris lnga'i gti mug lnga ma gtogs/ /khro chags nga rgyal gsum la lnga lnga dang / /lta ba bcu gnyis je tshom bzhi kun dkris/ / bcu ste zhe gcig 'dod pa'i zag pa dang / kun dkris nyi shu khong khro bcu bsal ba'i/ / gong mar spyod pa nga gnyis srid pa'i zag / rmug rgod kun dkris gong mar yod mod kyang / / ma bshad rang dbang can ni min phyir ro/ / 'dod pa'i rmug rgod sogs la 123

ra / / sa b.lathal bar 'gyur/ / khams gsum ma rig bco lnga logs su bstan/ / chu sbyor phal cher de dang 'dra na yang / / lta rnams rnam pa gsal phyir logs su bstan/ / de phyir 'dod pa'i chu sbyor nyer dgu re/ / srid sbyor nyer brgyad lta ba'i sum cu drug / ma rig bco lnga'o zag par lta ba rnams/ / zur min rkyang bas 'khor bar 'jog min lo/ / 'dod sbyor ma rig lnga bcas 'dod nyer len/ / srid sbyor ma rig bcu bcas bdag nyer len/ / lta ba sum cu brtul zhugs nyer len drug / rab byung khyim pa bslu phyir so sor bshad/ma rig rkyang bas mi 'jig phyir bsres lo/ / rang lugs gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang phyir yin/ / rtsa nyon drug gi kun sbyor drug las logs/ /mchog 'dzin gnyis po mchog 'dzin kun sbyor ro/ / lta ba snga gsum bden bzhis mthong spang rdzas/ / bco brgyad 'dir yang bco brgyad phyir phye lo/'di gnyis kho na mchog 'dzin phyir phyi'o/ / kun dkris nang nas phrag dog ser sna gnyis/ / mi dge rang dbang can phyir kun sbyor byas/ / kun dkris bcur smras kun sbyor bcu gcig 'gyur/ / sbyor dgus gang la bsgribs pa dbus mthar gsal/ / gnyis kyis sems can tha ma so sgyes dang / / gsum gyis khams mtha' 'dod las mi 'da' 'o/ / 'jig lta sdug bsngal mthong spang sgo gcig la/ / tshul zhugs sgo gnyis ze tshom sgo bzhi ste/ / de de spangs pas gzhan spang rtogs phyir lo/ / gzhan yang rim bzhin mthar lta lta mchog 'dzin/ / log lta'i rtsa ba yin phyir 'di gsum bshad/ / kun btus 'ching gsum sdug bsngal gsum la sbyar/ / nyon mongs las gzhan smos pa'i dgos pa ni/ / nyon mongs phra rgyas sam rtsa nyon thams cad dang / / nye bar nyon mongs byed pas nye nyon phyir/ / kun dkris brgyad steng la las khro 'chab bsnan/ / 'chab pa chags rmongs gang 124

༄༅/ /cas(na bca zhun kroḥsamado 'jub pa'i༄1gzingagalas skye ba rtsod/ / kun dkris brgyad dam bcu las lnga la ni/ / gnyis so lhagadang dri ma sgom spang nyid/ / 'gyod pa sgom spang ma rig nyid ldan par/mchims gsungs chung ngu'i sa bar 'gyur ram dpyad/ / gong gi rgyu mtshan 'gyod pa spyi'i phyir min/ / dkres ldang dri mar bcas te rang dbang can/mtshams spyod rang dbang can lnga las gzhan na/ / 'di dag 'byung dgos rang dbang can phyir 'gal/ / kun dkris bcu yi bdun dang dri ma druga'adod na mi dge'o rmug gnyid rgod rnam gnyis/ / gong skyes bzhi'o sgrib la lung ma bstan/ / kun dkris gnyis bzhi dri drug chung ngu'i sa/ / mthong spang la sogs yid shes kho nar 'byung / / rmug rgod the tshom gong mar yod mod kyi/ / 'dir bstan bsam gtan sgrib phyir 'dod kho na/ / rmug gnyid gnyen po zas dang bya ba gcig rgod 'gyod de bzhin no lngar nges rgyu mtshan ni/ / gnyis gnyis rim bzhin bslab gsum phung por gnod/ /shes rab med na bden la the tshom 'gyur/ / zhes zer slob dpon rang lugs ting 'dzin gyi/ / sbyor dngos rjes la sgrib pa'i dbang byas so/ /dmigs pa shes pas spong ba 'dod pa yi/ / sdug kun mi mnyam kun 'gro yin pa brgyad/ /gong ma'i sdug kun mthong spang sum cu ste/ /mi mnyam pa yang gcig car spong phyir ro/ / 'gog lam yul can log lta the tshom gnyis/khams dbye'i bcu gnyis dang bcas lnga bcu'o/ / rang la dmigs pa zad pas spong pa ni/ / 'dod pa'i skal ba mi mnyam kun 'gro dgu/ / rang gi dmigs pa spangs pa'i spong ba ni/ / log par log zhugs rnams te khams gsum na/ / 'gog lam mthong spang zag bcas la dmigs pa/ / dgu dang bdun bdun bsdoms pas nyer gsum mo/ / 'gog lam mthong ba'i spang bya ma rig drug / spong tshul gsum du ma bsdus rgyu mtshan tshol/ / mi 125

/ /'gal gsum po dmigs shes spong bas bsdus/ / gong sa tsam dmigs kun 'gro yod dam dpyad/ / mtshungs ldan las min dbye mi nus phyir ro/ /dmigs las spong ste gong 'og gzhung kun mthun/ / ye shes yongs shes yongs shes dngos yin la/ / spangs pa yongs shes rgyu ming 'bras btags so/ 'on kyang 'dir bstan spangs ba'i de la yang / / mthong drug sgom spang spangs ba'i yongs shes gsum/ / drug kyang shes pa'i 'bras bu yin mod kyi/bzod shes 'bras bu gcig phyir der bshad la/ / lhag ma gsum ni shes pa kho na'i ste/ / thod rgal bcu drug pa yi gnyis kyang ngo / / dngos gzhi'i mthong mtha' gsum dang sgom mtha' gnyis/ / dbyangs sgrogs tha ma'i cha mthun min brgyad de/ / 'dod gsum bral thob zag med rnyed phyir ro/ /tha ma'i cha spangs ldog pa rnyed mod kyi/ / lam mthong spang ba'i zhar yin phyir ma bgrang / / nam mkha'i nyer bsngogs 'bras bu gzugs zag zad/ /gzugs med dngos gzhi gsum la'ang kun zad nyid/ / zhi rags lam gyi 'bras bu bdun brgyad gnyis/ / rjes kyi gnyis so lam la chos shes ni/ /khams gsum gnyen po yin phyir de 'bras gsum/ / phyogs mthun chos bzod dang bsdoms chos shes 'bras/ / gsum steng 'dod pa'i mthong spang spangs pa'i gsum/ / rjes shes phyogs mthun bzod bcas 'bras bu ni/ /gong ma'i mthong spang gsum dang sgom spang gnyis/ / yongs shes 'jog byed bral thob zag med rnyed/ / srid rtse'i phyogs cha sdug bsngal mthong spang zad/rang sa'i kun 'gro gnyis bcom gsum tshang bas/ / drug bzhag mtha' gsum khams las 'das pas kyang / / ldan tshul gcig min gang na so skye'o/kun 'byung chos bzod man gyi 'phags pa yang / / mthong lam gzhan la gcig nas lnga'i bar ldan/ / sgom la rgyun zhugs gsar thob drug dang ldan/126

༄ / /mngon pacas(da kroḥ 'jub pa'i༄1gzingagachags bral 'bras thob tshe na bsdoms gsungs par/ / gnyis char 'doms na yin phyir 'dir mi 'gal/ / de tshe spang bsdoms yongs shes bsdoms pa min/ / dgra bcom 'dod nyon gyis nyams la yang drug /chags bral bcu drug pa la gcig ldan te/ / mthong lnga btang nas sgom gcig thob phyir ro/ / gong ma'i lam mthong spangs pa'i yongs shes mtha'i/cha mthun spang bar bsdus kyi med min te/ / de la dngos gzhi'i 'bras bu bshad phyir ro/ / gzugs spangs bcu drug pa la bdun brgyad gnyis/ /dgra bcom thob tshe btang nas dgu pa 'thob/ / nyams tshe dgu pa btang nas snga gnyis 'thob/ / lnga bshad zin la mthar gyis phyir mi 'ong / /mthong drug gtong ngo nyams tshe drug ka 'thob/ /mthong dang sgom pas spong zhes sngar bshad pa'i/ / lam dang mthong bya'i bden pa 'dir bshad do/ / mchims ṭīka mthong lam zag med rgyu mtshan du/ / mthong spang skor dgu mnyam spong 'jig rten pas/ / de mi nus gsungs phyir na des spong tshe/ / 'jig lta'ang skor dgur phye nas spong dam dpyad/ / 'di pas zag bcas thams cad sdug kun gnyis/ / dpe ston kun 'byung sred pa kho nar 'dod/ / sdug bsngal phyir bcos min pa bde ba zhig / 'dir yang med kyang sdug bsngal 'gag tsam la/ / bde zhes btags pa 'jog mtshams ma 'tshal bas/ / 'phags pa lha bkag bden pa gnyis las nyams/ /bum chu dbyibs dang tshogs pa'i kun rdzob bo/lus sems 'du 'dzi rnam rtog gnyis las bsrings/ / thar par bgrod pa'i gshegs shul mngon rtogs de/ / thar lam don no smin grol gnyis su bsdus/ / mdog dbyibs reg pa bsnyen bkur chags gnas bzhi'i/ /gnyen por 'du shes dgu bsngags tha ma yi/ / gnyen por shi ro g.yo ba med 127

༄/ /pa bsgom/ / mi sdug sgom tshul gsum po bye smra'i lugs/ / dang pos mi sdug rdzogs zhes grags pa 'thad/ / 'dod sems nyer bsngogs bzhi dang dngos gzhi lnga/ / dmigs pa 'dod pa'i dbyibs dang kha dog dkar/ / dang po gling gsum mis skyed phyis lha yang / / 'byung rdub shes rab 'jug byed dran pas btags/ / 'dod dang dang po gsum gyi nyer bsdogs dang / / khyad par can no btang stoms sdud dang mthun/ / rlung ni rnam smin min te chad nas sbyor/ / lus stobs 'phel bas 'grib phyir rgyas byung min/ / chos rnams thams cad dmigs pa dran nye ste/ / rang gzhan dbye pas bzhi char phyi nang gsum/ / tshogs lam klu dang gong mar mtshams gsungs dpyad/ /dang por chos la dmigs pa rnam gtod don/ / phyi nas gzhan gsum bsgom pas 'phel bar byed/ / bzod pa chung 'bring gtod byed drod rtse 'dra/ /'phel byed chos te sdom sdom dmigs phyir ro/ / gong 'og bden bzhi'i khyad chos so gnyis las/ / gong ma'i lam bor so gcig rigs bor bas/ /sum cu la sogs rnam pa re re nas/ / dor bas bzod 'bring bzhi brgya go bdun zer/ / ma bor so gnyis bsgom pa bzod chung yin/ / dmigs pa ma bor rnam pa mi 'bor pas/ / gong ma'i lam bzhi dor ba'i nyer brgyad nas/ / 'og ma'i lam bor nyer bzhi la sogs te/ / gong ma'i sdug bden bor nas 'og ma'i bzhi/ / gcig gnyis dor nas gsum gnyis tha mar ni/sred spyad gnyis te nga rgyal le lo can/ / lta spyod gnyis te bdag gi bdag lta bas/ / rim bzhin gcig la lan gnyis goms byed do/ / de phyir gcig gnyis 'dor bya skabs dang sbyar/ / rnam pa de ni chos bzod bar ru 'jug drod rtse 'dod la'ang dbyangs sgrogs bshad kyang gzhan/ /'phags pa gnyis par skyes tshe dang po'i spyor/ / gtong gi chags bral tsam 128

༄ / /mngonapamadzod tshos calnga'i 'jugapa'i༄9gosangagadang shi bas min/ / 'phags min 'chi bas gtong bya nyer bsdog go /yongs nyams 'gal rkyen stobs kyis nyams yin la/ / rnam nyams zhugs lam 'bras kyis btang ba yang / / 'gro gsum spyi'o bzod chen skye gnas gnyis/ / 'du shes med dang tshangs chen sgra mi snyan/ / tha ma srid brgyad mthong spang nyon mongs te/ / 'gro ba skye gnas skye ba lus srid pa/ / nyon mongs drug la mi skye'i bzod thob gsungs/ / thar cha thos bsam las byung gser 'phreng las/ / sgom gsung lus ngag yid kyi las gsum mo/ / thar cha zhes pa'i cha ni thob pa'o/ / shes rab mngon rtogs gsum mo mtshungs ldan gnyis/ / mtshan nyid bzhi sogs bya ba gcig bu'o/ /chos srung sde pa stong chen rab 'joms las/ / lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni/ / 'jig tshogs mtha' dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang / / the chom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag / gcig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba/gsungs phyir bden pa mngon rtogs gcig tu 'dod/ / yang dag ldan pa'i mdo las thar ba'i rim/ / 'og mar bzhag ste gong mar min bzhin gsungs/ / de phyir gzhan ni rim 'dod de la yang / / bzhi brgyad 'jig rten pa yoshes bzhir bcas/ / bcu gnyis skad cig bar du ldang bar smra/kha che bcu drug go gcig par zhugs 'bras 'gal/ / stong chen bya ba'i mngon rtogs dbang byas te/ /chos bzod kyis kyang kun 'byung spong 'gog thog /la sogs phyi mar byed pa 'jug phyir lo/ /zhugs gsum 'bras bu bzhi ste rdzas bdun po/ /thod rgal la 'khrul de la rdzas bzhi'o/ / dpe ston nges pa'i de la lha mi gnyis/ / bsdoms kyang srid pa brgyad pa 'gal zhes zer/ / tshe yongs gyur nges brgya byin 'og min du/ / smon pa ma bkag dga' phyir bye smra 'dod/ / der skye mi dgos gsungs na ches dga' mod/129

/ /phyir mi 'ong lngar spangs pa rigs dbang pos/ / khri dang nyis stong dgu brgya drug cur dbye/ / rdor ting dmigs pa'i sdug kun srid rtses te/ / khyad chos brgyad las ci rigs yin phyir brgyad/ / sa dgu'i 'gog la rnam pa so drug ste/ / 'dod pa'i lam bzhi gong lam spyir dmigs pa'i/ / bzhi ste nyer bsdogs brten pa nga gnyis so/ / bsam gtan lnga la'ang nga gnyis nga gnyis so/ / nam mkhar brten na 'dod pa'i 'gog lam brgyad/ /gzugs 'gog bcu drug bor bas nyer brgyad steng / / rnam shes la ni nam mkha'i 'gog bzhi bor/ / ci yang med la de'i bzhi bor ba yin/ /gzugs kyi sum brgya bcu gnyis lhag don gnyis/ / bsdoms pas rdor ting sum brgya gya bzhi'o/ / sde ba kha cig 'jig rten 'das kyi yang / / bral thob zag bcas yod de dbang 'thos pas/ / zag med btang yang nyon mongs mi ldanaphyir/ / khyod la 'dra ste srid gnyen zag bcas med/ / 'on kyang de phyed spangs pa dbang 'phos tshe/ / bral thob btang yang phyed mi ldan phyir dang / / byis pa gnyis par skye yang 'dod pa la/ / chags bral thob btang chags dang mi ldan bzhin/ / bye mdos bzlas pa rnam grangs 'dod tshul gnyis/ / kun btus la sogs 'pho ba nges 'dod par/ / gong mar gnas las mi skyod mi g.yo gnyis/ / rtog pa'i 'os can mi g.yor 'pho ba la/brel ngan byang bzhin goms phyir lam bco brgyad/ / mi slob zag med (sa dgu )slob la gzugs med dor/ / de tshe rtul pos khyad par can btang nas/ / rnon pos tsam po thob cing 'bras gnyis kyi/ / tsam po gzugs med bsdus pa med phyir ro/ / nyan thos bdun dang sangs rgyas gnyis te dgur/ / dbang po skor dgu'o 'phags tshogs gang zag bdun/ / la bsdus sbyor bas dad dang chos rjes 'brang / / dbang po'i sgo nas dad mos 130

༄ / /mngonasacas da ngos ca465 'jugasa'i༄9gozengagamathong thob gnyis/ / stoms par 'jug pa'i sgo nas lus mngon byed/ /rnam grol las ni shes rab kyis rnam grol/ / snyoms 'jug rnam grol gnyi ga'i rgyan bcas pa/ /rdzas su drug ste mthong la rjes 'brang gnyis/ / sgom la dad mos mthong thob mi slob la/ / dus spyor mi sbyor rnam grol rnam gnyis so/ /lam bzhi'i sbyor lam 'di la sgom yang ste/ /mjug tu bar chad med skye kun phyir ro/ / bsam gtan dngos gzhi sla la khyad can dang / / nyer bsdogs lhag mthong gzugs med zhi ches pas/ /dka' 'o rnon pos dka' sla gang brten kyang / / mngon shes myur la rtul pos gang yang bul/ /dka' sla rten dang myur bul dbang po'i phyir/ / nyer bsdogs la brten mngon shes 'di'i mdos 'grub/ / grub mtha' gong mas rdzu 'phrul sprul bsgyur dang / /rkang pa ting 'dzin 'dun sogs de rgyur bshad/ /bye smras rdzu 'phrul ting 'dzin 'dun sogs rkang / /'dun sems dpyod bcas bcu gsum rdzas su thal/ / tshul khrims lus dag dbye bas rdzas bcu gcig /bsdu bar lnga yis so bdun ma bsdus gsungs/ / byang lag 'phags lam go rim grangs phyir lo/ / nam mkha'i nyer bsdogs dran nye zag bcas kyis/bzhi pa'i zag bcas gzugs dmigs gzugs med pa/ / gsum gyi dngos gzhi zag bcas zag med kyis/ /sa drug zag med sdom dmigs srid rtse yi/ / zag bcas kyis kyang zag med sdom la dmigs/ / de phyir gzugs med na yang lus dran nye/ / yod de sde tshan mtha' gnyis ma gtogs phyir/ / dad dang tshul khrims 'dir gsungs gnas drug pa/ /mngon rtogs bdun gyis bsdus nas 'chad 'dod phyir/ / slob la lta rtog ngag sogs yan lag brgyad/ /mi slob la ni de steng rnam grol dang / /mi slob yang dag shes pa bsnan pa'i bcu/ / mos pa rnam grol zhes bya dga' 131

/ /lhang ba/ / byang chub nyid du sngar bshad zad mi skye/ / shes de skabs 'di'i yang dag ye shes so/ / 'gag 'gyur slob pa'i lam gyis sgrib spangs nas/skye 'gyur mi slob sems ni grol bar 'gyur/ / ma byas rnam grol la ni chags bral sogs/ / khams gsum shes bya chags bral yid 'byung mu/ /thod rgal la brtsi mthar gyis ma yang rung / /chos bzod bzod shes gnyis kyi shes pa min/ / yul der ze tshom spangs nas nges min phyir/ / zad shes tshol ba'i rang bzhin can min phyir/lta min 'phags blo gzhan ni gnyis ka ste/ / chags sogs blo yang lta min kun rdzob shes/ / de phyir gzhan shes zhes gsungs de'i dmigs bsal/ /lta ba drug ni lta dang kun rdzob shes/ / chos shes rjes shes kun rdzob shes gsum spyi/ / sems shes bden bzhi zad dang mi skye shes/ / gong 'og bden bzhi'i chos shes rjes shes brgyad/ / bcu gnyis 'byed tshul lta min chos shes bzhi/ / rjes shes bzhi la zad dang mi skye brgyad/ / gsungs pa'i chos shes mi slob yin min dang / / de la brgyad du mi 'byed rgyu mtshan dpyad/dang po'i zad dang mi skye sdug kun la/ / dmigs pa dug mnga' 'chi tshe sdug pa bzhin/ / chos rjes lam dang kun rdzob bzhi las sems sa 'das gong sa dbang 'das non po'i lam/ / gang zag 'das pa 'bras gnas gong ma'i lam/ / mi shes zhag dang ma skyes gnyis kyang ngo / / chos shes rjes shes la dmigs gnyis po yang / / phan tshun mi rig mthong lam la bltas tshe/ / nyan thos spyor ba skad cig bcu bzhi yis/ / mi 'grub dang po gnyis rig lhag mi rig / rang rgyal skad cig lnga la sbyor byed phyir/ / dang po gnyis rig brgyad pa rjes shes rig / gnyis pa khams gzhan phyir 'dor lhag ma la/ / slar yang bskyar na sbyor ba rdzogs mi nus/ / dgu pa rig na 132

༄ / /mngonapamadzodakyi༄ nargya'atshor 'jugapa'i༄ jingagabacu pa rig nus sam/ / 'dod na rang rgyal mthong lam bzhi rig 'gyur/shes bcus nang tshan bsdu ba mchims ṭīka las/ / kun rdzob shes pa rang dngani/ / sems shes cha'o chos shes ni/ / rang dang bden pa bzhi shes dang / / zad dang mi skye sems shes brgyad/ / rjes shes kyang yin bden gsum shes/ / rang dang zad dang mi skyes shes/ / chos shes rjes su shes pa dang / / lnga yin zad dang mi skye shes/ / rang dang bden pa bzhi shes dang / / chos shes rjes su shes dang bdun/ / sems shes chos shes rjes shes dang / / lam shes kun rdzob shes pa dang / / rang dang lnga yin lam shes ni/ / rang dang chos shes rjes shes dang / / sems shes zad dang mi skye shes/ / rnam pa drug tu yang dag brjod/ / zag bcas rang bzhin las ni kun dzob shes/ / gong 'og gnyen po las ni chos rjes gnyis/ / dmigs mtshungs rnam pa las ni sdug kun gnyis/ / lugs 'dir sdug kun gcig pa 'dis kyang shes/ / dmigs rnam gnyis char las ni 'gog lam gnyis/ /sems byung shes kyang sbyor las sems shes bajod/ / yang na sbyor ba so sor dgos phyir bzhag / zad shes bya ba byas la dang por skye/ / skal mnyam rgyu rgyas pa las mi skye shes/ / yig char zad shes skal mnyam la min gsungs/chos rjes gong 'og gnyen por ma nges te/ / 'gog lam chos shes dmigs pa mi dman pas/ / sngar 'dris chos shes kyis kyang gong ma spong / / rjes shes 'dod gnyen min te rgyal zin phyir/ / mthong lam gyis bsdus rjes shes 'dod gnyen min/ / bden dmigs gzhan phyir ro chos shes de dang 'dra/ mthong lam rjes shes kyi rgyun rgyun zhugs la/ / yod do sgom lam rjes shes yin nam dpyad/ / kun rdzob shes pa sbyor lam la sogs la/ / chos shes rjes shes bzhin du rnam bcu drug / gzhan du'ang rang spyi'i mtshan nyid 133

ra / / / lamatha' yas so/ / bden bzhi shes par rnam pa bzhi bzhi'o/ / dri med sems shes lam bzhin rnam pa bzhi/ / dri bcas sems kyi ngo bo rags pa mthong / / gnyi gas sems dang sems byung rdzas re re/ / tsam mthong skabs 'dir 'dod chags bcas gsungs don/ / chags can sems ni 'dres pa'i 'dod chags bcas/ / mtshungs ldan mig yang thob par ldan rnam dang / / rgyas 'gyur dmigs pa ldan pa'i 'dod chags bcas/ /zhes grags slob dpon chags bcas mtshungs ldan dang / / mtshungs par mi ldan chags bral la sbyar ro/ / gzhan yang kun tu bsdus dang rnam g.yeng dang / / zhum rab bzung shes sogs la rtsod tshul mang / / chags par shes kyang chags yul mi shes te/ / gzugs la dmigs na sems shes min par 'gyur/ / sems tsam lugs kyi sems shes dpyad gzhi che/ / zad dang mi skye shes pa tshol min phyir/ / sems shes las bkol bar chad med kyang bkol/ / lhag ma zad dang mi skye rnam bcu bzhi/ / rjes thob bya ba byas zhes dran pa la/ / mnyam gzhan stong dang bdag med mi mthun lo/ / nyi 'og rnam shes tshogs las gsungs pa'i phyir/ / zag med rnam par gzhi yod gnas yod bsnan/ / gzhi ni rgyu dang gnas ni mtshan nyid lo/ / gzhan ni bden mthong gzhi yod gnas yod zer/ / dpe ston rnam pa bcu drug rdzas bdun te/ / sdug bsngal bzhi 'o lhag ma rnam grangs phyir/ / shes rab mtshungs ldan yul gsum rnam pa dang / / 'dzin byed gzung bya gsum las gsum gnyis gcig / kun rdzob shes la rnam gsum lhag ma dge /mchims ṭīka mchan bur sems shes sgom byung bzung / / 'og tu gsum bshad skyes thob phyir mi 'gal/ / de ni mngon shes 'ang min par yig char gsungs/ / sems rten kun rdzob shes pa sa kun te/ / chos shes sa drug 134

༄ / /mngonapamadzod nga nargyamatshore 'jugasa'itsho jingagarjes shes sa dgu ste/ / sems shes ma gtogs drug kyang de bzhin dgu/ /sems shes 'dod gzugs chos 'dod lhag khams gsum/ /'gog blo chos dran sems shes lus ma gtogs/ / lhag ma bzhi'o lam yang sdom dmigs srid/ / chos shes yul la rjes shes ma gtogs dgu/ / rjes shes yul la chos shes ma gtogs dgu/ / lam shes yul la kun rdzob ma gtogs dgu/ sdug kun shes yul kun rdzob gzhan sems gnyis/ / kun rdzob sems shes zad mi skye bzhir bcu/ /'gog pa shes pa'i dmigs par shes pa med/ /'dod gzugs gzugs med gtogs dang zag med la/ / mtshungs ldan yin min dbye bas 'dus byas brgyad/ / 'dus ma byas la dge lung ma bstan gnyis/ /de ltar chos bcu thams cad kun rdzob yul/ /chos yul 'dod gtogs gnyis dang zag med gnyis/ / ma byas dge dang lnga'o rjes shes yul/ / gong bzhi zag med ma byas dge dang bdun/ / sems yul gzugs med dor bas mtshungs ldan gsum/ / 'gog yul dge ba gcig sogs skabs dang sbyar/ / bya byed gcig tu thal phyir rang tshogs las/ /gzhan tsam rigs gsungs bye brag pa la dgongs/ / chags can 'khrugs med so skye kun rdzob shes/ / bsam gtan stoms 'jug can la sems shes kyang / /chags can zag med dang por kun rdzob nyid/ /de nas shes pa re re 'phel gyur nas/ / chags bcas bcu drug pa la bdun dang ldan/ /'og ma thob tshul yin zhing dmigs bsal yod/ / dgra bcom rgyan bcas shes pa bcu dang ldan/ / mchims gsung 'di la mi g.yos khyab bam dpyad/shes bzod gang skyes de dang dmigs yul bden/ / mtshungs thob de yi rnam pa bzhi char rung / / sgom la dmigs pa mi mtshungs sna tshogs 'thob/rjes shes dang po gsum mthar kun rdzob shes/ / mngon par rtogs pa 135

/mtha' las byung zhes bya/ / chos shes la med lam rjes shes la med/ /bden pa de de dzogs mthong min phyir dang / / kun kyang 'gog pa gcig gis mngon byed kyang / / gnyen po lam kun gcig gis mi bsgom pas/ /lam la mtha' med phyir na mtha'i de med/ / de ni mi skye mthong lam de'i sa'am/ / 'og rten 'gog las byung de dran nye'i mtha'/ / chos so gzhan pa gnyis la bzhi ga yod/ / gang gi mthar byung de dang dmigs rnams mtshungs/ / bcu drug pa la bden bzhi chos rjes drug / kun rdzob mi 'thob sngar rnyed zin phyir dang / / lam mtha'i kun dzob med cing gzhan 'brel med/ / thob bya'i chos shes sgom yin gzhan btang phyir/ / chags bral bcu drug pa la sems shes 'thob/ / chags bcas pa yi bcu drug pa'i gong dang / / chags bral man gye bar der snga ma yi/ / drug steng kun dzob shes pa bsnan pa'i bdun/ / sa dgu'i bar ba bdun la rgyal byed dang / /slob pa'i mngon shes lnga po 'thob byed la/ / bdun thob slob phyir zad dang misgye min/ / bar chad med phyir sems shes der mi 'thob/ / srid rtse'i gnyen po kun rdzob shes med phyir/ / srid rtse'i rnam grol brgyad la sems shes bsnan/ / mi g.yor 'pho byed drug steng zad shes bsnan/ / spel sgom bar chad med la kun rdzob bsnan/ / spel chos zag med de nyid yin nam dpyad/ / bden bzhi chos rjes kun la bzhir bzhag go / slob pa'i spyong byed la drug mthong dang 'dra/ / 'dra ste rnon pos 'bras gsum thob byed phyir/ / des drangs rnam grol lam la chags bcas drug / gzhan la bdun no 'am zhes gnyis ka la/ / kun rdzob shes pa snon pa'i lugs gzhan bstan/srid pa'i rtse las rgyal byed la yang drug / zad pa shes la mi skye ma gtogs dgu / lhag ma 'og sa brgyad las rnam grol dang / / mngon shes spel sgom 136

༄ / /mngon paca zhud kros 'jub pa'i༄1gzingagasogs kyi rnam grol lam/ /mi g.yor 'pho byed rnam grol brgyad la yang /slob pas mtha' gnyis dor bas brgyad brgyad 'thob/ / gnyis par chags bral gsum pa'i zag med tshe/ / dang po gnyis pa yis kyang zag med 'thob/zad shes 'thob tshe mi sdug la sogs pa/ / zag bcas zag med bcu gcig sa kun gyis/ / bsdus 'thob rgyal srid thob tshe skyes 'bul bzhin/ /gsar thob lam dang yang yang mngon byas lam/ / sdom dang re zhig chags bral thob pa bzhi/ / nyi 'og sdom thob rnam 'jig thob gnyis bsnan/ /las la 'gog lam bzhi la 'gog shes dor/ / kun 'gro'i lam la rang gi ngo bos dgu/ / 'bras bur bcas na 'gog shes bsnan pas bcu/ / rjes dranaskye 'chi shes pa kun rdzob bo/ / zad shes ngo bo mkhyen pa'i dbang byas na/ /chos rjes 'gog dang kun rdzob zad mi skye/ /rgyud la yod pa'i dbang byas shes bcu lo/ / stobs brgyad rten la'ang nyer bsdogs bdun ma gtogs/ / btsun pa thugs bzhin sku'i stobs mtha' med gsungs/ /glang chen phal pa spos glang tshan po che/ / rab gnon yan lag mchog dang stobs mchog dang / / sred med bu rnams snga ma bcu 'gyur ro/ /zhar byung sangs rgyas rang rgyal 'khor sgyur tshigs/ / klu dud lu gu rgyud dang gzer bu 'dra/ / rtogs par mi 'jigs gnas mkhyen bzhin shes bcu/ / spangs pa mi 'jigs zad bzhin drug gam bcu/ / gsum pa las kyi rnam smin mkhyen bzhi brgyad/ / lam la mi 'jigs lam bzhin dgu'am bcu/ / dran nye chos mnyan la sbyar bag chags bshad/ / thugs rje'i khyad chos drug go rtsa bar gsal/ / thugs rje che dang snying rje'i khyad par brgyad/ngo bo gti mug med dang zhe sdang med/ / rnam pa sdug bsngal gsum dang sdug bsngal dngos/ / dmigs pa khams gsum pa dang 'dod khams tsam/137

/bzhi pa nyid dang mi lcogs med sogs rten/ / sangs rgyas la yod nyan rang so skyer yod/ / srid la chags bral 'dod chags bral las thob/ / 'khor ba'i 'jigs las yongs su skyong dang gzhan/ / sems can kun dang sdug bsngal can la skye/ / rgyu dang ye shes spangs pa mthu dang sku/ / phan 'dogs rnams la phun tshogs bzhi bzhi'o/ / slob ma dang ni thun mong zhes bya yi/ /slob dang min de dgra bcom mi slob phyir/ / smon nas sam gtad nas shes phyir smon nas shes/ / bzhi pa yin phyir gzugs med mi shes zer/ / de yi gzugs med skye bar lung bstan ci/ / snga phyi'i skye ba'i spyor las dpogs so lo/ / so rig rgyud rten nyon mongs med dang 'dra/ / chos kyang tshig ste sgrub pa'i chos sogs min/ / bzhi pa'i myang 'das la sogs sgrub byed kyi/ /rigs pa'am gtan tshigs thogs med mngon par brjod/ / spobs pa so rig ngag dang lam dmigs gnyis/ / bsdoms na 'gog shes ma gtogs shes pa dgu / ngag sogs kun 'byung yin pa 'dis kyang shes/ / ngag lam ci rigs shes phyir sa bcu gcig / don ni shes byar byas na shes pa bcu/ / myang 'das byas na zad shes drug dang 'dra/ / lhag ma'i ngo bo sa sogasalhu bar gsal/ / thun mong chos drug rab mthar brten dgos kyang /nges tshig dang sa 'gal phyir de'i rten min/ / de la rnam drug gsungs pa nyon mongs med/ / smon gnas mkhyen dang so rig gsum gyi steng / / de lnga gangagi ngo bor ma skyed pa'i/ / rab mtha' tsam po dang bcas drug yin no/'dod nas srid rtse'i bar du song 'ong gnyis/ / slar yang 'dod nas bzhi pa'i bar 'gro ba/ / mthun byas 'on kyang rab mtha' so sor bshad/ /grub mtha' gong mas rab dang mtha' yi don/ / gcig byas rab mthar bsam gtan bzhi ga yod/ / sgom byung mngon shes skabs 'di'i rnam grol 138

༄༅/ /maḥdzan pacasasdod maḥ na15'khutshor 'ju ngagagyes/ / khyab phyir rnam grol dbang shes mi 'gal lo/ / skabs 'dis mchims kyang rgyan bcas mi g.yor gsungs/ / sems lnga'o zad shes zad stobs bzhin zhe na/ / sa yang kun phyir sred rtses bsdus pa'i de/ / mngon sum yin na zag med thal bar 'gyur/ / lugs 'dir mngon shes mngon sum min nam dpyad/ / 'dod dang srid rtse'i mngon shes yod dam dpyad/sems tsam mngon shes 'di bas sbyor bar byas/ / sngar 'dris 'dod la chags bral tsam gyes thob/ / sbyor byung kho na'o bskal mtha'i lha la dpyad/ / mngon shes bzhi dang dran nye sbyor tshul gsal/ / sngon gnas 'chi 'pho gnyis la dran nye bzhi/ / bye smras mig rna'i mngon shes dbang shes smra/ / bsam gtan bzhi la yod gsungs dang mi 'gal/ / de'i rten dbang po'am 'dren byed bar chad med/ / bsam gtan de des bsdus la dgongs so lo/ /rjes dran 'chi 'pho zag zad gsum kho na/ / dus gsum rmongs sel rig pa'o de las kyang / / gnyis ni mi slob rgyud la skyes pa'i phyir/mi slob rig par bshad kyang mi slob min/ / tha mar mi slob mi dgos srid rtse'iphyir/ / mngon shes de dag slob la yod mod kyang / / rmongs bcas phyir na rig pa'i sgras ma bstan/ / rdzu 'phrul sems shes zag zad mngon shes gsum/ /rdzu 'phrul kun brjod rjes bstan cho 'phrul te/ / gha na dha ri ba'i sngags kyi rdzu 'phrul dang / / rtog byed ces sngags kun brjod 'phrul byed la/ /rjes bstan de 'dras mi nus 'khrul med de/ / thabs ston phan 'dogs 'bras bu mchog la sbyor/ / 'gro dang sprul pa'i dbye ba rtsa bar gsal/ / mngon shes kho nas sprul min sprul sems kyis/ / sprul phyir de yang dang por rang 'og gnyis/ / nas bzung bzhi bar lnga ste bcu bzhi'o/'dod pa'i sprul sems logs su ma bshad de/ / bsam gtan so so 'bras 139

/ /bu bshad yin la/ / de yang bzhi po gang rung 'bras phyir ro/ / dang po'i 'bras bus 'dod pa'i sprul sems kyi/ / (gnyis par/ )mi bgrod phyir na 'dod pa'i sprul sems bzhi/ / phyi ma phyi ma 'gro ba'i khyad par 'phags/gnyis pa'i 'bras bu dang pos sprul sems ni/ / yod kyang 'og 'bras gong ma'i sprul sems med/ / dngos gzhi bzhin du 'og sar bral las rnyed/ /gnyis las skye zhing de las de gnyis 'byung / / rang sa'i sprul byed dmigs bsal gnyis pa yan/ / rtog dpyod med phyir ro 'og mas smra ru 'jug de ni smra sems tsam las sprul sems min/ / sprul sems dang ni lhan cig 'gal zhe na/ / sngar sprul zin nas ring gnas byin brlab phyir/ / de tshe sprul sems mi dgos lung ring por/ / ji skad cig gis smra bar byed pa na/sprul pa thams cad smra bar byed gsungs pa/ / ston min dbang byas shi shar byin rlabs med/ / rus par yod lo sde gzhan 'od srung rus/ / gnas gtsang lha mthu'o byin rlabs yod min zer/ / byang dang ma byang sprul tshul rtsa bar gsal/ / sprul sems skyes thob la ni dge sogs gsum/ / sgom byung skyes thob bsnan pas rdzub 'phrul lnga/ / byang sems 'khor sgyur khyim bdag rin chen ltar/ / lha yi mig dang 'dra bas btags pa'am/ / dngos yin zhe na mig rna'i thon kor du/ / bsam gtan 'byung ba rgyur byas gzugs dngapo/ / sha rus sogs dang ma 'brel lha'i mig rna/ / dngos 'byung rdzu 'phrul bzhin du sna sogs bzhi/ / skyes thob yod kyang mngon shes ming mi 'thob/ / skyes thob mig gis bar srid mi mthong la/ / skyes thob sems shes la ni dge sogs gsum/ / mtshan ma las dpog rtog ge'i sems shes dang / / sngags kyi sems shes la yang gsum gsum mo/ / dmyal bar skyes ma thag la sems shes dang / / rjes dran ldan no mi la sems shes ni/ /140

sa / /mngonasamadzodabyung nargyamatshor 'jugasa'i༄khajingagaskyes thob med kyang tshe rabs dran pa yod/ /bsam gtan sas ni gsum pa yin zhes sogs/ / gsum par der skyes pa dag rab tu bshad/ /'di yis sems par byed phyir bsam gtan no/ /bsam gtan sas bsdus cha bzhag sems rtse gcig /snyoms 'jug don no nyer bsdogs dngos gzhi gnyis/ /'on kyang sems rtse gcig pa ting 'dzin yin/ /skye ba'i bsam gtan snod bcud sna tshogs shing / / nam 'tsho'i bar du gnas par mchims ṭīka gsung / /snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can ni snyoms 'jug min/ / yig char gzugs med sdom yod ldan la dgongs/ / phal chen chung la gzugs med btags zhes smra/ / gzugs med dmigs pa nam mkha' sogs sam dpyad/ / der brten zag med gsum gye 'byed byed dpyad/ / srid rtser stoms 'jug zag med yod pa'i phyir/ / rdzas gsum 'gyur ro zag med snyoms 'jug kyang / / snyoms 'jug zag med min de'i dbang byas lo/ /rdzas gnyis nang gi dgu pa ba ru thal/ / bye smra dang po gnyis kyi dga' ba ni/ / tshor ba yin phyir bde ba shin sbyang ngo / / dpe ston bde ba gsum ga lus tshor 'dod/ /lus tshor phyir bltas yin phyir g.yeng bar 'gyur/ / ting 'dzin las skyes lus bde der mthun lo/ /'dod pa'i lus kyis gong ma'i reg myong 'gyur/ /shin tusbrangs phyir myong yang skyon med lo/ / bar chad med lam yan lag su la yod/ /rim phyir yan lag lnga ldan med par 'gyur/ / rtog dpyod gnyis kyang rim phyir mtshungs so lo/ / shin sbyang bde na bzhi par bde 'phel 'gyur/ / grub mtha' gong mas dga' bde tshor gcig kyang / / lus sems phan 'dogs ldog pas phye gsungs shing / / rab dang sa gnyis par rtog dpyod bral ba'i phyir/ / gnyen po dran dang shes bzhin bsdoms la 141

/ /gsungs/ / sde pa kha cig gsum pa'i bde ba yang / / yid bde yin la dga' ba des spangs phyir/ / de gnyis gzhan du smra yang bsam gtan gyi/yan lag ston mdor yid bde yid mi bde/ / nub gsungs rnam par bsgyur ba'i mdo las kyang / / yid bde dbang po skyes pa ma lus pa/ /bkag par 'gyur ro gsungs phyir yid bde dga'/ / bye smras ting nge 'dzin ni bsam gtan dang / / bsam gtan yan lag gnyis yin gzhan min zer/nyon mongs can la med gsung de dag la/ / yig char gsungs bzhin dag pa sbyong dgos te/ / dran pa sems kyi sa mang yin phyir ro/ / dge ba'i sa phyir btang stoms shin sbyang bkol/ / sa bzhi'i bsam gtan tshor ba rtsa bar gsal/ / dpe ston gnyis par mig shes 'dod gsungs mchims/ / 'og spangs gong nas lhung bas dag pa 'thob/ / zag med dngos gzhi gsar thob chags bral dang / / ldan pa dbang 'phos sogs ni sbyor bas 'thob/ /dang po'i nyon mongs can ni dang po la/ / chags bral nyams dang gong der skyes pas 'thob/ / dang po'i 'og dang ci yang med pa'i gong / / zag med med la gzhan pa phal cher la/ / rang nas gong du bgrang de gsum 'og bgrang / / gsum gyi dag pa zag med gnyis gnyis ni/ / rang gi sa pa'i zag med mjug tu skye/ / dag par de steng rang sa'i nyon mongs bsnan/ /gong 'og nyon mongs mi snon rgyu mtshan ni/ / mchims ṭīka snyoms par 'jug dus dbang byas gsungs/ / 'chi 'pho'i dus kyi de ni zur gsungs phyir/nyams gnas khyad par nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi/ / rim bzhin rang sa'i nyon mongs rang sa'i dag / gong dag zag med skye dang rjes mthun phyir/nyams las nyams gnas gnas las nyams gnas khyad/ / khyad las nyams pa ma gtogs mtha' las mtha'/ / brgyad bdun zag bcas zag 142
